But upon awakening, she can no longer remember anything- no details about who she may have killed, not even her name. Who is this woman? Who has she killed? Can CID solve this mystery with help from this amnesiac, perhaps at her expense?

episodes.title: The Amnesia Patient - Part 2
episodes.overview: A mysterious man comes to the CID headquarters claiming the woman is his niece, and that her mental state is unstable, taking her home with him. But in the meantime, forensic evidence proves that the accident occurred because the car's tyres were shot at. The woman was evidently telling the truth about someone being after her. Who was that man, then? Could he be the true culprit of this crime? Will CID be able to solve this mystery and save the woman's life?

episodes.title: The Missing Man - Part 1
episodes.overview: A man's unconscious body is found dumped underneath a flyover, with ?1 lakh on him. He has been badly injured. Who is this man? How did he end up in this situation? And why does he have this much money with him? Will CID solve this mystery?

episodes.title: The Missing Man - Part 2
episodes.overview: Despite his injuries, the man wakes up- but upon awakening, he insists he injured himself by falling off the flyover by mistake, despite evidence from his injuries that he was attacked. He also seems desperate to stop any investigation of his case. Who is this man? Who attacked him, and why? Why does he have this much money with him? And why does he not want his case to be investigated?

episodes.title: The Blackmail Victims - Part 1
episodes.overview: A government officer’s luggage is stolen during a journey. Inside the baggage is very important diary that contains the details of witnesses who have testified in cases convicting major terrorists. If this diary were to fall into the wrong hands, the witnesses' lives would be in grave danger. Will CID be able to recover this diary and keep the witnesses safe?

episodes.title: The Blackmail Victims - Part 2
episodes.overview: CID is consulted to help recover the officer's diary and save the lives of the witnesses. But the investigation comes to a halt when a mysterious blackmailer contacts them, asking for 50 lakhs in return for the diary. Will CID be able to find this blackmailer, or will they have to succumb and pay the money to keep the witnesses safe?

episodes.title: The Giant Wheel - Part 1
episodes.overview: A woman's dead body is found on an amusement park ride. The only clues are an Intercity Airline card in her front pocket, and an eyewitness account that that she was accompanied by a man when she was getting onto the ride. Who is this woman? Why was she killed, and why whom? Will these clues be enough for CID to solve the case?

episodes.title: The Giant Wheel - Part 2
episodes.overview: The clues begin to increase. An inspection of the amusement park reveals a bag with a yellow shirt and blue jeans near the giant wheel ride where the body was found. An investigation into the woman's identity reveals she had recently come to Mumbai from Goa for an interview at the Intercity Airline office, and that she had a lover in Goa, named Narendra Lal. Can CID piece the rest of the puzzle together with these hints?

episodes.title: The Multiple Puzzzles - Part 1
episodes.overview: ACP and his team stumble upon a case where a man gets thrown off a building, all because of a photograph. What kind of value does this photograph hold that a life was taken because of this? Interestingly, another Government Bureau seems to be connected with this case. What's the team dealing with this time?

episodes.title: The Multiple Puzzzles - Part 2
episodes.overview: Knowing that they might be dealing with an issue that involves national security, the team needs to be careful. Their raid at Pallavi Hotel was somewhat a success, and they nabbed one of the people involved in the trade, although he revealed very little information. What more does the team need to do to crack this case?

episodes.title: Who Killed Ravinder - Part 1
episodes.overview: Two friends who were out on a casual fishing trip suddenly get the biggest shock of their lives when their hook gets stuck to a corpse underwater. ACP Pradyuman and his team rushes to the spot. A drinking permit and a token of some sort help Identify the victim. Initial investigations reveal that the murder was a recent incident.

episodes.title: Who Killed Ravinder - Part 2
episodes.overview: With the huge involvement of a under ground gambling scene, the motive behind the murder gets clearer. ACP and his team come to know about Rosy, who frequented one of these gambling dens and was known to the deceased. How does this affect the entire investigation?

episodes.title: Father's Revenge - Part 1
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman's attempt to trick kidnappers backfires when the kidnapper gets critically wounded in the altercation. The only person with any information about the kidnapped boy was this man in the ICU. How does the team go about retrieving information from a dying man?

episodes.title: Father's Revenge - Part 2
episodes.overview: With revenge being one of the motives, it becomes significantly harder for the team to trace the child. Investigation leads to a factory where at some point the child was kept hostage. But with the accused dead and the victim missing, the team hits a wall and is in need of a desperate breakthrough.

episodes.title: The Blackout - Part 1
episodes.overview: A woman goes missing from her in-law's boutique. The store manager claims that she left in a white Police jeep. CID trace the car to a remote location and eventually stumble upon an abandoned corpse but not of the woman who went missing.

episodes.title: The Blackout - Part 2
episodes.overview: The alcoholic husband remains clueless about his wife's disappearance and he lives in complete denial. CID are however convinced that car found outside the bungalow was the same car that left tire tracks in the jungle.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Last Show - Part 1
episodes.overview: A man is shot inside a movie theatre. The CID arrive and find out that the man was a famous actor in disguise. Knowing it will bring in a lot of media attention, the CID play it safe. The house help and people who knew him are questioned.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Last Show - Part 2
episodes.overview: The blind owner of the PCO is the only witness who can identify the culprit. Interrogating the people who had booked seats behind the deceased actor became crucial in this case. Were they involved or can they lead the CID to the culprit?

episodes.title: The Case Of The Four Rinas - Part 1
episodes.overview: A criminal terrorizes the city when he commits a spree of attacks on anyone named Rina Raj. With the help of a telephone directory. ACP Pradyuman and his team trace a possible victim and reach just in time to prevent anything unfortunate from happening. Who is this culprit? What's in the name?

episodes.title: The Case Of The Four Rinas - Part 2
episodes.overview: The close call at the terrace reveals two things. The killer mentioned come one called Shashikant and the fact that he was in search of some diamond. The mystery around Shashikant and the missing diamonds deepens as the team decides to put Asha as a bait and lure the killer into the CID's trap. Will they be successful with this underhanded tactic? Was putting an Officer's life at risk worth it?

episodes.title: The Case Of 48 Kms. To Mumbai - Part 1
episodes.overview: An Intelligence officer is found dead in the jungle. It appears that the body was tortured and there are visible signs of combat before death. With no information about the people he was fighting, the team decides to contact higher officials in the Intelligence Bureau.

episodes.title: The Case Of 48 Kms. To Mumbai - Part 2
episodes.overview: The case has taken a new direction after the Doctor's murder. Investigations around the clinic helps the team find out more about the culprits and their possible exit route. Forensic analysis of the stomach contents reveals a piece of paper with something written on it. What was so special in that paper that the IB officer had to swallow it before dying?

episodes.title: The Case Of The Strange Clues - Part 1
episodes.overview: A man's wedding proposal gets interrupted when the girlfriend spots an abandoned corpse inside a car, on the opposite side of the road. The CID team is called into action for further investigation of the dead body. It becomes obvious that a blunt object was used in this case, that claim gets solidified when Asha manages to find the murder weapon in the lake. But what about the fake gun found inside the car?

episodes.title: The Case Of The Strange Clues - Part 2
episodes.overview: With information about the relationship with Sheila, ACP Pradyuman and his team dig deeper into the records and find out more about the will that was left behind. Everyone from Jagdish to Sheila have good selfish reasons to take someone's life. With such wealth on the line, everyone including family is under scrutiny.

episodes.title: The Case Of LOCKER NO. 42 - Part 1
episodes.overview: A blood-stained letter is sent to the Bureau. Closer inspection reveals that the key opened one of the lockers in a local bank. The team rushes to the bank to find out more about this mysterious key. They open the locker and find 9 Lakh Rupees. This makes the case even more complicated. Why was a blood-stained key sent to the department? What happened to the owner of the safe?

episodes.title: The Case Of LOCKER NO. 42 - Part 2
episodes.overview: With Kamal dead in his house, the team struggles to put pieces together. The introduction of all these new characters doesn't make it easier for the team. Kamal's previous employers refuse all the claims made by the CID team. His friends claim that he'd been spending a lot since he returned from Lonavla. Where did he get this money? Was his uncle his main sponsor?

episodes.title: The Case Of The Clinching Evidence - Part 1
episodes.overview: Dr. Salunkhe gets into a traffic altercation. Things get heated up and he draws his gun at the man. A few days later, the man is found dead and the fingerprints on the crime scene match Dr. Salunkhe's prints.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Clinching Evidence - Part 2
episodes.overview: With fingerprints on one side and just a broken piece of glass on the other, the case is heavily tilted towards prosecution. The CID sense that Dr. Salunkhe is being framed in a larger conspiracy.

episodes.title: The Case Of The 639 Coins - Part 1
episodes.overview: A man mysteriously dies of a heart attack in a shopping market. CID find multiple fake IDs with him, hinting that the man was either a con man or a terrorist. Meanwhile, a famous actor gets kidnapped. Could these two cases be connected?

episodes.title: The Case Of The 639 Coins - Part 2
episodes.overview: With clear indication that the calls were made from PCOs, CID do a thorough fingerprint scan of all the coins in those 3 portable public phones, hoping for a match.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Dishonest Cop - Part 1
episodes.overview: Daya's friend, a TV show director, invites him over to discuss a murder mystery script that he was working on. While eating dinner and discussing, Daya's friend calls his wife, but nobody picks up.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Dishonest Cop - Part 2
episodes.overview: With some people in the industry pointing at Daya, there is a huge lack of internal trust in the department. Daya is ready to go against everyone in the Bureau to clear his name.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Unknown Girl - Part 1
episodes.overview: Inspector Abhijeet goes through a temporary phase of 'memory loss' due to his combat injuries. On his way to recovery, he comes across a woman looking for help in the middle of the road. She claimed her life was in danger and someone from the adjacent building was trying to kill her. Inspector Abhijeet responds but doesn't find anyone. People in his department however are skeptical about his story considering his mental conditions.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Unknown Girl - Part 2
episodes.overview: Inspector Abhijeet is on the lookout of an unknown girl who is believed to be dead five years ago. Will he find her? Watch this episode to find out.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Mysterious Matrimonials - Part 1
episodes.overview: A woman hits a man with her car but upon investigation, it is found that the man was killed by a gunshot. Who killed him and why? Watch this episode to find out.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Mysterious Matrimonials - Part 2
episodes.overview: Dr Salunkhe is a suspect in a murder case and CID find this about him. How is he related? Watch this episode to find out.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Invisible Bullet - Part 1
episodes.overview: Dr. Salunkhe is a suspect in a murder case and CID find this about him. How is he related?

episodes.title: The Case Of The Invisible Bullet - Part 2
episodes.overview: Dr. Salunkhe is accused of hiding the bullet that is used for the murder. Meanwhile, a junior doctor informs Salunkhe, that she has been the given the charge to do the postmortem of the body of the victim. Is Salunkhe guilty or not?

episodes.title: The Case Of The Dead Murderer - Part 1
episodes.overview: A man named Jayant is killed after he gets a death threat from a kid named Avinash who is known to be dead from the past 20 years. How is it possible? Watch this episode to find out.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Dead Murderer - Part 2
episodes.overview: CID interrogate Shruti who is in the hospital after being attacked. Inspector Abhijeet has also been attacked. Will CID solve the case of this dead murdered? Watch this episode to find out.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Unknown Attacker - Part 1
episodes.overview: A man received death threats through letters and texts. CID investigated the case and interrogates the inmates of the house as they're the major suspects.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Unknown Attacker - Part 2
episodes.overview: Niranjan gets a heart attack and CID reaches to investigate. The culprit is still on the run and it's found that his medicines were quoted with an allergen. Will CID find the culprit?

episodes.title: The Case Of The Flashing Light: Part 1
episodes.overview: Residents of a society in Borivali are suspicious of an unknown person in their area. Upon investigation, it's found out that a guy named Raj has been killed and Neha has disappeared.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Flashing Light: Part 2
episodes.overview: CID finds and unknown skull buried in the ground. They suspect that it's linked to Raj's death and interrogate a transporter who knew Raj. Will they find the killer?

episodes.title: The Case Of The Bomb Scare - Part 1
episodes.overview: A bomb explodes outside actress Ranjana's house and CID is on the case to investigate who did this. They find a burnt finger and burnt skin at the site of the blast. All eyes are on producer Vipin Kumar, but he is nowhere to be found. Will CID catch him?

episodes.title: The Case Of The Bomb Scare - Part 2
episodes.overview: CID finds producer Vipin Kumar and his wife along with actress Ranjana. On the other hand, clues lead them to a man named Gangu who is on the run. Will CID catch him? Watch this episode to find out.

episodes.title: The Killings Of The Panther - Part 1
episodes.overview: A young kid witnesses the murder of a girl by a panther. CID is informed about this. Upon investigation, they find an unknown key. Who does it belong to?

episodes.title: The Killings Of The Panther - Part 2
episodes.overview: A kid spots a man-eating wild animal in the forest. A woman is attacked by the animal and she dies. Meanwhile, a man enters the forest and drops a key right outside his car. CID is called in to investigate. What looks like a wild animal attack has something more to it. Find out in this episode of CID.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Green Paint - Part 1
episodes.overview: A nurse is found dead in her house with green paint smeared all over her face and also on the serving dishes. This unique murder case puts the CID in turmoil. Will they find the killer?

episodes.title: The Case Of The Green Paint - Part 2
episodes.overview: Nurses are being killed with green paint on their faces. Dr. Yash is considered a suspect for these killings. Meanwhile, another nurse named Sandhya dies. Will CID catch the killer?

episodes.title: The Case Of The Frame Up - Part 1
episodes.overview: A dead body is found in the backseat of a car. All eyes are pointed on Sudhakar when a bag full of money is also retrieved from there. Sudhakar is on the run. Is he the culprit or is he being framed?

episodes.title: The Case Of The Frame Up - Part 2
episodes.overview: Sudhakar meets his informant and asks for a place to hide where CID cannot find him. Why is he hiding when he has not done anything?

episodes.title: The Case Of The Mysterious Deaths - Part 1
episodes.overview: A man named Utkarsh who has been missing from his home since the last three years enters a gift shop and threatens the shopkeeper for one lakh rupees. Later he's found dead in a hotel room where he was staying. Who killed him? Watch this episode of CID to find out.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Mysterious Deaths - Part 2
episodes.overview: Utkarsh's parents reveal about their son's drinking problem and just then CID find a dead body of another man named Abhimanyu who was also missing from his home, just like Utkarsh. Are the deaths of the Utkarsh and Abhimanyu linked? Watch this episode to find out.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Juicy Poison - Part 1
episodes.overview: Malini dies after being given poison through juice. Her husband is the prime suspect. Upon investigation it is revealed that someone has been poisoning all the juice bottles. Who is it?

episodes.title: The Case Of The Juicy Poison - Part 2
episodes.overview: A syringe is found in the juice factory and CID are called in to investigate. The syringe was used to inject poison in the juice bottles. Will the culprit be found?

episodes.title: The Case Of The Predictions - Part 1
episodes.overview: Dr. Purshottam dies and his death was predicted by a patient who has Alzheimer's. Upon investigation, it is found that an astrologer is a regular visitor of the patient.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Predictions - Part 2
episodes.overview: Another accident takes place at Kings Circle and it was also predicted by the Alzheimer's patient. CID investigate the accident to find out the culprit behind these killings.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Wedding Blues - Part 1
episodes.overview: On the eve of Karthik's marriage his ex-girlfriend Shalakha is bitter and threatens her. His friend, Ashok, knows Daya whom he asks for help. Shalakha enters with the lights switched off just then and a shot is fired. The girl is dead.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Wedding Blues - Part 2
episodes.overview: The twists and turns continue making the case even more intricate. The suicide note of Karthik doesn't match with his handwriting and what's even more surprising is that the same gun has been used to kill both Shalakha and Karthik.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Tempting Diamond - Part 1
episodes.overview: Ranveer an aging patriarch calls his entire family to explain that he is now broke. All he is left with is a Rs.2.5 crore diamond which he intends to sell and square off his debt and distribute the remaining amount among his children leaving all of them dis-satisfied. He suffers a heart attack and as the doctor advises complete rest his daughter tries to coax his dad to give the locker number. The next morning he is found dead with a knife plunged into his heart.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Tempting Diamond - Part 2
episodes.overview: CID starts investigating the murder case and finds that all members of the family including the maid and her daughter are driven by greed and had a reason to kill the patriarch. The twist in the case comes when the sniffer dog finds the dead body of Durvesh, a friend of Ranvir's son who was also in the bungalow. Now there is a double murder and a missing diamond case that CID needs to solve.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Red Water - Part 1
episodes.overview: A housing society is experiencing panic due to red tap water, suspected to be blood. CID investigations reveal a body with a slit throat in the overhead water tank, belonging to Mr. Rana, who was supposed to return from a night tour.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Red Water - Part 2
episodes.overview: CID are investigating Mr. Rana's mysterious murder, but society are shocked when the kitchen water line turns red and the killer dumps the body and Mr. Rana's bag in a second water tank, causing further shock for the community.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Frightened Men - Part 1
episodes.overview: Piyush, a writer specializing in murder mysteries, becomes the prime suspect when one of the five friends, Rishab, gets murdered in his presence shot with his own gun in his own house. All of them were getting unsigned letters warning them that now it was their turn. The common thing the five friends was the fact that they had all ragged Piyush during the college days resulting in him falling off from the second floor of the hostel. Is he the one? or is there a twist?

episodes.title: The Case Of The Frightened Men - Part 2
episodes.overview: The twist in the story comes when it comes to light that Chander, one of Rishab's friend had a motive to kill. He owed ten lakh rupees to Rishab and was not in a position to pay. However, very soon Chandar and one more of his friend too die of poisoning.

episodes.title: The Case Of 1030 AM - Part 1
episodes.overview: A man in a mask enters a bank to rob it. The robbery goes haywire when he gets a heart attack. He is then rushed to the hospital and is later declared dead. The team of CID reaches the bank and is informed of the case. Dr. Jayant fills them with the information that the mysterious man died at 10:30 AM due to a heart attack. Upon investigation they come to know that this mysterious man called Raghu could not die at 10:30 AM as he was home at that time. Could there be more answers at the club?

episodes.title: The Case Of 1030 AM - Part 2
episodes.overview: CID gets a call from a girl from the club that she has seen Raghu talking to a woman who workd there, but had quit only a day before. This woman, Kalpana, refuses to know Raghu or that she had anything to do with him. But the truth can not stay hidden and the team comes to know that she was Raghu's ex-wife. Can Kalpana be able to help solve this confusing case or could she be the one involved in the death of Raghu?

episodes.title: The Case Of The Nightmare - Part 1
episodes.overview: Sidharth is prone to seeing nightmares. He witnesses a murder in a bungalow with the body being disposed in a wardrobe. When he narrates it his colleague she calls in the CID because Sidharth has bruises on his body and also has the key of the wardrobe. Just then CID is informed of a murder in Madh island. Shockingly the details match with the nightmare.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Nightmare - Part 2
episodes.overview: The initial suspicion is on Sidharth as he has with him the key of the wardrobe where the corpse was hidden. However CID decides to utilise the services of a specialised psychiatrist who helps Sidharth to go on an induced sleep so that he can see the nightmare further. The result is shocking.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Chasing Butterflies - Part 1
episodes.overview: At a motel in the outskirts of the city a car is parked in such a way that it obstructs others driving out. The watchman is alerted and very soon they all hear the a ticking sound as if a bomb is about to go off. CID is called in and so is the bomb disposal squad. Surprisingly, a dead body of a woman is recovered from the trunk which is a few days old. Forensics find that inside her ear are some eggs of a rare butterfly. CID gets cracking on the case with this slender evidence.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Chasing Butterflies - Part 2
episodes.overview: CID investigates the lead given by the forensics and try to find out the specialty of the butterfly eggs This leads them to a particular jungle in the outskirts of Pune. It is a slender lead but CID manages to outwit the killer and trace him using all their analytical skills and experience.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Invisible Murderer - Part 1
episodes.overview: During a party, a man named Shailender plans to make a new will that deprives his family members of taking his money after his death. Before he can sign it, he's killed. CID tries to investigate and doubts the relatives at the party.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Invisible Murderer - Part 2
episodes.overview: With Dr. Salunkhe's help, CID were able to track down the weapon used in the murder. They go back to the crime scene to find more evidence to apprehend the culprit.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Mysterious Blast - Part 1
episodes.overview: A taxi gets blown up in a blast with the bomb planted in a suitcase left on the back seat. Eyewitnesses say that the driver seemed to be in a hurry. Either the driver was delivering the bomb or the bomb was left behind by the bomber.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Mysterious Blast - Part 2
episodes.overview: The sticker on the teddy bear leads CID to a hotel and suspect who had checked out the day after the blast. CID manages to get wind of a drug mafia and begins the intricate job of laying a trap for the drug dealer.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Elusive Bomber - Part 1
episodes.overview: A film shooting is in progress. The man in charge of explosives is short of trained men. The mock blast scene goes wrong as someone has used real explosives to sabotage the project killing the blast master.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Elusive Bomber - Part 2
episodes.overview: The intricate web of deceit and betrayal takes the CID back to 25 years when 75 lakh rupees were looted. CID finds out that the blast master was involved in this loot along with his partner who gets jailed for 5 years.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Red Rain - Part 1
episodes.overview: An elderly gentleman is seen driving the car erratically and dashes against the sidewalk. He gets out of the car and after taking a few unsteady steps fall down dead. CID finds out that it is not a case of drunk driving but a cold blooded murder as someone had injected him with poison. It also transpires that he had got a unsigned letter giving him a death threat. His two other business partners too get killed with the same poison just after the funeral.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Red Rain - Part 2
episodes.overview: Forensics conclude that the killer has a burnt hand because of which he has a peculiar finger print which were retrieved from the letters and the umbrella used to inject the poison. The third business partner too just before dying was trying to convey to the CID by repeatedly saying fire, fire. CID needs to solve the case on the basis of this minor clue.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Poisonous Cigarettes - Part 1
episodes.overview: Two friends suffer from heart attacks. One of them dies. Forensics suspect it to be a case of poisoning and trace it to a cigarette which they both had shared which was meant for someone else and they had accidentally borrowed it.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Poisonous Cigarettes - Part 2
episodes.overview: The young couple who were having the poisonous cigarette clearly were the killer's targets. CID's investigation leads them to a bunch of friends and acquaintances who were there and they're suspects of mixing the poison in the cigarette.

episodes.title: The Case Of Two Blackmailers - Part 1
episodes.overview: A man is stabbed and thrown from a van outside an ATM. He desperately wanted to say something to a lady coming out, but he dies. CID pick up the event from the CCTV and find out that the man was a photographer who blackmails people.

episodes.title: The Case Of Two Blackmailers - Part 2
episodes.overview: CID come across a mysterious phone number, which leads them to a man who claims that the victim was blackmailing him. Will these clues be enough for the CID to solve the case?

episodes.title: The Case Of Nailing The Suspect - Part 1
episodes.overview: A woman is found dead at her office desk, strangled by someone with long nails, no signs of struggle. CID officers suspect someone in the office and begin inspecting every employee.

episodes.title: The Case Of Nailing The Suspect - Part 2
episodes.overview: Abhijeet suspects the killer cut the office employees' nails, leading to a search of office's dustbins to find the nail cuttings. Meanwhile, a mysterious new forensic doctor gets assigned to the case.

episodes.title: The Case Of Flat 211 - Part 1
episodes.overview: A man's body is found in a flat where he does not live. Forensic work reveals that he was killed by an electric current, likely passed through the key used to open the door of the flat. Is this a murder or an accident? And if it is a murder, will CID find the killer? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodes.title: The Case Of Flat 211 - Part 2
episodes.overview: Further forensic investigation reveals that marks from the fingers of five different people are on the door- which means the man was not alone, and likely murdered. A search begins for the locksmith who gave the victim the key that lead to his death. It turns out that the man had paid a locksmith 5 lakh rupees to make him that key. Why did he go to such a length for a key? How did it lead to his death? Will CID solve this case and find the killer? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Spitting Cobra - Part 1
episodes.overview: A man's corpse is found floating in a river by a family out on an excursion. The victim's eyes are swollen due to, it turns out, snake venom.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Spitting Cobra - Part 2
episodes.overview: An investigation reveals that all three men who were bit by a splitting cobra landed up in the jungle after having a meal together, and that the one who survived seems to have some kind of amnesia.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Horryfying Viruse - Part 1
episodes.overview: A prisoner escapes from jail and robs and kills a man. CID is called to the scene to begin searching for the man. But a seemingly ordinary case goes awry when a deformity on the victim's body, first thought to be cause by acid burns at the hands of the prisoner, turns out to be the result of a virus- that the prisoner is now carrying around the city, possibly infecting hundreds. Can CID catch the prisoner and stop this calamity?

episodes.title: The Case Of The Horryfying Viruse - Part 2
episodes.overview: CID question the prisoner's kin and find out that he plans to visit someone in the city. They soon find the man, infected with the virus but not dead yet, and find out he gave the prisoner some money. CID soon deduces that the prisoner plans to sell the virus to the highest bidder so it can be weaponised. A search for a vaccine begins, but things get even worse when a member of the CID team gets infected with the virus. Will CID be able to stop this calamity? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodes.title: The Case Of Missing Money - Part 1
episodes.overview: A man's corpse is found, killed by drowning after being knocked out by a hit to the head. With very few leads to work off, CID officers begin to investigate a strange tattoo on the man's shoulder, and use it to begin searching for the man's identity. Will they find out who this man is and why he was killed? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodes.title: The Case Of Missing Money - Part 2
episodes.overview: It is revealed that the victim was a state agent who intended to buy a property near Ranipur- and was carrying 40 lakh rupees with him before he died, all of which is now missing. An investigation at hotels in the Ranipur area reveals that the victim got into a scuffle with a waiter at one of the hotels, and that the waiter has not come to work since. CID begin the search for this waiter, now the number one culprit and seem to be coming close to solving the case when the find the victim's car at the waiter's home. But the case turns a loose end when they find the waiter dead, underneath it. How will CID solve this case? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodes.title: The Case Of Robbery After Death - Part 1
episodes.overview: A scientist's body is found at a private science lab, where a six-month vaccine for anthrax has just been developed- and now, stolen. An investigation of the crime scene reveals that the lab was only accessed by one person before the victim, one Dr. Carlton, a scientist who reportedly died four days before the crime. But when Dr. Carlton's coffin is found to be empty, he immediately becomes the number one suspect in the case. Will CID find Dr. Carlton and solve this case? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodes.title: The Case Of Robbery After Death - Part 2
episodes.overview: CID officers deduce that a rival pharmaceutical company must have ordered this killing in order to be able to steal the vaccine but have no evidence to support this theory. It is also found that Dr. Carlton is indeed dead after his body is found in a storage room at the lab, and that his body was likely dug up used by the killer to access the lab. But with no more clues to work off, how will CID solve this case? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodes.title: HOWZZAT  - Part 1
episodes.overview: A gun is found in former cricketer Kapil Dev's bag at an airport security check, and he swears it's not his. The CID suspect he left it unattended in a changing room. A sniffer dog finds a dead body shot in the chest.

episodes.title: HOWZZAT  - Part 2
episodes.overview: A forensic investigation reveals the victim was shot by the same gun found in Kapil Dev's bag, Later, a phone belonging to the victim is found nearby, revealing that the victim had tried to call Kapil Dev thrice over the past day.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Unusual Murder - Part 1
episodes.overview: CID is called to a seemingly ordinary crime scene. There seems to be a clear murder weapon at the scene with fingerprints and the victim's blood on it, a footprint near the body, as well as an eyewitness report of someone running away from the scene. But things take a strange turn when a torn photograph of a cat is also found at the scene. Is this an unrelated object or could this be a a part of the case? How will CID solve this mystery? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Unusual Murder - Part 2
episodes.overview: All the clues seem to be pointing to a suspect name Daria- the eyewitness recognises him and his shoes match the footprint at the scene. The problem is, however, Daria was dead long before the victim was killed. To make things even stranger, a forensic investigation of a hair found on the victim's body reveals that does not belong to a man, but to a cat. Could this seemingly ordinary, usual murder, have more to the story than what meets the eye? How will CID solve this case? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Serial Threats - Part 1
episodes.overview: A man's family keeps receiving death threats, and when his front door is fired at as he's returning home, he requests the help of the CID. The man suspects that an old business rival is behind these threats, and the investigation begins.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Serial Threats - Part 2
episodes.overview: Investigation reveals partially destroyed letter from Rajesh to Sheila, who fancied each other but her husband found out. Search narrows to three people, but ACP Pradyuman suggests investigating Rajesh's wife, Pallavi.

episodes.title: Better Safe Than Sorry - Part 1
episodes.overview: A man on an amusement park ride makes a phone call crying out for help. Moments later, he is thrown off the ride and killed. CID trace the call he made to a banker, who is soon found shot dead at his office.

episodes.title: Better Safe Than Sorry - Part 2
episodes.overview: The banker had opened two safe deposit boxes that belonged to him and his wife before he was killed. His wife reveals that she had recently bought some jewels, and that her husband was perhaps trying to put them into the safes.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Kidnapped Girl - Part 1
episodes.overview: Two men kidnap a girl in broad daylight at a shopping centre, despite her crying out for her friend's help. The only piece of evidence is a matchbox from a disco, found inside the girl's purse. Will CID be able to find the kidnappers and save the girl? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Kidnapped Girl - Part 2
episodes.overview: The kidnappers' van is found abandoned near the shopping centre. Eyewitness reports suggest that the kidnappers hit Manisha on the head with something to make her stop shouting for her friend's help. ACP Pradyuman reckons that she might be as good as dead, but alas, no body has been found yet. A forensic investigation of the van reveals sand on the tyres, meaning it was at a beach not too long ago. With his clue, the search carries on for Manisha and her kidnappers. How will CID be able to solve this case? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodes.title: Target - CID - Part 1
episodes.overview: Daya gets shot by a gun sent in his nephew's birthday party. Later, Asha almost dies when her lift's chain breaks. Abhijeet and Sudhakar also face an accident when the car brakes fail. Though they survive CID wonder who is behind all this.

episodes.title: Target - CID - Part 2
episodes.overview: A mysterious gas is released from a package in the CID bureau, temporarily blinding all the officers. Further investigation reveals that somebody deliberately cut the car's brakes. A handprint is found with one finger missing.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Dazed Man - Part 1
episodes.overview: A kid playing by himself in the shopping center finds a man drenched in blood. He is rushed to the hospital, and the CID is called upon. ACP Pradyuman and his team realize that the man wasn't in his best possible mental state and is blabbering like an abecedarian. Meanwhile, on the radio, Pradyuman hears about a missing school bus with children in it. Could these cases be related?

episodes.title: The Case Of The Dazed Man - Part 2
episodes.overview: After finding the teacher's dead body, the CID are put in a catch-22 situation. They know they can't create a mass panic by releasing news about the death of the teacher to the press. Clue by clue CID inches towards the missing bus. Can it be found? Watch now to find out.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Invisible Bomb - Part 1
episodes.overview: Criminals manage to pass through high level security and detonate a bomb. ACP and his team fail to understand how someone can bring in and explode such a massive amount of explosives and successfully blow it. Only ray of light happens to be a cockroach who survived the blast. Was it a blast or is there more?

episodes.title: The Case Of The Invisible Bomb - Part 2
episodes.overview: Unfolding the mystery and finding another layer of poisoning in the case. It is found the poison was in the Samosa and the chai. Further investigation reveals that the culprit wears black glasses, even at night. And so begins, CID's search for this mysterious man.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Suicide-That Was Murder - Part 1
episodes.overview: A man falls off the building and dies. The closest person there happened to be Inspector Daya's friend, who becomes the prime accused in this case. Forensic team is convinced that Daya and Abhijeet are trying to protect the culprit. Is that really the case?Watch to find out.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Suicide-That Was Murder - Part 2
episodes.overview: With the team still trying to figure out the exact chain of events that led to the death. The forensic team gets its hands on some crucial evidence that changes the whole direction of the investigation. Can Daya clean his name and show the world duty comes first to him?

episodes.title: The Case Of The Deadly Proposed - Part 1
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman keeps getting phone calls from an unknown admirer. She insists that she loves him, and they should get married. She even threatens to kill a person if her proposal wasn't accepted. What does ACP do in a situation like this?

episodes.title: The Case Of The Deadly Proposed - Part 2
episodes.overview: The case shifts when ACP Pradyuman discovers that the woman who called him was just a pawn in the bigger picture, while Dr. Anjalika secures evidence to prosecute ACP Pradyuman for allegedly killing her husband.

episodes.title: Trust Me Not - Part 1
episodes.overview: A thief caught in a raid reveals that he saw a dead body in one of the houses he looted. ACP Pradyuman and his team take this matter seriously and rush to the house. But to their surprise, the woman, who the thief claimed to be dead, was in fact alive and questioning the thief's claim. Who is telling the truth here?

episodes.title: Trust Me Not - Part 2
episodes.overview: After shedding light on the blackmailing nexus, ACP Pradyuman and his team get into some dangerous territories, when Senior Inspector Abhijeet goes under cover and risks it all. What started off as a case involving a thief, has now taken a completely different angle, with multiple individuals and motives. Watch this thrilling episode here on Sony LIV.

episodes.title: The Case Of Kidnapping Star - Part 1
episodes.overview: A famous film star Kamlini gets abducted from a five start hotel. ACP Pradyuman and his team are called in to investigate the matter. Kidnappers have demanded 5 crores in ransom. But things start looking suspicious really soon. What really happened? Who kidnapped Kamalini?

episodes.title: The Case Of Kidnapping Star - Part 2
episodes.overview: The manager reveals that Kamilini was part of the plan, but the second kidnapping wasn't part of their plan. The CID is not convinced by this story. The kidnappers call CID and demanded that they pay up or witness Kamalini falls from a high rise. How does ACP save Kamalini?

episodes.title: The Case Of the Mistaken Identity - Part 1
episodes.overview: CID get baffled when they find two women who looked exactly like the deceased in their latest case. A bit of investigation leads them to a plastic surgeon who changes some of his patient's faces to match his daughter's face, who passed away a few years back. What makes the doctor do such a thing? There's only one way to find out.

episodes.title: The Case Of the Mistaken Identity - Part 2
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman's car gets stopped by a girl in the middle of the road, she says her car has broken down and would appreciate some help. ACP drops her to her house but gets an ominous vibe. He speaks to the caretaker, but the caretaker tells him, the girl he saw, died a few years ago. Is ACP hallucinating? Watch this special episode now.

episodes.title: ACP In The Game Of Death - Part 1
episodes.overview: After coming to know about the flash mob, ACP goes looking for the girl he gave a lift to. As it turns out, the girl died under unusual circumstances. This dangerous game just got real for everyone. Watch this special episode here.

episodes.title: ACP In The Game Of Death - Part 2
episodes.overview: As the forensic team reveals that the death was dude to being bitten by a venomous snake, officers are put in a fix as they didn't have suspect. It appears that the killer had made two holes in the bag and made sure that snake had enough oxygen to survive. Who could be behind this masterplan? Watch now to find out.

episodes.title: The Case 15 Years Old - Part 1
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman recollects his first case in the department involving a murder because of mistaken identity, the immediate death of the murderer that followed, and the resurgence of the same murderer after years of inactivity.

episodes.title: The Case 15 Years Old - Part 2
episodes.overview: The case becomes more complex when the CID recognize the significant role facial reconstruction surgery plays, with multiple characters with their own motives. ACP Pradyuman couldn't have asked for a better welcome to the department.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Comatose Victim - Part 1
episodes.overview: A patient in a critical condition with her life at constant risk for some odd reason is being treated in a hospital. An unknown man made an attempt to cut off her life supply. The CID are called in and are promptly updated on the issue.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Comatose Victim - Part 2
episodes.overview: The mystery continues as new information about an address possibly fake but true emerges. Daya uses modern technology to search for the suspect. Knowing the fact that the suspect has already broken in twice becomes unsettling for the CID.

episodes.title: The Bloody Trail - Part 1
episodes.overview: A long trail of blood leads to a murder. It appears the victim had hidden a key of some sort in his bullet wound. What kind of key is it? What does it lead to? There must be a reason why a dying man decided to hide this key. Watch now to find out.

episodes.title: The Bloody Trail - Part 2
episodes.overview: With a key but no locker CID had to do a thorough search of the city to locate the gym where the key could be used. What did the team find inside the locker? Meanwhile, a watchman gets brutally assaulted by unknown assailants. Could these cases be connected?

episodes.title: Daksh Comes Back - Part 1
episodes.overview: Officers Daksh's almost lifeless body is found in the jungle by Senior Inspector Abhijeet and Daya. Dakhsh's lifelong mission to avenge his brother's death made him cross paths with dangerous people. Daksh who is currently fighting for his life needs ACP and his team to continue his fight. Will the team let Daksh down?

episodes.title: Daksh Comes Back - Part 2
episodes.overview: Ever since their informer's death, the team has been tracking a package from Mongolia which was supposed to arrive along with a guy called Cheena. Will the team be able to crack down on this international nexus? Watch now to find out.

episodes.title: The Faceless Killer - Part 1
episodes.overview: A man dies in a hotel in mysterious ways. There seems to be video footage of the murderer, but with the head cropped out. What's even more intriguing is the fact that the poison-filled sweets went missing even with the camera rolling. Who is this faceless killer? Watch this episode now to find out.

episodes.title: The Faceless Killer - Part 2
episodes.overview: Trying to clear its name off the controversy, our team traces Chandrakants wife and questions her. It's revealed that Chandrakant was an art seller was doing so behind his wife's back. Did she have enough motive to get him killed? Or was she even involved?

episodes.title: The Case Of The Dead Murderer - Part 1
episodes.overview: Dead bodies are found in a hotel and no one has any clue about it. Where did these bodies come from? Watch this episode to find out.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Dead Murderer - Part 2
episodes.overview: Forensic reports reveal poison to be the death of the manager and Vijay. Where did the poison come from?

episodes.title: Abhijeet In Danger - Part 1
episodes.overview: Inspector Abhijeet has been framed for the death of Riya. Abhijeet does not remember anything at all but his gun is found at the site of the crime. Is he guilty?

episodes.title: Abhijeet In Danger - Part 2
episodes.overview: Upon investigation, it is revealed that Riya's blood was stolen from the blood bank and spilt outside Ashok's house. Abhijeet is still struggling to find out his involvement in the case. Watch this episode to know more.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Haunted Building - Part 1
episodes.overview: A couple enters a building but soon the boyfriend runs out screaming. The watchman comes to inquire and is told that the flat in the building was haunted and he has no clue where his partner went missing.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Haunted Building - Part 2
episodes.overview: The CID get to know that the only way to find the killer is to find the secret behind the medicine. They get to the prime distributors' location. Meanwhile, Dr. Salunkhe returns and challenges ACP's theory and analysis.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Unknown Conspiracy - Part 1
episodes.overview: Abhijeet is suspended from CID due to his involvement in the killing. CID investigates the case of a girl who was kidnapped in a godown. Watch this episode to know more.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Unknown Conspiracy - Part 2
episodes.overview: CID interrogates Sushmaya who is at the funeral of her father in law. She is a prime suspect of the death of Kiran and in the meanwhile, forensics reveal that Kiran did not die due to accident. Will CID solve the mystery?

episodes.title: Man On The Bus - Part 1
episodes.overview: A man falls from a running bus and dies. Forensics reveal that his hand was burnt by a cigarette and then he was pushed out of the bus. Meanwhile, a girl is also found dead.

episodes.title: Man On The Bus - Part 2
episodes.overview: CID tries to tie loose ends of the death of the girl and the guy. They interrogate the manager of the restaurant where they had lunch. Will they find anything? Watch this episode to find out.

episodes.title: The Deadly Betrayal - Part 1
episodes.overview: Inspector Daya has been shot after he was investigating at a discotheque. The killer is unknown and looks like a betrayal. Watch this episode to know more.

episodes.title: The Deadly Betrayal - Part 2
episodes.overview: Dr Ranjanika at the forensics finds the fingerprint marks on the bricks that takes the team of CID closer to the killer who has also kidnapped Inspector Daya. Will CID find him? Watch this episode to find out.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Secret In The Ashes - Part 1
episodes.overview: Sentosa Bar gets burned down and CID finds a skeleton at the site. A girl named Reshma goes missing after the fire. Is she involved in the fire? Watch this episode to find out.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Secret In The Ashes - Part 2
episodes.overview: Inspector Aditi is linked to Reshma and the team of CID finds out. Aditi does not let CID investigate Reshma who had run from her house a few years ago. How is Reshma linked? Watch this episode to find out.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Ticket Window - Part 1
episodes.overview: CID are investigating the case of a ticket window where two people die after taking a ticket from the counter. Meanwhile, CID Special Bureau set out to punish the criminals that have been convicted but not yet punished.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Ticket Window - Part 2
episodes.overview: Sudhakar is taken to the hospital due to his critical condition after he smelled a capsule containing poisonous gas. Forensics also reveal that the two victims also died after inhaling the capsule. What does the capsule contain?

episodes.title: The Case Of The Murder In The Interrogation Room - Part 1
episodes.overview: CID is framed for the murder of two businessmen. Forensics reveals CID's involvement in the murder and strict action is taken on CID. Is CID guilty? Watch this episode to find out.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Murder In The Interrogation Room - Part 2
episodes.overview: Inspector Daksh is trying to steal evidence from the forensic lab and Dr Anjalika catches him. Dr Anjalika also reveals about the involvement of the family members in the murder of Dinanath. Will CID catch the real culprit? Watch this episode to find out.

episodes.title: Murders At Sunrise - Part 1
episodes.overview: A TV actor is killed while swimming at the sunrise hotel. Meanwhile, another actor has been killed. The clues lead the team of CID to the security guard who is in a critical condition.

episodes.title: Murders At Sunrise - Part 2
episodes.overview: The security guard has been tied up and CID finds a shoe mark at the site that will lead them to the killer.

episodes.title: The Case Of The One Face Two Men - Part 1
episodes.overview: Tanuj is a multi-millionaire and is found dead. Upon investigation, it is revealed that someone else has disguised himself as Tanuj and taken over the company. Forensics reveal that both the DNA's match.

episodes.title: The Case Of The One Face Two Men - Part 2
episodes.overview: CID is not convinced with the identity of Tanuj and Rupali is also killed. CID is in a fix.

episodes.title: The Final Showdown - Part 1
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman's car is found stranded at a spot. Upon investigation, there is blood found inside it and a girl is dead. ACP is the suspect of the murder. Is he the culprit or has someone framed him?

episodes.title: The Final Showdown - Part 2
episodes.overview: ACP's son Nakul kidnaps him but ACP manages to escape and brings him to the bureau. His son pleads not guilty but ACP does not listen. Who is the real culprit if not Nakul?

episodes.title: The Case Of The 17 Lakh Suspects - Part 1
episodes.overview: A young man is found dead on Bandra flyover. The investigation leads the team of CID to his office where his colleagues reveal that he had gone to an exhibition.

episodes.title: The Case Of The 17 Lakh Suspects - Part 2
episodes.overview: CID suspect that when the motorcycle collided against the auto the knee of the rider got rammed against the headlight with considerable damage and bleeding.

episodes.title: The Case Of Jewel Thief - Part 1
episodes.overview: ACP shot 3 bullets in Nakul causing severe injuries but he again manages to escape. A party takes a dramatic turn when during a game one of the friends gets killed. The parents return just then to find all the jewels in his locker missing.

episodes.title: The Case Of Jewel Thief - Part 2
episodes.overview: There is a terrible twist in the proceedings. The ambulance carrying the two bodies does not reach the forensic department. It is found abandoned on the highway with the ward boys killed.

episodes.title: Murder By Number - Part 1
episodes.overview: A dead body with a number 2 on its forehead is found and CID is called in to investigate. Another dead body turns up with the number 3 on its forehead. Is there anything common in these murders? Episode continues to Bullet .11mm: Part 1 (2005).

episodes.title: Murder By Number - Part 2
episodes.overview: Continuing from Bullet .11mm: Part 2 (2005), RJ Sagarika's murder investigations get a sensational twist when Daksh shoots down Inspector Arjun and is unable to prove his innocence. The killer strikes again and witness no.4 too gets shot and killed.

episodes.title: Double D.N.A. - Part 1
episodes.overview: Within a week there are two identical murders. The body is cut open and then expertly stitched back for no apparent reason as neither the heart, kidneys or liver have been removed from it. What could be the motive?

episodes.title: Double D.N.A. - Part 2
episodes.overview: CID continue to investigate based on 2 clues given by forensics. The stitching up job seems to have been the handiwork of an expert and secondly all of them were brain dead first and its DNA was different from that of the rest of the body.

episodes.title: The Fortune Teller - Part 1
episodes.overview: CID are called for investigating the mysterious deaths of two men. Their respective wives inform them that their death was predicted by a Baba. The Baba is called for interrogation who predicts that one of the cops is going to die soon.

episodes.title: The Fortune Teller - Part 2
episodes.overview: As the investigation continues, Daya gets shot but is able to survive with some injuries. CID later realize that this was the work of the fortune teller who is a fraud but denies anything to do with the murders. Who is behind the murders?

episodes.title: The Case Of Engraved Rice Grains - Part 1
episodes.overview: A man seeks help of someone travelling from Jodhpur to Mumbai, by sending a bag full of rice grains to the office of CID. Once team realizes that these rice grains have a cryptic message on them. This clue leads the team to Jodhpur.

episodes.title: The Case Of Engraved Rice Grains - Part 2
episodes.overview: The team finds out that a group of some outsiders are responsible for the smuggling of Uranium and also the Judge's daughter is involved in the racket. On further investigation, the team then reaches Jaisalmer from Jodhpur.

episodes.title: The Case Of Engraved Rice Grains - Part 3
episodes.overview: In hot pursuit of uranium, CID reach Jodhpur and continue their investigation. A key is retrieved and all they can make out of it is that it has some connection with a haveli in Jaisalmer.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Stolen Ring - Part 1
episodes.overview: Abhijeet informs ACP that Pantella has trusted him with son and lef him in his custody. The kid becomes really close to Abhijeet and is inseparable. Hence Abhijeet had to bring him along to work. Abhijeet is also the head of security and is in charge of a precious diamond ring that is in exhibition. The kid goes with him to see the exhibition and misplaces the ring while playing with his yo-yo. Can the team bring back the original ring? Is the kid involved in the disappearance of the ring?

episodes.title: he Case Of The Stolen Ring - Part 2
episodes.overview: As the investigation continues, the team finds a strange tattooed man in the video chewing a gum. It is later learnt that the ring was stolen with the help of the chewing gum and the kid's yo-yo. The kid then confesses that he was helping those criminals as they had his mother kidnapped and he was faring for her life. Will CID be able to nab the criminals responsible for the theft? Is Pantella involved too?

episodes.title: The Case Of The Killer Lake - Part 1
episodes.overview: Daya is held responsible for a colleague's death in the bureau, while the CID team investigates a taxi driver's death near Mansa lake, where a film unit is shooting. They find dead bodies of girls.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Killer Lake - Part 2
episodes.overview: Abhijeet conducts the hunt of the hero only to find him dead too. Since the death of these girls took place 2 days ago and the film unit had started shooting 5 days ago, CID are convinced that the culprit is someone from the unit.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Staged Murder - Part 1
episodes.overview: The CID investigate a play accident involving an actor who was accidentally stabbed by an actress, discovering that the cause was not a stab, but a different factor.

episodes.title: The Case Of The Staged Murder - Part 2
episodes.overview: The CID are taken aback to know that a lot of people had reasons why they would want the actor dead. They all had various opportunities and means to take the actor's life.

episodes.title: Abhijit Sawant Under Arrest - Part 1
episodes.overview: ACP receives a tip that one of his team members is planning to take on another member. He conducts a search of their houses to avert the eventuality. Later, Abhijeet Sawant, the winner of Indian Idol 1 is charged with the murder a girl.

episodes.title: Abhijit Sawant Under Arrest - Part 2
episodes.overview: CID team learns of other possibilities involved in the girl's murder. The doctor and the girl's father, both are now suspects. Meanwhile, Abhijeet manages to trace Daya's bike with clear signs that he was in an accident.

episodes.title: Code Name Banjara - Part 1
episodes.overview: Abhijeet investigates Daya and Daksh. Two dead bodies turn up one by one, both belonging to a man called Colonel Banjara. Who are these two Colonel Banjaras? What could be the reason behind Daksh's odd behavior?

episodes.title: Code Name Banjara - Part 2
episodes.overview: The CID discover Colonel Banjara's body with 11-digit numbers on his arm, linked to Daksh's account. ACP Pradyuman gets very angry and asks Daksh, who later seen to be meeting a dubious character. Meanwhile, Daya is found with lost speech.

episodes.title: The Case Of Mysterious Truck - Part 1
episodes.overview: On a busy street a lady's bag is found that was smelling of gun powder. Fearing that it could have a bomb,CID team is called for investigation. Later in the office ACP Pradyuman receives a call from Varun requesting if Aditi could have a day off. A key inside the purse that leads them to a truck company. The team successfully nabs the locksmith who made the key and confesses that a woman had paid him to steal the truck. Could this mysterious girl be responsible for the murders.

episodes.title: The Case Of Mysterious Truck - Part 2
episodes.overview: As the investigation continues,it is revealed in the forensics lab that both the murders took place in different places.One of the murders took place in or near a place where painting was done.Just then Aditi asks the team to rush over to Varun's showroom where she found blood stains and a bullet. On interrogating Varun they find that the body that was found in the truck belonged to his partner Anirudh. Could Varun be the one behind thee murders or is there another suspect at large?

episodes.title: Man Eater - Part 1
episodes.overview: Someone is going around kidnapping women from a set of a TV series. The bodies of these women soon turn up, half eaten. With no idea who's behind this atrocity, CID send one of their officers undercover to find out who this man-eater is.

episodes.title: Man Eater - Part 2
episodes.overview: While undercover, Aditi begins searching the set suspecting the cameraman. However, she is shocked to find boxes filled with ice, and the body parts of the missing women, in the director's room, but it's too late as the director finds her.

episodes.title: MAD BOMBER - Part 1
episodes.overview: Subbu calls people imitating celebrities' voices and robs them. Meanwhile, a mad criminal Bandora sends a letter to CID that a bomb will explode every 4 hours if he's not paid 5 crore rupees. Episode continues to Mad Bomber: Part 1 (2005).

episodes.title: MAD BOMBER - Part 2
episodes.overview: Continuing from Mad Bomber: Part 2 (2005), The bombs are now going to go off even if the CID pay the 5 crores, since Bandora won't be able to tell his men to deactivate them. CID begin to search for the bombs, with some help from Subbu.

episodes.title: Anokha Intequam - Part 1
episodes.overview: Abhijeet is accused of destroying evidence from a murder case to save his friend a film star. The case is given to the CID Special Bureau to solve. Is Abhijeet innocent? Episode continues to Anokha Intequam: Part 2 (2005).

episodes.title: Anokha Intequam - Part 6
episodes.overview: Continuing from Anokha Intequam: Part 5 (2005), the Special Bureau's investigation reveals that Rakhi has been hiding at her hairdresser's home and has recently left to go to a coffee house to take money from someone.

episodes.title: Watery Grave - Part 1
episodes.overview: When the monsoon rains cause floods in Mumbai, dozens of bodies of people who have drowned are found by the CID. All the bodies get claimed by kin, except one, a man whose face has been severely facially deformed. A forensic investigation reveals that the body was bludgeoned to death and then thrown into the water with the others. How will CID identify this man and solve his murder? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodes.title: Watery Grave - Part 2
episodes.overview: Forensic investigation of the victim's body reveals that the water inside his lungs is not rainwater, but rather tapwater, likely from a bathroom somewhere. Officers also find a bob in the mans hand, that is commonly used as a clown's nose in a circus. Meanwhile, Inspector Daksh has an accident in the mall, falling down an escalator and becoming uinconscious. When he comes to, he finds that his gun has been stolen. Will CID be able to overcome this and solve the case, and how? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodes.title: The Case Of Dead Waiter - Part 1
episodes.overview: A model is in the middle of a photoshoot at a hotel, when a man falls off a balcony into the hotel swimming pool, dying. CID finds out that the man is Ganpath, a former waiter at the hotel, who was fired after being accused of stealing. On the balcony, officers find the footprints of 2 people, meaning that somebody else was up there with him. How will CID solve this case? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodes.title: The Case Of Dead Waiter - Part 2
episodes.overview: An investigation into Ganpath life reveals that he had recently brought his sister 3 lakh rupees for her wedding, very mysteriously. Meanwhile, the model, Jahnvi is forced to move into a different room when she finds her room ransacked. Could she be in danger as well? How will CID solve this case? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodes.title: 3 Rat Cat 3 - Part 1
episodes.overview: CID are summoned to a house fire, where they find multiple burnt bodies, and a man, whose life they save on the verge of death. They find out that he arrived in India from abroad, just 9 days prior to the incident.

episodes.title: 3 Rat Cat 3 - Part 2
episodes.overview: A strange ring is found. When scanned, CID find that it has an extra coat on it hiding a phrase underneath saying, "3 Rat Cat 3". When Max hears this phrase in the hospital, he immediately dies of shock. What does this phrase mean?

episodes.title: Face Off - Part 1
episodes.overview: Abhijeet and Daya receive a message from the DCP, summoning them to a special location, where they find out that a CID officer is being investigated for a suspected conspiracy. They are shocked to find out he's none other than the ACP.

episodes.title: Face Off - Part 2
episodes.overview: A man is found on the verge of death. He is rushed to the hospital. When asked who did this to him, he points to the ACP. The CID cannot believe that the ACP could possibly be involved in treason and now murder.

episodes.title: Face Off - Part 3
episodes.overview: The ACP shoots at Daksh and flees much to the CID's shock. Daksh, fighting for his life, tells the DIG that his life is in danger because of the ACP. The DIG responds by telling Abhijeet and Daya to kill the ACP in an encounter.

episodes.title: Face Off - Part 4
episodes.overview: Amidst orders from the DIG to kill ACP Pradyuman, Abhijeet finds out that the ACP has left for London. Abhijeet lies to the DIG that the ACP has left for Uganda. Meanwhile, the DIG puts a new ACP Prithviraj, when a new case reaches them.

episodes.title: Trail In London - Part 1
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman is in London searching for a criminal named Degendu to no avail. Meanwhile in Mumbai, Nakul attempts to murder Daksh on his hospital bed but is saved in time. With more proof against him could ACP Pradyuman still be innocent?

episodes.title: Trail In London - Part 2
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman finally finds Degendu, who has now become a simple man leading a life away from crime. He asks him to identify the men in a photograph he found, and although he can't do that, he does identify the café where they are sitting.

episodes.title: Trail In London - Part 3
episodes.overview: Degendu betrays ACP Pradyuman and calls the local police on him. But before they can catch the ACP, he escapes, and manages to find the café from the photograph. Back in Mumbai, ACP Prithviraj attempts to find Nakul.

episodes.title: Murder By Marriage - Part 1
episodes.overview: A groom is shot and killed at a wedding parade. An investigation reveals four guns that were used recently. Who could be behind this tragic murder. Could there be a family grudge in the midst of this wedding?

episodes.title: Murder By Marriage - Part 2
episodes.overview: Further investigation reveals that the gunshot came from the bride's home, not far away, from a gun belonging to the bride's father. The father insists that he hasn't used the gun in many years.

episodes.title: Poison In The Nail - Part 1
episodes.overview: A fight between two women models begins at a fashion show. Things turn sour when one of them collapses and dies. Initial forensic evidence suggests that she was strangled to death. Could the fight really have led to this woman's death?

episodes.title: Poison In The Nail - Part 2
episodes.overview: A twist in the tale develops when it's found through a deeper forensic investigation that Reva, the model, died by ingesting poison. While searching her room, a CD is found containing inappropriate photographs of several women.

episodes.title: Mental Cruelty - Part 1
episodes.overview: A woman named Kalpana publicly screams that her husband wants to kill her. But as her husband arrives, her behavior changed completely, shocking Abhijeet, who is present there. Was she truly crying out for help or just making a scene?

episodes.title: Mental Cruelty - Part 2
episodes.overview: As Abhijeet questions Kalpana's husband, on the other side of Mumbai, a woman finds a man's finger inside her drink. While CID are investigating, Abhijeet gets a call, informing him that Kalpana's husband has been murdered.

episodes.title: Yellow Roses - Part 1
episodes.overview: Rita threatens Peter by saying if he marries anyone else, she would commit suicide. This angers Peter even more and he in return challenges her that he will get married in week.  On the day of the wedding, a mysterious murder happens. Who gets killed? Who killed them? Watch now to find out.

episodes.title: Yellow Roses - Part 2
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman needs to know the mystery of the flower. How come there were two bouquets instead of one? Was it all Peter's plan? He investigates and reaches the florist and takes him in for interrogation. What does the florist tell him that changes the whole angle of investigation? Watch now to find out.

episodes.title: Killer Whistle - Part 1
episodes.overview: A tune playing next to the scene of crime takes the CID to a studio owned by famous musician Baba Sehgal.  It convinces the CID that either Baba or someone from his team is guilty in this case.  But Baba refuses all allegations and Dr.Salunke is called in to solve the case. Watch this special episode featuring Baba Sehgal now.

episodes.title: Killer Whistle - Part 2
episodes.overview: The forensic team needs to match Baba's whistle with the recorded audio to have any sort of case against him. With the case being a double murder now, all eyes are on ACP and his team. What’s the mystery behind this tune? Are more people involved who aren’t coming under the scanner? Watch now to find out.

episodes.title: Return of the Jewel Thief
episodes.overview: Tipu Sultan's ancient jewelry is up for auction, but a famous jewel thief has his eyes on it. A seasoned group of jewel thieves strike overnight and get away with valuables worth crores. It wasn’t long before the thieves got in touch and demanded money in return for the valuables. A deal was set. But our team had other plans. Can our team win this battle of cat and mouse and nab the criminals by the end of it?

episodes.title: Maut Ka Saudagar
episodes.overview: While a serial killer terrorizes the city, a psychic gets in touch with ACP Pradyuman, wishing to predict a death. Meanwhile, Dr. Vinay a practicing doctor with some side interest in a supernatural phenomenon was asked by his colleagues to stay off unscientific research. it is revealed that the doctor has many enemies in his academic circle, Dr. Raj to name the first. But with Dr. Raj’s sudden death and evidence found in his car, all pointed fingers at Dr Vinay.

episodes.title: Letter from the Past
episodes.overview: A woman who was house hunting was warned by her neighbors to not buy the house she liked, as it was ominous according to them. She claimed that the house belonged to a famous model who was pushed off the edge by her photographer boyfriend. Further investigation revealed that the story was only partially true, she did fall off the edge but who was it who pushed her?

episodes.title: Yeh Phool Chaman Mein Kaisa Khila
episodes.overview: A man wakes up next to his dead wife without any recollection of what happened the night before. He faintly remembers having a nightmare about attacking his wife but was certain he did not commit the crime. Did he or did he not? Or was he made to? The only clue seems to be the song 'Yeh Phool Chaman Main Kaise Khila'.

episodes.title: The Case of the Baby Killer
episodes.overview:
A blind, a deaf and a mute man witness a crime in a grocery store. A person wearing a Burkha chases a woman carrying a baby, she gives the baby to the deaf man and escapes. The friend's panic with a baby in hand and call the CID.  What happens when a team of seasoned officers used to the most hardened criminals get custody of a baby? Watch this hilarious episode where ACP Pradyuman and his team get a lesson in babysitting while solving murder mysteries.

hardened criminals get custody of a baby? Watch this hilarious episode where ACP Pradyuman and his team get a lesson in babysitting, while solving murder mysteries.

episodes.title: The Case of the Mysterious Shadow
episodes.overview: A blind woman reaches out to the Cid and informs them about an intruder who visits her room at night and looks for some documents.  She strengthens her claims when she correctly guesses how many people were around her in the office. ACP Pradyuman take it upon himself to go deep into the issue and disguises himself as a blind man and enrolls in the center.

episodes.title: Dynamite
episodes.overview: A truck full of dynamite goes missing and a huge explosion takes part in a different part of the city. A famous builder and his wife go missing after the explosion. With no leads and fingerprints, investigation reaches a halt, but there’s new hope when a palm reader enters the picture and provides information about a person without visible finger prints.  What’s the mystery behind this explosion and person without fingerprints?

episodes.title: Murder at Midnight
episodes.overview: Mumbai wakes up to a shock when a body wrapped in a mattress is found. Forensic analysis reveals that the reason for death was Hypothermia. How can a body be frozen to death in Mumbai weather? Investigation leads to a lab somewhere in Mumbai where something very unethical is taking place.

episodes.title: Murder on 97.1 FM
episodes.overview: Mumbai wakes up to a shock when a body wrapped in a mattress is found. Forensic analysis reveals that the reason for death was Hypothermia. How can a body be frozen to death in Mumbai weather? The investigation leads to a lab somewhere in Mumbai where something very unethical is taking place. Watch now to find out.

episodes.title: Murder in the Safety Vault
episodes.overview: A famous safe making company puts out an ad saying they'd reward anyone who breaks their unbreakable lock.  Thieves from all over the country come to try it out but nobody succeeds. Until a phone call comes and challenges the Owner.  What happens to this unbreakable safe? watch now to find out.

episodes.title: Secret of the Code No. 571E1115
episodes.overview: Spreading exponentially, a deadly virus threatens the city's extinction.  Stolen from the Biological warfare department, this is a race against time for CID to stop the community transmission. Suspected Dr.Vikas is on the run. Where could he be?

episodes.title: Red Rose Killer
episodes.overview: An investigation into Sheetal's murder leads them to a serial killer on the run. The infamous Red Rose killer gets critically injured in the altercation but refuses that he killed Sheetal. He agrees to all his murders but says he wasnt's the one who killed Sheetal. So who was it that killed Sheetal? Only ACP Pradyuman and his team can find out.

episodes.title: CID Undercover
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman goes to help his friend's son on a detective mission. But unfortunately, as soon as he reaches, he gets news about Karan's death. The local police catch ACP Pradyuman at the crime scene in a disguise. All he knows is that the case is about Sam Ex. What's the mystery behind this elaborate plan? Watch now to find out.

episodes.title: The Halloween Murders
episodes.overview: A man is found dead with only a note that said ' aajke baad betaal ped se kabhi nahi utrega'.The CID is called in but they have a clue to work with except for the note that was left behind. What does the note say about the killer's identity? Can a possible match be made with handwriting analysis?

episodes.title: Return of the Dead Child
episodes.overview: A woman starts fighting with another woman in the grocery store claiming that she was the real mother of the child. The husband comes and interrupts her and tellher that she is mistaken and that her child is infact dead. This delusional mother goes even further and takes a drastic step to take custody of that child. What did she do? Watch now to find out.

episodes.title: Body in the Suitcase
episodes.overview: A decapitated body of a young struggling actress is found on the road. CID is called in to investigate the matter. It becomes obvious that the killer did not try to hide the identity of the victim. ACP Pradyuman and his team figured that the victim was last seen with a famous Film Star Kenny Raj in a hotel. Could he have some sort of involvement in this? Watch now to find out.

episodes.title: Monsoon Mystery
episodes.overview: A film crew finds a corpse in a pit while shooting on set. They immediately call the CID to investigate. The body is taken into the forensic lab and Dr. Salunke successfully identifies the victim. A quick search of the database reveals that the woman was reported missing but later found. How is that possible? The mystery deepens. Watch this thrilling episode now.

episodes.title: Suicide Pact
episodes.overview: A mysterious body is found inside a Mumbai BEST bus. CID team is called in to investigate the issue. A quick scan of the area leads themto another corpseon the side the road, CID connect the dots and join these two cases. Forensic analysis confirms that the cases were connected as they both had similar toxic contents in the stomach. Who poisoned these two? Watch now to find out.

episodes.title: Film Piracy Racket
episodes.overview: A film piracy scandal that leads to the death of Akash, someone  who ACP Pradyuman knew on a personal level. Akaash, an ex cop, was supposed to deliver a film print to some distributers in Delhi but goes missing mid way.  It was hard for ACP to believe that it was Akash who was involved in the leak. If not, then who was it? Why was Akash killed in the process?

episodes.title: The Mysterious Mr. Arvind
episodes.overview: A student accuses her teacher of having involvement in one of her friend's disappearances. He outright denied all the allegations, but when CID arrives at the location and search his closet, they find Kavita's suitcase inside.  The teacher has a feeling that he is being framed, but the evidences against him are too concrete.  What's the mystery behind Kavita's disappearance? Watch now to find out.

episodes.title: Killer in the Jungle
episodes.overview: A man-eating panther has been terrorising the area. Few environmentalists and students find a victim in the jungle. CID is called in to investigate, but for some odd reason, ACP has a gut feeling that the murders were not committed by an animal.  A fish eye from the victim's stomach is retrieved.
