episodes.overview: As a couple is jogging in a park, they witness a man with a javelin pierced through his chest. Before he can tell them anything about the attack, he collapses and dies. CID arrives and starts its investigation that leads them to a sports club nearby. Who killed him?

episodes.title: Case Lift Murder Ka
episodes.overview: A lift in a building gets stuck. The maintenance man is called and a dead body is found stuck between the lift ropes. The team of CID is called in to investigate the matter? Will they find out the killer?

episodes.title: Bomb Ka Khel
episodes.overview: An abandoned suitcase is found in a house. As panic ensues, the bomb squad is called in to scan the suitcase that was nothing but a hoax with a threat note of a real bomb. Will CID find the owner of the bag before he can do anything dangerous.

episodes.title: Kissa Aadhi Laash Ka
episodes.overview: A dead body is found on a deserted beach. CID arrives in to investigate and discovers that its only half the body. They must find the second half to solve the mystery.

episodes.title: Kissa Khali Kabar Ka
episodes.overview: A woman informs the CID about another woman's death. The investigation leads them to her husband as a prime suspect of the murder but upon revelation, the team of CID is in a fix.

episodes.title: Talwar Ka Rahasya
episodes.overview: The accidental death of a man during a fight leads the team of CID to discover another body buried in the ground with a knife popping out of it. Whose body is it?

episodes.title: Once Upon A Time in Mumbaai
episodes.overview: In this special episode of CID Imran and Prachi are being threatened by a crazy fan. The cops are on the lookout for this man. Watch this episode to find out who is the fan and what does he want.

episodes.title: Kabarawali Ladki
episodes.overview: A woman's body is found in an ancient coffin and upon investigating they realise that she is still alive. The woman has been hit on the head and suffers from partial amnesia. CID tracks down the clues to reach the killer.

episodes.title: Mumbai Darshan Murders
episodes.overview: A woman is killed while travelling on a Mumbai darshan bus. The team of CID is in a turmoil as who could have killed her in a running bus amidst so many people? Watch the team of CID unravel the mystery in this episode.

episodes.title: Rahasya Paanch Kankaalon Ka
episodes.overview: A windowsill of a house breaks down that contains five human skeletons. The team of CID is called in to investigate the matter and their findings lead them to something unexpectable. Watch this episode to find out about the five skeletons.

episodes.title: Desh Drohiyon Ke Virrudh CID
episodes.overview: The team of CID is in the capital to solve a murder mystery that leads them to unfold a big fake currency racket. Upon further investigation, it is found out that there is something more to it.

episodes.title: Kissa Kuwe Ki Laash Ka
episodes.overview: A girl named Alisha was reported missing and is found dead in a well with her body brutally cut. A strand of hair and perfume leads the team of CID to the murder suspects of Alisha and also reveals a missing bag of money. Who killed Alisha?

episodes.title: Hire Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: Owner of Travis Security Agency, Shekhar has a project to transfer diamonds worth millions to the USA but before he could do that, the diamonds get stolen. CID arrives at the scene and gets a call from the hospital where Shekhar is lying dead. Who killed Shekhar? Who stole the diamonds?

episodes.title: Kissa Aadamkhor Aadmi Ka
episodes.overview: A human flesh-eating man is caught by the CID for the murder of a girl. But when the cops investigate his hideout, they find skeletons of many bodies and someone has been providing him with the dead bodies. Who can it be?

episodes.title: Kissa Gumnaam Bacche Ka
episodes.overview: A woman is taking her child for a morning walk. After a while, the child is found abandoned and the woman is found dead. What looks to be a case of suicide at first is actually a neatly planned murder. Watch CID unravel the case in this episode.

episodes.title: Khooni Lootere Ka Rahasya
episodes.overview: A bank robbery goes wrong when the manager and an unknown man are found dead. But when CID investigate they find a shocking clue in the dead anonymous man. What can the clue be?

episodes.title: Dowry Death
episodes.overview: The team of CID is approached by the parents of a girl named Trupti. They inform them that Trupti had been missing for the last two days and that both her in-laws and her husband had no knowledge about it either. Upon further investigation, the team finds a burnt dead body of a woman and they are convinced that it is Trupti's, but Dr.Salunke informs them that the body belongs to another woman. Who could this woman be?

episodes.title: Coffin Rakshak Ka Rahasya
episodes.overview: When a group of property dealers decide to sell an old abandoned inn they are suddenly shot dead by mysterious assailants. One property dealer manages to survive the shooting and he calls CID for help. When they were searching the inn, the team finds an empty coffin and on further investigation, it is found that the coffin had a dead body in it which now missing. Will the team be able to catch the shooters and find out about the missing dead body?

episodes.title: Netraheen Gavah
episodes.overview: The team of CID is called to investigate the murder of a man who was found in the compound of a building. As the team starts enquiring about the dead body they come across a blind woman who claims to be there at the time of the murder. Will the cops be able to catch the killer before he strikes again?

episodes.title: Kissa Daya Aur Nanhe Detectives Ka
episodes.overview: A group of children are playing outside their colony at night and they decide to enter an abandoned house, just then they witness a man killing someone. They tell Daya about the incident, but when he searches the abandoned house he finds nothing suspicious. The next day, one of the kids and his mother goes missing. Could their disappearance be related to the murder that the kids witnessed or could it be a prank they are playing on CID?

episodes.title: Bhutiya Ladki Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: A girl called Kashish believes she saw a ghost, a girl who is begging her to find her murderer. She approaches the CID team and tells them about the ghost. On investigating they find out that the ghost Kashish saw was actually a girl who has been missing for a year and her dead body was found in Kashish's house. The team is now puzzled, is there really a ghost and is Kashish telling them the whole truth?

episodes.title: Aakhri Chunauti - Part 1
episodes.overview: CID team finds the body of a man who had been murdered. Next to his body, they find a CD that has footage of Sonali being kidnapped. When they start looking for clues they find a connection between Sonali's kidnapping and the murder of this mysterious man and a strange mystery of CID forensic doctors being kidnapped. Binge-watch as they introduce the new villain targetting the team of CID.

episodes.title: Aakhri Chunauti - Part 2
episodes.overview: While CID are searching for Sonali and Tarika, Abhijit and Tasha almost get killed when they are locked up in a room with poisonous gas. They find a camera roll which reveals Salunke's pics and now the cops suspect that Salunke might be the next target. Meanwhile, a woman is found dead and her husband is seriously injured. Cops need to find out who killed the woman and come across some shocking evidence that points to the most unexpected person.

episodes.title: Aakhri Chunauti - Part 3
episodes.overview: A father has been grieving for years thinking that his daughter who had been missing is now dead. Suddenly one day he receives her picture and realises that she was not killed but kidnapped. But why is the kidnapper trying to psyche him out with the picture of his missing daughter? While investigating the case Kajal gets a call that her brother is seriously injured and has been kidnapped. Will CID solve the case?

episodes.title: Aakhri Chunauti - Part 4
episodes.overview: A few days after a visit to his dentist a man dies mysteriously. Salunke finds out that he was poisoned. But how did the poison get there? Meanwhile, when Kaajal does not return from her house the cops realize something is seriously wrong. Freddy and Vivek go to check up on her. Someone catches Freddy and drags him away before Vivek can help him. Watch this episode full of twists and turns.

episodes.title: Aakhri Chunauti - Part 5
episodes.overview: The burnt corpse that the cops were fearing was Freddy, turns out to be a false alarm. CID understands that Freddy is alive and that he has been kidnapped like the other team members. Vivek is very disturbed by Freddy's abduction and takes it as a personal failure. CID team follows the trail of the burnt dead body to reach the supervillain while Vivek, in a bid to nab the supervillain on his own and erase the guilt, walks straight into the supervillain's trap.

episodes.title: Aakhri Chunauti - Part 6
episodes.overview: Daya escapes a bomb blast in a tunnel. CID is called to investigate the mysterious death of a woman. What looked like a case of accidental poisoning takes a surprising twist as CID finds that the victim in question was living under two separate identities, Naina and Devika. The cops try to solve the case while also looking for the mastermind criminal HD who has proved to be notoriously well informed about CID's every move. Will they catch him?

episodes.title: Aakhri Chunauti - Part 7
episodes.overview: The CID team finds Dr. Salunkhe's car on the road, but they notice that Dr. Salunkhe is missing. They suspect that the same mastermind who kidnapped the team previously has abducted Dr. Salunkhe. So, the CID team splits in two teams in order to rescue him. Will CID find Dr. Salunkhe?

episodes.title: Aakhri Chunauti - Part 8
episodes.overview: The Mastermind successfully traps ACP, Abhijit and Daya into his web. He holds them captive and injects them with something that causes all three of them to lose their memories. The confusion among the CID officers further increases when they find themselves in a forest with no memory of each other. How will they get out of the forest?

episodes.title: Aakhri Chunauti – CID V/S HD in Paris
episodes.overview: HD traps the CID team in a cottage and blasts it and escapes to Paris. The CID team manage to escape and also find the identity of HD ( Herpes Dangaroo ). They follow him to Paris and continue their investigation. The cops keep track of suspicious people in the loop who have been working for HD. There are bags of money being passed around and cops now realise that HD is planning something big to harm India.

episodes.title: Lady in Red
episodes.overview: A couple, Ishaan and Prishita hosts a party in their house and Ishaan's cousin brother gets jealous and angry as Ishaan got all the money and a huge house where as he did not. While they are arguing in front of their guests, Prishita goes inside the house and later her scream is heard, they find a note telling them that Prishita has been kidnapped. Who kidnapped Prishita?

episodes.title: Subway Murder
episodes.overview: A janitor in Andheri station finds a dead and informs CID of the same. When the team reaches there, they find out his name, Ranjan and also manages to locate a CCTV camera pointing the crime scene. While watching the recording they come to know that he was murdered but the murdere's face was not visible. They also saw that a man witnessed his murder but got scared and ran away. Will CID be able to find that witness? Will they be able to nab the murderer?

episodes.title: Zindagi Aur Maut Ka Khel
episodes.overview: Sangraam, a wrestler rushes back home to find his wife burned to death. CID reaches his house and starts their investigation, they come to know his servant is missing, just then Sangraam gets a call from Jaggu asking him to save her. On further investigation it is revealed that the dead body was not of Sangraam's wife. What happed to Sangraam's wife? Whose dead body was burned in their house?

episodes.title: Khooni Bhavishyavani
episodes.overview: CID reaches a mall where a man was found dead. The owner of the mall informs ACP Pradyuman that he whispered something in his ear before he died. Upon being asked he tells the team that the man said he is going to kill someone tonight at 11 P.M. How can one person who is already dead kill someone else? If he was going to kill someone who killed him?

episodes.title: CID Ki Jung Baal Mazdoori Ke Sang
episodes.overview: Three kids can be seen running away from their captor. Next day CID team is called to a hospital, where the doctor informs them about those same kids that they were brutally beaten up and left to die but a man brought them to the hospital in time. The man tells them about the place he found them. The team starts searching that place for clues but instead they find a dead body. Who were these kids running from? Whose dead body did the CID find?

episodes.title: Khoon Ka Rishta
episodes.overview: Some kids are seen playing in their locality late in the evening, just then they hear a scream from a balcony of a house and they decide to go check the place. They see a man, Abhimanyu holding a knife over his sister's dead body. Upon being startled by the kids he gets scared and runs away. When CID reaches the crime scene, they are informed that both brother and sister were not in good terms. Did Abhimanyu really killed his sister? Or is he being framed?

episodes.title: Kissa Nakli Notes Ka
episodes.overview: A woman is seen running scared in a jungle from someone, she reaches the end of the jungle but gets killed in an accident by a truck. Meanwhile Inspeactor Tasha is caught with fake notes while shopping.How did Tasha get all that fake money? Who was the woman running in the jungle? Who wanted to kill her and why?

episodes.title: Asylum Murder
episodes.overview: In a prison cell, one of the prisoners killed another one and escaped from the prison. CID reaches there to start their investigation and they find out that the prisoner must have escaped disguising as a prison guard. He must have stolen rhe uniform or one of the guards helped him escape. Who helped him escape? Is there a more bigger crime about to happen?

episodes.title: Rahasyamay Qatil
episodes.overview: A couple Devyani and Veer are on their way to collect some money from Veer's friend, Prabhaat. His servant informs them that Prabhaat was in a bad mood and he should not be disturbed. When he comes out he can be seen irritated with his friends and tells his servant to give them their money, later Prabhaat is found dead by them. CID investigates and finds that there are no wounds on him and door and windows were completely shut. How was he murdered?

episodes.title: Do Qatil Ki Paheli
episodes.overview: Two guards come across a dead body of an old man and CID is called to investigate. Just then Abhijeet gets a call informing him about another murder that happened in other part of the city in a parking lot. Both the dead bodies are sent to Dr. Salunke and he informs them that they were both murdered by two different people with different techniques. Why would someone want to kill an old man? Even with two different killers could the case be connected?

episodes.title: Raaz Anjaan Biwi Ka
episodes.overview: Daya is on a date with his girlfriend and he proposes to her, instead of being happy she can be seen worried and want to tell something to Daya, but he has to rush to work for a new case. A young woman gets injured in a car accident and loses her memory, all information in her documents states that she is married to a man called Vishal but he refuses to believe that. He informs them that her wife died a month agoand this woman is an imposter. Who is lying?

episodes.title: Daya Ki Dulhan Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: The CID team is shocked to find out that Daya is going to get married to a girl with ties to the criminal underworld. They collect proof of her guilt decide to confront him at his engagement ceremony. But Daya responds with anger, telling them to leave if they cannot be happy for him. But soon, a man who was going to give a testimony against the girl’s uncle is found dead- and all the signs point to the girl’s family. Will the team have to ruin Daya’s celebration?

episodes.title: Abhijeet in Jail
episodes.overview: A man’s bag, containing a diamond worth 3 crore rupees, is stolen from a train platform and CID are called to investigate. CID catch the robber but find that he has been poisoned and is dying. But to their shock- on his deathbed, the robber confesses that he knew nothing about the diamond. He was paid by someone else to rob the bag. Someone knew that there was an expensive diamond in that bag and poisoned the thief in prison to keep his mouth shut.

episodes.title: Khatre Mein Tasha
episodes.overview: Yogesh, an experienced paraglider, is out at a paragliding site with his girlfriend. He decides to show off his skills a little in front of her, but she tries to encourage him not to, afraid of an accident happening. He dismisses her cries and tells her it’ll be okay, even going to the extent of double checking and replacing his parachute to make sure. But when he reaches the base of the summit, he is found dead. Did he die by accident or is there more to the story?

episodes.title: Kissa Double Murder Ka
episodes.overview: A woman wakes up at night to find blood on her husband’s shirt. She screams, assuming he is dead, only for him to wake up annoyed. But when he notices the blood on his shirt, he too panics. Soon, they realise that blood is dripping down from their ceiling. The go the flat above theirs with their neighbours to find the couple who live there shot dead. Why were they killed, and by whom? Watch as CID solve the crime and catch the culprit.

episodes.title: Raaz Khoon Peene Wale Qatil Ka
episodes.overview: A man wakes up to find, to his shock, his mouth and teeth covered in blood, with no memory of the last night. On the other side of the city, CID is finds a body that looks like it has been attacked by a wild animal. The man hears about this killing, and afraid that he might be the culprit, ties himself in his room before falling asleep. But he wakes up to find the ropes torn and the news of another killing. CID are on his trail. But is he innocent or guilty? Watch as CID solve the case.

episodes.title: 150 Saal Purana Khoon
episodes.overview: The biology lab of a college has organized the arrival of new equipment and specimens. But all hell breaks loose when one skeleton in a set of replicas turns out to be a real one, belonging to a man who has been murdered recently and had skin and flesh melted off with an acid. CID begin their investigation, leading them to a network of fake antiques that the man was reportedly involved with. Was this the reason for his death? Watch as CID solve the case.

episodes.title: Raaz Beech Restaurant Mein Khoon Ka
episodes.overview: Deepak and his wife Kavita are having soup in a restaurant, when Deepak suddenly begins choking and dies. As CID begin investigating, Kavita also collapses and dies. Dr. Salunkhe reveals that they were both poisoned through the soup.

episodes.title: Abhijeet Ke Ateet Ka Raaz - Part 1
episodes.overview: The CID find an unknown dead body one in a train and another at the railway station. Both the bodies are in the age group of 16-20, and all looked like beggars. Forensic analysis reveals that their kidneys had been removed.

episodes.title: Abhijeet Ke Ateet Ka Raaz - Part 2
episodes.overview: A rich family is hosting an engagement of their youngest daughter, but their mansion is said to be cursed, that any happy occasion results in suicides in the family. Soon, their fears are proven true when one of them jumps to her death.

episodes.title: Abhijeet Ke Ateet Ka Raaz - Part 3
episodes.overview: Someone calls CID reporting a murder in a flat. CID finds out that a murder has indeed taken place, with playing cards having been dealt in front of the body for 4 people. But forensic analysis reveals only 2 sets of fingerprints.

episodes.title: Abhijeet Ke Ateet Ka Raaz - Part 4
episodes.overview: A young man attacks a group of youngsters on a beach and kills himself. Then, a labourer is pushed off a building to his death. The common thread in these cases is that the perpetrators were both gentle people who suddenly became violent.

episodes.title: Abhijeet Ke Ateet Ka Raaz - Part 5
episodes.overview: The head of a rich industrialist family is found murdered at a camp where he was celebrating his 70th birthday. Around his dead body, there is a symbol drawn in blood of a V with two dots.

episodes.title: Abhijeet Ke Ateet Ka Raaz - Part 6
episodes.overview: A man is found dead, frozen in the ice at an ice-manufacturing factory. Neither the factory workers nor the manager do not recognize the body, even though they were the only ones with access to the factory. Who is this man?

episodes.title: Abhijeet Ke Ateet Ka Raaz - Part 7
episodes.overview: While returning with Maya from a hotel, Abhijeet finds a dead body in his car.

episodes.title: Abhijeet Ke Ateet Ka Raaz - Part 8
episodes.overview: After an argument ensues between a referee and a player during a tennis match, both players suddenly collapse one after the other. The security guards realize that they're being targeted by a sniper on the terrace of a nearby building.

episodes.title: Abhijeet Ke Ateet Ka Raaz - Part 9
episodes.overview: Abhijeet arrives with Amit and Maya. They hold the station hostage and he demands that CID free 2 criminals who have to be hanged. The CID are curious about Maya, and their investigation reveals she's playing with Abhijeet's mind.

episodes.title: Abhijeet Ke Ateet Ka Raaz - Part 10
episodes.overview: Abhijeet is in a maddened state seeming he will kill Daya, before Maya intervenes and takes him away. The ACP wakes up and reveals to CID that he was shot by a fake bullet. CID realize that Abhijeet is still with them.

episodes.title: Khooni Raaste Ka Rahasya
episodes.overview: There is an empty and deserted road which is a shortcut to the highway where accidents and murders happen in the night at a particular hour and a particular spot. And the accidents are definite.

episodes.title: Kissa Mrit Khooni Ka
episodes.overview: A girl's dead body is found in a park cut in pieces. Autopsy reveals that she was tied, tortured and then strangled to death. Eventually, a fingerprint is found on the nail that matches with a man who died 10 years ago.

episodes.title: Case Hanging Bodies Ka
episodes.overview: Anuj enters Kiran's house and to their shock tells that he cannot marry her as he has got married to someone else. The next day, Kiran, her father, her mother, and her sister are all found hanging from a tree.

episodes.title: Raaz Khooni Painting Ka
episodes.overview: Abhinav buys a painting from a poor artist of a beautiful young woman who the artist claims was his wife, who passed away. He brings the painting home and hangs it in his living room. Weird things start happening with him later on.

episodes.title: Rahasya Qatil Padosi Ka
episodes.overview: Sameer keeps on hearing the fights between Ravi and Jaya who live next door. He gathers everyone and rushes to save Jaya but she is alright. One day Jaya is found dead with Sameer unconscious in the flat.

episodes.title: Blackmail Murder
episodes.overview: Vishakha is celebrating Valentine's Day with her fiancée Rishabh. While boarding a bus she finds a gun and a cellphone. It rings and the caller tells her that she has to kill someone today, else her family will be killed who are kidnapped.

episodes.title: Bhagdad Mein Maut Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: The CID receive a tip about a most wanted criminal being spotted. They plan to capture him, but he gets alerted and creates a chaos by firing his gun in the hall, causing a stampede where a man dies.

episodes.title: Maut Ki Bhavishyavani
episodes.overview: A doctor is shocked to find his own obituary. Soon, he dies exactly as mentioned in the obituary. The same thing happens with an industrialist who receives a phone call mourning his death. The industrialist dies the exact death as heard.

episodes.title: Insaaf Ka Khel
episodes.overview: A judge who happens to be ACP Pradyuman’s childhood friend, gets the shock of his life when he comes to know about his grandson’s kidnapping. The kidnappers want a judgment in their favour in return for the grandson. The judge refuses to comply but has very little time save his grandson. Will he crack and do what the criminals say in an attempt to save his grandson?

episodes.title: Waqt Ki Paheli
episodes.overview: A girl calls the cops saying she is in danger. When they reach the flat, she seemed to be missing. Later the body is found on the terrace. There is an eyewitness who says he saw her being strangled at 11 pm, but forensics claims that she died at 8pm. How is that possible?

episodes.title: Rahasya Machhli Ka
episodes.overview: With the help of an informant, the CID catches a man with a really expensive revolver hidden in a fish. The man refuses to know anything about this imported revolver, but the CID keep grilling him hoping he gives out something. How did the informer know about this deal?

episodes.title: Raaz Room Se Gayab Jode Ka
episodes.overview: A husband who is spying on his wife, sets up a meeting between his wife and her lover. He places CCTV cameras inside the hotel room and keeps an eye on them. He goes into confront his wife but to his surprise the hotel room was empty. He couldn't believe the fact that his wife and her lover could have gone missing even after keeping an eye on them through his CCTV cameras. Where did his wife go?

episodes.title: Magic Cannon Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: etaal the famous magician is performing for a packed hall. The audience is waiting for his special act where he fires himself from a cannon. The cannon is fired into the air and after a couple of seconds Vetaal appears from one corner of the auditorium, intact and unhurt. This time after the cannon fires, Vetaal doesn’t appear. The audience and his assistants keep on waiting but Veetal is nowhere to be seen. His wife panics, assuming that something has gone wrong. Where did Veetal go?

episodes.title: Khoon Ki Kitaab
episodes.overview: A writer is horrified when 3 murders take place in the city, which are identical to those he has written about in his book. What could be the mystery behind these strange occurrences? These self-fulfilling prophecies

episodes.title: Pune Mein Aatank Ka Khatra
episodes.overview: With an experimental device, the CID catches a man with traces of RDX on him. The amount was miniscule, so he was let off. But when asked how he thinks he got particles of RDX on him, he reveals what had happened to him in the railway station. What does the man tell CID?

episodes.title: Khoon Ka Suraag.. Ek Tattoo
episodes.overview: A dead body found with a half-torn ticket from her pocket, a ticket to a museum. Cops go out and they find the photographer who was clicking the photos of the visitors. Cops take a chance and check the photos and see that the same girl standing with a unknown person. A man with a tattoo on his hand. And the chase for the tattooed individual begins.

episodes.title: Khoon Ka Raaz Ellora Caves Mein
episodes.overview: CID receives a mysterious call from an unknown number from Aurangabad, Investigations leads them to a paper factory. One of the workers at the paper factory tries evading the CID. What does he know that he ran straight away?

episodes.title: Lapata Ladki Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: CID’s adventures in Aurangabad don’t stop there. A murder beside a road gets CID attention. Investigation leads them to Bibi ka makbara, a historical site in Aurangabad. Can the CID once and for all solve all issues in Aurangabad? ACP and his team are ready for action.

episodes.title: Kolhapur Mein Serial Killer
episodes.overview: Multiple people across the city are found dead in a mysterious way. To a naked eye, they look natural deaths, heart attacks. But the similarity in these cases and the timing tied these deaths together? Was someone orchestrating all this?

episodes.title: Kolhapur Ke Palace Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: A death at a heritage hotel shocks everyone. A group of friends witness a murder that has some sort of supernatural element to it. Not sure if the cause of death was because of a human being or because of something beyond our perception. The CID is called in to investigate this spooky encounter.

episodes.title: Neend Mein Khoon
episodes.overview: A mystery involving a woman who wakes up with a bloodstained knife next to her in the jungle. She claims to not remember what happened or who she had hurt. The investigating CID team does a thorough search of the area but there is nobody. What could explain such a phenomenon?

episodes.title: Khooni Jaal
episodes.overview: A drunken man stumbles upon a dead body at the beach. While the Police were trying to retrieve the body, 4 more washed up. Did they all know each other? Did they share a common death?

episodes.title: Raaz Gayab Laash Ki
episodes.overview: Nitin and Tanu throw a horror themed party at a farmhouse. Everyone in their costumes play games and try to scare each other. There seems to be a secret rumored haunted room. Whoever goes in, never comes out. And so it happens, someone goes in and doesn’t come back. This freaks all the guests out and CID is called in. Is that person playing a prank or did something unholy happen?

episodes.title: Zinda Shikaar
episodes.overview: A regular day turns ominous when a girl with a spike going through her head rushes to the mall. Civilians around the area, call for medical emergency. The girl was lucky the spike had missed all major organs, and she was alive. ACP Pradyuman and his team are called in to investigate this strange phenomenon.

episodes.title: CID Dhoom – Bus Hijack
episodes.overview: A bus with 15 passengers is cruising through traffic, crushing everything coming its way. People call the CID and they try to stop the bus. But a call from a random number asks them to not interfere or else they’d detonate the bomb in the bus. How does CID deal with this tricky situation?

episodes.title: CID Dhoom – Aag Ka Paani
episodes.overview: A reputed college is having their annual festival, which includes a rain dance. Everyone is having fun and enjoying until a fire breaks out in the rain dance, injuring and burning students to death. The CID team is called as the fire is not natural and has been set up. The cops get on the case and they realize that there is a psychotic arsenist on the loose who wants to cause havoc by setting the city on fire. What’s really happening here?

episodes.title: CID Dhoom – Bike Robbers
episodes.overview: Money truck gets robbed by some bikers. Their incredible stunts convince CID that they were professionals. Soon after there is another heist. They investigate into the matter and reach the stunt school where most city bikers go to. Riders there, all seem to have alibis and suggest it could be Payal’s stunt school, that’s behind all this

episodes.title: CID Dhoom – Raaz Blue Print Ka
episodes.overview: Two construction workers eve drop on some goons threatening a scientist. Their panic reveals their location and the goons open fire on them, killing one in the process. The goons wanted some sort of a blueprint which the scientist refused to know about. Meanwhile, the scientist’s daughter informs CID and they decide to look deeper into case. What blueprint were they talking about?

episodes.title: CID Dhoom – Under Water Action
episodes.overview: A group of boys gone for scuba diving, find a dead body of a scuba diver. CID investigates and traces his identity by the serial number on the oxygen cylinder. The deceased was a famous scuba trainer, Dharam, and his death showed lack of oxygen as the reason but the cylinder was almost full so it was a case of murder. The weeds on his cloths indicate that he has been death for some time. What could be the mystery behind this mysterious death?

episodes.title: CID Dhoom – Finale Ka Akhri Takkar (The Grand Finale)
episodes.overview: A big auction of ancient jewelry. The jewels were kept in a well-guarded high-security vault and set with invisible laser rays to protect them from theft. However, the night before the auction, two thieves break into the vault room and steal the jewels. All hell breaks loose as it was impossible for a theft to be committed there considering the security. CID gets on the case.

episodes.title: Ekta Special MMS Qatl
episodes.overview: Big News creates a sensation in the city. A serial killer is making celebrities his targets. That too on live-television. Why? No one knows. No clue, no marks left on the crime scene. This time his target is Ekta Kapoor, the famous television Producer, who had plans of coming on the show to talk about her upcoming Movie ‘RAGINI MMS’. Cops are on alert and make a plan to catch this serial killer. Will they be successful?

episodes.title: Shootout at a Park
episodes.overview: Rahul, who is jogging in the park with his friend, collapses while exercising and dies. CID comes in and is stunned to see that he was shot, but there seems to be no one who heard the gunshot or saw the assailant. They investigate and figure out the gunshot angle. They realize that he had been shot from a height. What’s the mystery behind this death?

episodes.title: Khatre Mein CID
episodes.overview: A man decides to take revenge on ACP Pradyuman. Son of a scientist who had committed suicide, has some old scores to settle with the ACP. What really happened between ACP and the scientist that his son is out for blood? What was the scientist working on that the ACP did not approve?

episodes.title: Raaz Kankaal Ka
episodes.overview: Ayesha and Shaurya receive a house in inheritance from a distant relative whom they are not so familiar with. When they enter the house, Ayesha seems to have been here in the house before and discovers bones in the house. Shaurya informs CID and the investigation begins. Whose bones are they?

episodes.title: Gayab Goli
episodes.overview: A wealthy businessman Dhanraj was on his way to put his diamonds in a safe but before he could do that, the diamonds are stolen and he is shot dead in the parking lot. CID is informed and upon investigation, they find out that Dhanraj never told anyone about the diamonds. Then how did the robbers know?

episodes.title: Katte Pairo Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: A girl and her boyfriend find a shoe with the feet cut and soaked in blood. CID is called in to investigate and the forensics reveal that the foot has been lying there from the past 3 days. Is it a case of serial killing?

episodes.title: Khoon Ki Bansuri
episodes.overview: A newly made bridge is made on the highway and is the recipient of the sound of a flute and whoever listens to the flute, he/she is never found again. CID investigates the matter and the clues lead them to various skeletons. Watch this episode to find out about the mystery of the flute.

episodes.title: Raaz Necklace Message Ka
episodes.overview: Seven people arrive at an isolated spot as they receive an SMS from the same number. Meanwhile, a professor is killed in the washroom of an airport when he is about to leave the country. Are the seven people linked to the professor?

episodes.title: CID Aur Nanhe Detectives
episodes.overview: Kids and teachers in a school become hostage to terrorists but somehow manage to call CID for help. Will CID save the kids and teachers?

episodes.title: Raaz Wristband Killer Ka
episodes.overview: Three kids spot a girl in danger and call CID for help. Upon interrogation, it is found that the girl was missing and they also find the dead body of Akhil. Who killed Akhil? Is Akhil linked to the girl?

episodes.title: Bhootiya Khooni
episodes.overview: Nihaal and family are out to spend a weekend to a mansion but their car breaks down in the middle of the road. Nihaal's sister hears a whispering sound but Nihaal doesn't pay attention. The next morning she is found dead. Who killed her?

episodes.title: Raaz Khooni Ke Khoon Ka
episodes.overview: Abhijeet and Daya are undercover to catch a culprit named Babu who is involved in a drug-smuggling racket. They chase him but before they can catch him, he is shot dead leaving a clue of a plain paper. Who shot him and why?

episodes.title: Dhobi Ghat Mein Khoon
episodes.overview: Jiya is about to get married. Hell breaks loose when an unknown dress comes back from the laundry that doesn't belong to Jiya and upon finding out, it's revealed that the worker who dyed the dress is murdered. Who killed him and why?

episodes.title: Victoria Mein Laash
episodes.overview: Three youngsters find a dead body lying at Marine drive. The cut marks on the body match with three other deaths in a month. What seems to be a case of serial killing of beggars has changed its modus operandi to killing a rich girl.

episodes.title: Rahasya Qatil Kidnapper Ka
episodes.overview: Shobhit is walking on a lonely road with a suitcase and gets into a fight with two men and ends up killing one of them. CID comes to arrest him but he reveals that his son has been kidnapped and is later found dead in their own house.

episodes.title: Raaz Khooni Chetawni Ka
episodes.overview: Manu's servant is killed in his house. Upon interrogating Manu, he reveals that he was asleep when someone sneaked into the house and killed him leaving a threat message to kill Manu. CID suspects his stepbrother and wife.

episodes.title: Qatl Ka Raaz Mare Hue Qatil Ke Paas
episodes.overview: Gayatri, a widow hears a whistle in a mall and follows it but goes into a shock after seeing the man. Later, a thief enters her room, and she shoots him. CID follow the blood trail only to find his dead body a couple of meters away.

episodes.title: CID Maut Ke Kagaar Par
episodes.overview: CID are waiting for their informant and as soon as he arrives, he dies after coming in contact with lightning. Upon investigation, it is found out that the informant was killed deliberately. Who could have killed him?

episodes.title: AC Duct Mein Laash
episodes.overview: A strong stench smell is noticed in Kashyap's office, but the source is nowhere to be found. Upon searching, they find Kashyap's dead body in the AC duct. CID are informed.

episodes.title: Khoon Ki DVD
episodes.overview: While watching a horror movie, Sid and Tanya see a real footage of a girl being shot dead. The girl is Tanya's sister Meenakshi, who had gone missing a few years ago. CID are informed about this and they find a skeleton at the murder site.

episodes.title: Peephole Murder
episodes.overview: On the night of Ritwik's birthday party, Maya sees Ritwik in an argument with a girl. Later in the night, she sees Ritwik being killed, but later Ritwik is found alive. Who has died if not Ritwik?

episodes.title: Stuntman Murder
episodes.overview: During a karate rehearsal, a man starts fighting with Sameer. Later, a man's body is burning and Sameer is found dead. Why did the two get into a fight? How did Sameer die?

episodes.title: Raaz Qatil Hatyar Ka
episodes.overview: Real estate agent Nitin is found dead in the house he has come to deal for. CID are informed. Nitin was killed in a very strange manner where a part of his flesh is lying near his dead body. Who killed Nitin so brutally and why?

episodes.title: Kissa Paagal Ashiq Ka
episodes.overview: Famous actress Pia is kidnapped, and all eyes are on the cameraman Devesh who had a fight with her. Before CID could catch Devesh, he runs into a makeshift lift that crashes down and kills him along with an unconscious girl. Where is Pia?

episodes.title: Paagal Aashiq
episodes.overview: During Payal's farewell party, her friend Karan is worried. He sees Payal crying while talking to Manish and gets furious on Manish. Next day Payal is found dead in Karan's car and Karan says that he is innocent. Who killed Payal?

episodes.title: Kissa X-Ray Suraag Ka
episodes.overview: A radiology staff is stabbed to death during a false fire alarm in a hospital. He was attending an old man who is now missing. The clues lead the CID to the case of performance-enhancing drugs. How was he involved and who killed him?

episodes.title: Aazadi Ki Jung ACP Pradyuman Ke Sang - Part 1
episodes.overview: Vivek is on a special mission to find the whereabouts of a convicted terrorist who is planning an attack on Independence Day. Vivek goes missing and CID are on the lookout while on the other end a victim asks CID for help.

episodes.title: Aazadi Ki Jung ACP Pradyuman Ke Sang - Part 2
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman and Fredricks are the only two officers left of CID after all the other members go missing. The plan is laid down by an old criminal who was arrested by them. Will CID save the city?

episodes.title: Daya Ek Qatil
episodes.overview: Judges of a food competition show are poisoned but doctors manage to save them. Sanket, the organizer feared that a killer is trying to ruin the competition. Daya enters this show undercover. However, Sanket is killed and Daya is framed.

episodes.title: Highway Killers
episodes.overview: Jigar, a hot-tempered guy, goes on a road trip with his friends and they all go missing. Investigations lead CID to a village nearby where they find Jigar's car with bloodstains.

episodes.title: Kissa Double Murder Ka
episodes.overview: Two women are mysteriously killed. The twist in the case comes when they find out that one of them was having an illicit relationship with a married man. Who is the killer? And if the affair was the cause, then why a double murder?

episodes.title: Raaz Khooni Ke Kidnap Ka
episodes.overview: Mitali, a famous model, kills a man Ravi on a busy street and then she disappears. Investigations reveal that her friend Vicky and Ravi were enemies. Cops doubt Vicky but he claims innocence.

episodes.title: CID Mission Goa - Part 1
episodes.overview: Vijay, who is posted in Goa as a police officer, gets killed while following the case of Carlos, a notorious drug mafia. Before dying he is able to contact his friend ACP Pradyuman who rushes to Goa only to be trapped and gets kidnapped.

episodes.title: CID Mission Goa - Part 2
episodes.overview: The twist in the case comes when Abhijeet falls off a cliff, looses his memory and made to believe by the mafia that he is Carlos.

episodes.title: Ganesh Utsav Special
episodes.overview: Yaksh, a young businessman dies in a bomb blast in his office on the eve of Ganesh Chaturthi. Meanwhile, the CID team that was investigating the murder of a man find out that both the cases are connected.

episodes.title: The Case of Memory Loss
episodes.overview: Saloni is abducted by gangsters who want to know the whereabouts of a pendrive. However, she doesn't know about it. She manages to escape and meets with an accident. What's so special about that pendrive?

episodes.title: Bandra Fair Mein Sareaam Maut
episodes.overview: A small-time thief, Kimmi, gets shot on the ferry wheel in the Bandra fair. CID investigations lead them to a robbery of expensive jewels. A twist is added when it is revealed that Kimmi was actually working undercover for cops.

episodes.title: Aakhein
episodes.overview: Meera's birthday takes a dark turn when she receives a seemingly innocent doll ordered by her father. However, the discovery that the doll contains actual human eyes unravels a sinister tale.

episodes.title: Raaz Paani Mein Jale Haatho Ka
episodes.overview: Mahinder is found dead in the basement of his ice cream parlour with burnt hands. On further investigation, cops come across a room where drugs are being processed. CID have to find out not just the murder weapon but also bust the racket.

episodes.title: Adrush Zeher
episodes.overview: A man is found dead in a taxi. Another dead body is found in a forest. Dr. Salunkhe finds out that both of them had paan before they died. CID's investigations lead them to an isolated gambling den.

episodes.title: Jale Murde Ka Rahasya
episodes.overview: An old lady burns to ashes but the chair on which she was sitting is intact.

episodes.title: Maut Ki Aawaz
episodes.overview: A father gets a ransom call about his son, but he thinks this to be a prank as his son is in front of his eyes. The next day his son is found dead in his room.

episodes.title: Kissa Raavan Dehan Ka - Part 1
episodes.overview: A headless body is found in a jungle with a cinema ticket. It is revealed that another man visited the theatre briefly and left a bag with old newspapers. The trail leads to a kidnapping case, but CID must find the murderer.

episodes.title: Kissa Raavan Dehan Ka - Part 2
episodes.overview: CID gathers all the evidence that they found in the jungle. They also find a motive and a pattern that keeps the case on the hook. Every victim of the killer has committed a crime but got away.

episodes.title: Tasveer Ka Khooni Raaz
episodes.overview: A man is murdered and his body is found in antique furniture. When the body goes for forensic analysis, they find a photograph in his body with a plea to save someone holding the secret to another murder.

episodes.title: Bank Robbery Se Bada Shadayantra
episodes.overview: A robbery attempt of a jewellery shop goes haywire when the security guard tries to stop it and gets killed. But the robbers were carrying fake guns. Then who shot the security guard? Though robbers escaped, they're found dead.

episodes.title: Bezubaan Gavah
episodes.overview: 5 girls are playing hide and seek at a bungalow when 4 of them get brutally killed. The CID to their horror finds an organ trafficking racket behind these murders as they find more dead bodies buried with their vital organs missing.

episodes.title: Aaropi Dr. Salunkhe
episodes.overview: A young woman's body mysteriously disappears from forensic lab and Dr. Salunkhe keeps quiet about it and lies to the CID.

episodes.title: Khoon Ki Diwali
episodes.overview: On Diwali night, Rhea and Tina, two cousins, play a prank on the assistant director Poorak by making a prank call, threatening to expose his misdeeds. However, their joke takes a turn when Rhea is found murdered shortly after the call.

episodes.title: Kolkata Mein Target – Daya
episodes.overview: An injured Daya is chased by some goons in Kolkata. Meanwhile in Mumbai, CID are lead to clues that make them believe that Daya has killed someone. They go to Kolkata and realize that Daya is trapped in a web of a conspiracy.

episodes.title: Shaadi Ka Khooni Haar
episodes.overview: A woman shows up at a jewellery store with a bag of jewels she wants to sell desperately. During the checking of jewels for authenticity, they find a patch of blood on its back. Terrified, he rushes to the CID with the jewels.

episodes.title: Aatma Ka Khel
episodes.overview: A tensed Deepak faints during his marriage rituals and is found dead when his would-be wife Tanya had come out of the room. Cops get to know that he was under the treatment of a psychiatrist according to whom Deepak used to see ghosts.

episodes.title: Rakht Chinha - Part 1
episodes.overview: Shruti dies in front of many people in a disco. She was bleeding from eyes, nose and ears.

episodes.title: Rakht Chinha - Part 2
episodes.overview: A woman's body is found on the outskirts of the city. Her head is shaved, there is blood everywhere and mutilated marks all over the body, and her eyes are glued open.

episodes.title: Khoon Peene Wala Qatil
episodes.overview: A corpse is found with all of its blood sucked out. According to an eyewitness, the blood was sucked out by a person. The investigation starts and CID find out that the culprit at the crime scene is a man named Ratnesh, who is on the run.

episodes.title: Rakht Chinha - Part 4
episodes.overview: Palash gives a flat in a renovated building to his friends Aarav and Mihika, a newly married couple. But on the first night of their stay, they discover a leaking ceiling. To their horror, the ceiling is not dripping water, but blood.

episodes.title: Gumraah Saboot
episodes.overview: A businessman staying in a hotel is murdered. Interestingly, CID investigates to find the owner of the company to be alive leading to a confusion, as to who is alive and who is dead. CID is left with clues that seem useless.

episodes.title: Masoom Suraag
episodes.overview: CID find a woman's dead body is found in the road near a jungle, with her face completely destroyed. They hear a baby crying and follow the sound to a cave, where they find another woman's dead body with the baby underneath it.

episodes.title: Raaz Khooni Aawaaz Ka
episodes.overview: On a film set, an actress falls and dies. However, the cameraman has a dream that she was actually murdered. CID's investigation confirms this. In fact, someone came that day in disguise and killed her.

episodes.title: Zehrila Dart
episodes.overview: Nitin reaches a club and meets a man named Gattu. Both of them are up to something inquisitive and look tensed. When Nitin returns home he finds his father dead. CID find a dart near the collar bone as the murder weapon.

episodes.title: CID Ne Kiya Apharan
episodes.overview: CID find a girl running from a person who claims to be her father. They save the girl from the man and she tells them that she's seen a dead body, but she will only tell them more about it if they'll help her kidnap a boy.

episodes.title: Badli Laash Ka Rahasya
episodes.overview: Girish's wife comes crying to CID fearing for his life from Rakesh who was sent to jail because of his testimony. CID manage to catch Rakesh and find Girish's dead body along with another man's dead body at the same place.

episodes.title: Khush Aatmahatya
episodes.overview: Mohit wins 50 lakh rupees lottery, but the same day, has a stone thrown at his house with a message attached which he doesn't show to his wife. That night, he falls from his balcony of his apartment and dies.

episodes.title: Kissa Jaadui Kamre Ka
episodes.overview: A wealthy couple have bought the controversial and haunted mansion of a notorious magician of the 1930s to turn it into a heritage hotel. But their plans are thwarted by stories of the magician's 'magic room', from where people go missing.

episodes.title: Khooni Tohfa
episodes.overview: Kashyap, is celebrating his daughter Shimona's 20th birthday with a Christmas-themed party. But this happy celebration turns sour when his daughter dies in a blast on the day of her birthday and his wife is kidnapped by the killer.

episodes.title: Khatra Radioactive Gas Ka
episodes.overview: A hospital receives 4 patients in critical condition. They're diagnosed with radioactivity exposure. When they suddenly die, the hospital is vacated immediately in panic. CID must find how they came in contact with radioactive elements.

episodes.title: Khooni Ka Pardafaash
episodes.overview: The CID is called to a theatre where a senior actor dressed as a vampire is found dead. His death is very mysterious, as his body is paralyzed, but there is no visible cause of death.

episodes.title: Happy Hew Year
episodes.overview: A few of the guests during a New Year Party in a hotel outside the city, receive a phone call, making them leave the party in panic. As the CID is about to leave for New Year celebrations, they receive a call on a series of accidents.

episodes.title: Holiday Murder
episodes.overview: Fredricks invites the CID team for a holiday in his village. But, in this village lives a boy who has seen a few people doing evil deeds. Will Team CID find this boy and solve the case of that mysterious night?

episodes.title: Kissa Lift Murder Ka
episodes.overview: Piyush, a disco owner is found murdered in a lift without any wound on his body or evidence for a cause of death. On top of that driver on the ground floor did not see the lift stopping at any level or see anyone getting in or out of it.

episodes.title: Raaz Safed Shirt Wali Ladki Ka
episodes.overview: A scared girl gets onto a bus, but a robber follows her. She jumps off the bus, but the robber snatches her bag and is caught and beaten up and in the scuffle, the contents of the bag fall out: blood-stained tissues and a dagger.

episodes.title: Khoon Ki Bhavishyavani
episodes.overview: A psychic who can read minds finds that one of the guests on his show is a killer and is going to kill a girl. CID don't believe this, but they can't take a risk. They round up every girl. But still, one of the girls gets attacked.

episodes.title: Kissa Daya Aur Lapata Bacche Ka - Part 1
episodes.overview: A woman comes to the CID saying that her baby has been kidnapped, and her husband who went to pay the ransom has gone missing. CID go to the location and find him lying dead and Daya unconscious, insisting that he did not kill the man.

episodes.title: Kissa Daya Aur Lapata Bacche Ka - Part 2
episodes.overview: The kidnapped baby is found in Daya's house. CID realize that somebody is trying to frame Daya. They follow the informer who told Daya to go to the location where the husband's body was found but he also gets killed.

episodes.title: Bhootiya Hospital
episodes.overview: A series of deaths due to brain haemorrhage happen in a hospital which is rumored to be haunted.

episodes.title: Raaz Newspaper Ka
episodes.overview: A journalist is killed in the newspaper office. CID find that the newspaper had a secret code that was used to communicate with terrorist groups. An attack on CID and further investigation reveal another bomb blast attempt on Republic Day.

episodes.title: Raaz Chalte Ped Ka
episodes.overview: Vicky and his friends are in his uncle's bungalow for a picnic. The caretaker warns them not to go to the jungle behind the bungalow since it is haunted. However, they still go there, and Vicky gets killed mysteriously by a tree.

episodes.title: Raaz Bandh Kamre Ke Khooni Ka
episodes.overview: A party is going on at Monica's farmhouse, and they are playing a card game. Soon a chit comes up that says that "M" will die that night. Everyone thinks this is a joke but things soon turn sour when Monica dies in a closed room.

episodes.title: Abhijit Ki Maa
episodes.overview: A woman and her son get attacked by an unknown assailant next to a pay phone. CID reach there and rush the lady to the hospital. When she opens her eyes, she recognizes Abhijeet. Abhijeet, however, has no recollection of her.

episodes.title: Pyaar Ka Khooni Tohfa
episodes.overview: Rishabh and Akshit get into a fight on Valentine's Day. Akshit pledges that he'll teach him a lesson. The next morning, Akshit's dead body is found in the swimming pool and CID are called in. They inquire about Rishabh, but he's missing.

episodes.title: Khel Andhvishwas Ka
episodes.overview: A superstitious man gets worried when his wife makes a series of mistakes that may lead to something terrible. Next morning, she falls off the balcony and CID are called in. He blames everything on the omens, but they don't believe him.

episodes.title: Raaz 25 Saal Purani Laash Ka
episodes.overview: A builder trying to sell his property gets shocked when a storm uproots a tree and a corpse is found under the stump. CID's investigation reveals that apart from an upturned chair, everything else had sheets covering them from dust.

episodes.title: Kissa Anjaan Caller Ka
episodes.overview: Daya gets a call from an unknown girl who says a murder has taken place. The CID find out the phone number belongs to Ajay Kumar. Later, a man named Vishesh is found dead in the same housing society as Ajay Kumar.

episodes.title: Khoon Ka Deewana
episodes.overview: A stalker makes Kamya's life miserable. One night, Kamya comes back home to find her maid murdered. The stalker asks her not to inform the cops or else she and her friends would have to pay the price. How does Kamya deal with the stalker?

episodes.title: Gayab Gawah
episodes.overview: Ballu, a thief attempting to break into a car finds a dead body in it. Panicked, he calls the CID. However, upon the CID's arrival, both the car and Ballu, are nowhere to be found. Eventually, they find Ballu shot in the stomach.

episodes.title: Khooni Keel
episodes.overview: A group of friends accidentally push a man by their car. The dead man's wife believes he was killed so CID investigates from a different perspective. Closer inspection of CCTV reveals the deceased to be running from something or someone.

episodes.title: Khooni Gulaal
episodes.overview: Guests at a Holi party get shocked to see a dead body next to a tree. CID is called in to investigate and find that only the face was terribly burnt. Investigation reveals that some dangerous chemical laced with the color.

episodes.title: Bank Ka Khooni Raaz
episodes.overview: Officials at the bank panic when they find a man choking to death. The nephew of the deceased tells CID that he had suspected that something might go wrong with his uncle as he was acting strange for a before his death.

episodes.title: Dahej Ka Danav
episodes.overview: A woman gets tortured by her in-laws for dowry. Her sister-in-law calls the CID and they reach on time and save her. However, her life was still not out of danger; somebody makes another attempt to kill her in the hospital.

episodes.title: Chota Sainik
episodes.overview: A boy saves a man from drowning. While trying to save the man, the boy faints due to his asthma problem and is admitted to the hospital. Who pushed the man in the pool and why?

episodes.title: Buland Hosle
episodes.overview: 3 statues that were recently auctioned become the reason behind murders. The ancient statues are being stolen from the buyers after killing them. 2 are already dead; can CID get to the third on time? What's so special in these statues?

episodes.title: Choti Si Asha
episodes.overview: In a mugging case that goes wrong, the robbers take everything and still kill the couple. The nanny and the infant escape and inform the CID. No blood is found in the front seat of the car, despite the murder. Will CID find the culprits?

episodes.title: Veerta Ki Jung Dacait Ke Sang
episodes.overview: A group of tourists, travelling inside dangerous territories, ask the driver to take them deep in the jungle. He refuses but he bribes him and takes over the wheel. They drive through the jungle only to be ambushed by dacoits.

episodes.title: Raaz Wheelchair Ka
episodes.overview: Neighbours hear a couple screaming for help. They see them badly bruised, but the attackers escape. Immediate medical attention is given to them and CID are called in. But to their surprise the couple refuse to file a case.

episodes.title: Mission Shirdi Part 1
episodes.overview: A man, who was on an office tour goes inside the restroom and gets attacked and his bag gets snatched. The bag is found empty so he leaves him for dead and disguises himself as one of the colleagues. What was he looking for in the bag?

episodes.title: Mission Shirdi Part 2
episodes.overview: With the knowledge that the bus is going towards Shirdi, CID is trying to get ahead of them and stop the bus. Knowing the bag contains some sort of explosives, they race against time to stop it getting it into the wrong hands.

episodes.title: Raaz Boondighat Ka
episodes.overview: Two set of accidents happen where the victims are mysteriously killed in a place named Boondighat where people get disappeared. CID decides to venture to find out the truth.

episodes.title: Raaz Heart Attack Ka
episodes.overview: An owner of a call center dies mysteriously inside his office. CID investigates to find no traces of blood. Forensic analysis reveals that the man died because of a heart attack but something felt off. Is the heart attack a murder?

episodes.title: CID Mein Daraar - Part 1
episodes.overview: Daya sees ACP in a restaurant with a woman carrying a gun. He gets suspicious but ACP rejects his calls. Daya gets worried and follows him. Daya notices ACP's strange behavior and he seemed to be interacting with questionable characters.

episodes.title: CID Mein Daraar - Part 2
episodes.overview: With ACP on the run and missing, the DCP orders the team to find him as soon as possible. The DCP looks fidgety but insists he is worried for Pradyuman. Abhijeet is convinced that the ACP has been kidnapped, but the DCP doesn't agree.

episodes.title: CID Mein Daraar - Part 3
episodes.overview: A phone next to a dead body with the last dialed number creates more suspicions. Abhijeet tracks down on ACP Pradyuman's phone and manages to find the chip and more information on the ACP's whereabouts and his vehicle.

episodes.title: CID Mein Daraar - Part 4
episodes.overview: The rift in CID deepens. With DCP on the hunt for the ACP, he interrogates all the junior members but none of them reply. Abhijeet and Fredricks reach the location where the ACP was last seen hoping to find clues on his whereabouts.

episodes.title: Raaz TV Reporter Ke Khoon Ka
episodes.overview: On a live show, Malay is interviewing an astrologer who predicts his death and Malay dies in some time. Vivek who is also there for an interview, hears the commotion and rushes to check in. He sees Malay's body frozen.

episodes.title: Raaz Aatmahatya Ka
episodes.overview: People are taking their own lives without any apparent motive. Witnesses recount that the victims appeared to be entranced before their fatal actions.

episodes.title: Raaz Bad Uncle Ka
episodes.overview: An old couple returning from a holiday find a terrified 4-year-old child in the boot of their car. CID is informed about this and they start searching for the kid's family and reach his house where they find his elder brother missing.

episodes.title: Raaz Khidki Pe Bache Ka
episodes.overview: A family shifts into a new neighbourhood where stories are rife about a deserted house from which a family disappeared 3 months ago. The daughter of the family sees a boy at her window asking for help from the deserted house.

episodes.title: Raaz Gayab Bacche Ka
episodes.overview: Aryan and his mother Niharika have been kidnapped and are hiding in the jungle. Aryan's friend Riddhi informs CID about this. Investigation leads them to the place where the two have been hiding from the goons.

episodes.title: Raaz Kate Kaano Ka
episodes.overview: The CID team finds four murder victims and the one thing common between all of them is that their ears have been chopped off.

episodes.title: Operation Theatre Ka Khooni Raaz
episodes.overview: Vijay is brought into the operation theatre. Dr. Mayur instructs Sonia to get the oxygen cylinder but she doesn't respond and it kills Vijay. When the furious doctor approaches her, he realizes that she is not Sonia as she falls and dies.

episodes.title: Raaz Accident Ka
episodes.overview: A girl named Richa dies due to an accident while she was on her way to the CID bureau to reveal a secret. Upon investigation, it is found out that the accident was a pre-planned murder.

episodes.title: Raaz Gayab Maa Baap Ka
episodes.overview: In this special episode, Rowdy Rathore rescues a child.

episodes.title: Raaz Kaatne Wale Qatil Ka
episodes.overview: A group of college friends are refreshing their old memories. A heating argument takes place between Preeti and Sheela. Angered, Sheela leaves and Riya and Naina try to stop her but she gets murdered. Her corpse is found with bite marks.

episodes.title: Raaz Chandi Ki Goli Ka
episodes.overview: Jairaj, along with his wife and daughter, is packing their bags to escape financial troubles. During an argument with investors, a power outage occurs, and Jairaj is shot dead while his daughter is kidnapped.

episodes.title: Maut Ka Bulawa
episodes.overview: CID gets a call from a stranger who is under attack but before he can say anything the call gets disconnected. CID tracks down the call and reaches a bungalow where they find the man dead.

episodes.title: Laash Pe Laash
episodes.overview: Deepak, Jatin and their other friends witness a man falling from an under-construction building and call the CID. Did the man commit suicide or was he killed?

episodes.title: Raaz Dum Dum Bullet Ka
episodes.overview: This episode deals with the infamous DUM DUM bullet that was invented in Kolkata and used in the Norway shootout.

episodes.title: Raaz Kidnapped Scientists Ka
episodes.overview: A vegetable vendor spots a man falling from a running bus. The man is still conscious but dies in front of the vendor. CID is called in to investigate. Who killed him? Why was he thrown from the running bus?

episodes.title: CID Mein Gaddar
episodes.overview: The residents of a society call the CID on their resident named Vikram who has a gun with him. They go in to interrogate and in a fight, Vikram gets shot. They find photographs of young kids who have been tied up. What does Vikram do?

episodes.title: Khooni Paani
episodes.overview: A kid is terrified after he sees blood in the swimming pool. CID is called in to investigate and they find 4 unidentified dead bodies from the pool.

episodes.title: Raaz Sar Aur Haath Ka
episodes.overview: A head and a hand cut off are found in a park. Dr. Salunkhe reveals that the parts belong to different bodies. A bracelet found on the hands of one of the bodies leads the CID to continue their investigation further.

episodes.title: Raaz Latakti Laash Ka
episodes.overview: A man is found dead hanging between two buildings from a rope. CID assess that the killing seems symbolic and a reminder of something which happened in the past and even more bizarre as they find out that the victim has a fear of heights.

episodes.title: Rahasyamay Bullet Part 1
episodes.overview: A man falls from a building in front of many people. The CID find out that the man died due to a gunshot but there is no gunshot on the body. A jewellers bill is found from his pocket that leads them further into their investigation.

episodes.title: Rahasyamay Bullet Part 2
episodes.overview: A dead body falls down from the building. Upon investigation, CID finds two more dead bodies on the terrace of the same building who have been shot by the same bullet. Who killed them and why?

episodes.title: Rahasyamay Bullet Part 3
episodes.overview: A girl is shot at point-blank range by her cousin and the murder is witnessed by her housemaid and society members. For CID, it looks like an open and shut case until the autopsy and forensic analysis proved otherwise.

episodes.title: Khatre Mein Tarika
episodes.overview: Dr. Salunkhe receives a jar of blue bottle flies at his house and he is alarmed that something awry is about to happen. His suspicions prove true when Dr. Tarika goes missing from the forensic lab.

episodes.title: C.I.D. Viruddh Adaalat Part 1
episodes.overview: Raja is killed in the makeup room of a dance bar. A bar dancer named Julie witnesses this and informs CID. CID is in in a fix as they do not find any bullet inside the body. Episode continues to C.I.D. Viruddh Adaalat (2012).

episodes.title: C.I.D. Viruddh Adaalat Part 2
episodes.overview: Continuing from C.I.D. Viruddh Adaalat (2012), the DCP has been given a life sentence but CID finds the DCP's driver's dead body in the warehouse along with RDX that can prove DCP not guilty.

episodes.title: Khoon Khabri Ka
episodes.overview: CID's informants are getting killed one by one and no one knows the reason why and a rift takes place between Daya and Abhijeet. Will they solve their issues and catch the culprit?

episodes.title: Gayab Pati Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: Asha escapes from Ambulance seeking for CID's help. Later she faints outside in the bureau. CID are finding out about a missing man named Rajesh. In the hospital, Asha reveals to Abhijeet that her husband Jagdish is kidnapped.

episodes.title: Raaz Qatil Auzar Ka
episodes.overview: CID are informed about mysterious deaths on a highway near a wildlife sanctuary. On reaching there, they find 3 dead bodies: 2 have been killed with a mysterious weapon, while the 3rd has died of poisoning.

episodes.title: Khatre Mein C.I.D. Officer Part 1
episodes.overview: A heating argument takes place in a disco. Next morning, a kid finds some blood on the road and the CID are called in. They find a hair attached to the skin near the blood and an empty bottle of alcohol lying on the road.

episodes.title: Khatre Mein C.I.D. Officer Part 2
episodes.overview: Further investigation leads CID to a local booze shop where they find the same cheap brand bottles like the one found earlier. They show Sanjana's photo and booze shop owner stuns cops by telling that she didn't come to buy the booze.

episodes.title: Raaz Gayab Laash Ka
episodes.overview: Shilpa notices drops of blood falling on the window glass. Before she can think any further, suddenly a body appears hanging upside down outside the window. She asks for help but when the neighbours arrive, there is nobody to be found.

episodes.title: Khooni Raksha Bandhan
episodes.overview: As Rakhi celebrations are going on in Raja's sprawling mansion, the family hears a shriek of Raja's daughter Deepika. As everyone rushes to the first-floor bedroom they find Deepika lying dead.

episodes.title: Raaz 14 Saal Ke Qaidi Ka
episodes.overview: Dev, a prime suspect in the murder of his wife Priya had disappeared since then. However, he resurfaces in the city again and CID nabs him. They get to know that Dev was held captive for 14 years and he has no idea who kidnapped him.

episodes.title: Raaz Kidnapped Birthday Girl Ka
episodes.overview: Two masked men barge inside a restaurant and kidnap Saloni who was celebrating her birthday with her friends. Cops find a dead body of a girl wearing the same dress Saloni was wearing in her party.

episodes.title: Aakhri Saboot
episodes.overview: A group of youngsters loitering on a seashore find a bottle with a blood-stained note inside. They call the CID. For the cops, it's a rather twisted case as all they have is a blood-stained note from the sea.

episodes.title: Freddy Ki Biwi Ek Khooni?
episodes.overview: A woman is murdered in the parking lot near her office. As CID investigate, it turns out that the victim is Freddy's wife's boss. Freddy's wife also goes missing and the CID think that she has run away because she's guilty.

episodes.title: Raaz Laal Raincoat Wali Ladki Ka
episodes.overview: A superstar dies on the day of his film's premiere in front of his fans. CID, after looking at the footage, spot a girl in a red raincoat reaching close to him to his shock. CID nab her but realize that she's not the killer, then who?

episodes.title: Target 15 August
episodes.overview: A journalist comes to CID and informs them that he's got a call from an unknown source warning him about an impending danger to the city on Independence Day.

episodes.title: Raaz Dulhan Ke Khoon Ka
episodes.overview: One of the brides at the mass wedding ceremony suddenly dies on the spot.

episodes.title: Rahasyamay Hotel
episodes.overview: Shreya is asked for help by a hotel employee while she's having dinner. She and Purvi go to meet the person in an isolated place but suddenly Purvi goes missing and there's blood near the site where Purvi was last seen.

episodes.title: Raaz Khooni Pati Ka
episodes.overview: Pramila is stabbed to death despite being under tight security. To the utter shock of the CID, her husband Maanik takes complete responsibility of the same but the autopsy report reveals something else. Who is he trying to protect?

episodes.title: Giraftaar C.I.D. Officer Vineet
episodes.overview: During a raid on the drug dealers, the CID is shocked to find Vineet at the spot with a bag full of drugs but he denies his involvement. To make matters worse, a syringe with his bloodstains and drug is also found from his house.

episodes.title: Gunehgaar C.I.D. Officer Rajat
episodes.overview: A couple of dead bodies are found floating in a well with a chemical in it. Later, Abhijeet and Daya investigate and are stunned to see a huge quantity of blood in a house nearby, a girl's dead body and Rajat himself colored in blood.

episodes.title: Bhootiya Haveli
episodes.overview: The film unit had come to shoot for their film, Raaz 3, in a supposedly haunted mansion. In the opening shot, the camera rolls and Bipasha opens a cupboard. To the horror of the crew, one of the crew members' dead body tumbles out.

episodes.title: Dulhan Pe Shraap
episodes.overview: In a cursed village where the brides get killed just when they're about to get married, the Sarpanch comes to the CID for his daughter's protection. Even before they reach there, she's killed.

episodes.title: Ice Pick Killer
episodes.overview: 2 young women are killed in a similar manner with ice picks drawn through their throats. The initial investigation leads the CID to think about a serial killer as they're an exact replication of the murders done by a psycho years ago.

episodes.title: Rahasya Bacchi Ka
episodes.overview: A watchman discovers a young girl hanging from a balcony in a flat. Cops rescue her but find Raj and Manisha killed in the same flat. Clues lead to Raju, but the girl remains the suspect. CID must uncover the truth about her involvement.

episodes.title: Nakli Chehra
episodes.overview: Arnab is murdered during his wife's birthday party. CID investigates, leading to Shiela, who Arnab was fighting with over the phone. They eventually find her dead and realize they are dealing with a con artist using multiple identities.

episodes.title: Heroine Ko Khatra
episodes.overview: Kareena gets a bomb threat from an obsessed fan. He wants her to come to him otherwise he will kill her on the day of the release of her movie Heroine. CID gets into the case and finds the dead body of Kareena's bodyguard.

episodes.title: Rahasya Locked Room Murder Ka
episodes.overview: Three contestants prepare for Miss Popularity finale when Shivangi, a contestant, is found dead in her room. Cops uncover a drug-laced iPod and new angles to the murder mystery.

episodes.title: Raaz 2 'O Clock Murders Ka
episodes.overview: Prateek and Minaali move to Mumbai, where Minaali dies in a bomb blast. CID discovers a trap for Natasha and Mahant, and police witness Natasha's death. CID seeks killer and motive.

episodes.title: Gaddar
episodes.overview: Jeevan, a gangster breaks out of jail at midnight, 3 days before he was set to be acquitted. CID are baffled on why would a man commit a crime which would put him behind bars for life?

episodes.title: Khooni Drugs
episodes.overview: CID discovers blood splatter on building terrace and suspects injury. They search apartment buildings and find a similar splatter in Vishal and Rahul's house. A forensic analysis reveals violent coughing.

episodes.title: Room No. 303
episodes.overview: Maaya reports her daughter Lakshita's death from a haunted balcony in Kothgarh. The CID team, disguised as locals, investigate under fake identities. Daya, who allegedly took the haunted balcony, faces the risk of his life.

episodes.title: Abhijeet Ka Inteqaam Part 1
episodes.overview: A witness is to be brought to court who's going to give his testimony against a terrorist and keeping his family safe. An elaborate plan is devised, but they're still attacked. The witness's daughter is taken leaving Abhijeet injured.

episodes.title: Abhijeet Ka Inteqaam Part 2
episodes.overview: Abhijeet survives the attack. The hearing is postponed. The witness's daughter is kidnapped and he and his family are threatened that she will die if he gives his testimony. He still goes ahead and the terrorist is sentenced to death.

episodes.title: Rahasyamay Footprint
episodes.overview: A group of trekkers find a dead body with a huge footprint on it. CID arrive to investigate and find another dead body in the same way. In a village close by, people complain of a strange creature roaming around in the village.

episodes.title: Maut Jalne Se Ya Jal Se
episodes.overview: CID are meeting an informer, when a fire breaks out in a nearby bungalow. They rush to help and find a man's dead body but are able to rescue a girl trapped inside a cupboard. However, the autopsy reveals that the man died by drowning.

episodes.title: Laash No. 47
episodes.overview: Two wardboys are startled to find a dead body of a prisoner Munna missing, The CID find out that he accidentally died in prison due to a heart attack. But just then, a murder takes place. Is Munna back from the dead, taking his revenge?

episodes.title: Bank Locker Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: Purvi and Shreya are at a bank. Suddenly, 5 robbers enter taking everyone hostage. They loot the bank and leave with the two. The CID manage to save them, but the robbers die when their van explodes. However, the case takes a strange turn.

episodes.title: Raaz Daya Ke Doston Ki Maut Ka
episodes.overview: Two of Daya's friends are found dead in an unusual condition, with their bodies sitting upright with no sign of external injuries. The CID realize that the killer is stalking Daya. Will CID be able to save rest of Daya's friends?

episodes.title: Zehreele Fruits
episodes.overview: What appears to be an innocent case of a food allergy escalates when nine people perish from food poisoning at a party, showing the same symptoms. CID delves into the case, uncovering mass poisoning as the root cause of the deaths.

episodes.title: Raaz Breaking News Ka
episodes.overview: A notorious criminal, Raghu is planning a ransom exchange for a hostage. CID apprehends him and rescue the captive. During interrogation, an unexpected accident leads to Raghu's death. ACP, suspecting foul play, suspends Daya and Abhijeet.

episodes.title: Anokha Khooni Shadyantra
episodes.overview: Rajeev complains to the CID that someone came in his room to kill him while he was sleeping, but his wife says no one came as she was with him. As cops are guarding at night, Rajeev gets killed. Will the CID find this invisible killer?

episodes.title: Abhijeet Ki Deewani
episodes.overview: Abhijeet gets a phone call from a woman for help. He rushes there but he finds her dead. Suddenly, someone knocks him out. When he awakens, he finds himself tied up, where his captor, Roshni, tells him that she's madly in love with him.

episodes.title: Baby Kidnapping Ka Mayajaal
episodes.overview: A child gets kidnapped from a hospital by an unknown lady. CID are able to identify her using the CCTV footage and get to know that she's not a known criminal, but a victim of domestic violence and she seems to know the child's father.

episodes.title: Red Suitcase Murder Part 1
episodes.overview: The pieces of bodies of several police officers begin to be found across the city in big red suitcases. This is the work of a serial killer, sending a message getting his revenge on the police.

episodes.title: Red Suitcase Murder Part 2
episodes.overview: CID team up with the fearless Inspector Shekhawat, digging into cases that he has worked on in the past involving similar serial killings. They realize that the person behind this may be caught by the Inspector a few years ago.

episodes.title: Khoon Ki Painting
episodes.overview: A painting exhibition is being held at a farmhouse by 2 business partners, Sumit and Vimal. Things turn sour when a guest finds blood on one of the paintings. Forensic analysis reveals that somebody made the entire painting with blood.

episodes.title: Chocolate Murder
episodes.overview: A young couple find a woman's dead body covered in chocolate. CID discover that she was drowned in a chocolate tub. Using forensic evidence, they trace the chocolate to the factory where it was manufactured.
