episodes.title: Filmy Murder
episodes.overview: Vicky, the son of a film star Mukul, in the twilight of his career is found dead at the Mahurat party of his debut film. It seems like a suicide as the weapon is found in the victim's hand. But CID find out that Vicky was in fact murdered.

episodes.title: Raaz Jali Laash Ka
episodes.overview: A newly married couple are mysteriously burned alive in their home. What seems like an accident is revealed to be a murder by CID's investigation; a murder committed by carrying out an intricate plan.

episodes.title: Khooni Kitaab Ka Rahasya
episodes.overview: An author is at the release of his new book, reading out a passage in which a character is murdered. Suddenly, the lights are turned off. When they come back on, the publisher of the book lies dead, killed in the same way as in the book.

episodes.title: C.I.D. Ki Kidnapping
episodes.overview: Abhijeet, Sachin, Vineet and Daya wake up in a closed room and realize that they have been kidnapped. Back at the bureau, the ACP receives a CD from the kidnapper, showing him the situation his team are in.

episodes.title: C.I.D. Par Grahan Part 1
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman saves a newly married woman running away from a group of men carrying swords and takes her to her home. However, she refuses his help. The next day, he's shocked to find that she doesn't live where she told him she did.

episodes.title: C.I.D. Par Grahan Part 2
episodes.overview: When the woman dies because of ACP Pradyuman's mistake, he resigns out of guilt. The CID protest, but he sticks by his decision. 2 new cases arrive: A bride murdering her groom and running away and a newly married woman going missing.

episodes.title: C.I.D. Par Grahan Part 3
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman joins a marriage bureau for an undercover investigation that could solve the mystery of Jasmine's case. Meanwhile, the CID get a tip off on Amar and Priya's location, that could help them save Sanya.

episodes.title: C.I.D. Par Grahan Part 4
episodes.overview: DCP Chitrole breaks the news to the CID that ACP Pradyuman is working at the same marriage bureau where illegal activities were an under handed affair. Shocked, they confront the ACP and he reveals what happened when Jasmine was killed.

episodes.title: Anjaan Laash
episodes.overview: A man gets killed in a flat in the middle of the night, but the strange part is that no one knew about the murder. Only when the family members get up in the morning, they come to know about the murder.

episodes.title: Bhoot Ka Khel
episodes.overview: After a gun fight Daya and Abhijeet manage to save ACP Pradyuman. Though in a terrible state, he manages to provide some info. Abhijeet reaches the place where Mahesh had committed the crime, while Nikhil and Fredricks have their own plan.

episodes.title: Khooni Kitaab
episodes.overview: A woman trying to steal a book from a library at night, mysteriously dies. It happens as soon as she opens the book and as a result she bleeds to death. There seems to be another person who witnessed her death and did nothing.

episodes.title: Raaz 5 Looteron Ka
episodes.overview: Five criminals, misunderstanding each other, accidentally shoot each other at each other during a party. The organizers find them dead on the terrace, prompting CID to investigate the cause of the multiple murder.

episodes.title: Heere Ki Chori
episodes.overview: A jewelry store owner is checking a diamond but leaves to spend time with family. While returning to pick up a gift, he finds the guard murdered on the floor and his boss murdered inside his cabin, posing a classic case of jewel theft.

episodes.title: Raaz Ungli Ka
episodes.overview: A woman suddenly receives a package at her door. As she opens it, to her surprise, there's a chopped human finger in it. However, the package was dated two years before its arrival. CID are called in to investigate the matter.

episodes.title: Khatarnak Virus Ka Rahasya: Part 1
episodes.overview: A group of masked men attack a Government Research Centre in search of something unknown. A number of guards lose their lives that night but what they attempted to steal is the mystery. Can the CID get to the bottom of this?

episodes.title: Khatarnak Virus Ka Rahasya: Part 2
episodes.overview: With Daya injured and the criminals on the run, it's a race against time. They figure that the gang attacked them and took the virus. CID find out that there will be an auction for the virus amidst various terrorist organizations.

episodes.title: Dancer Ki Rahasyamayi Maut
episodes.overview: Mohini, a Bharatnatyam dancer, prepares for her first solo performance, but suddenly gets immolated, causing panic among the audience. CID are called in to investigate the incident.

episodes.title: Nakli Chehra: Part 1
episodes.overview: A man named Bakul is found dead in his farmhouse. The witness sees Arnav, his best friend with blood-stained clothes, escaping. However, he proves his innocence. CID get proofs against a woman, but Dr. Salunkhe is convinced it was a man.

episodes.title: Nakli Chehra: Part 2
episodes.overview: CID find out that Rashmi was involved in the killing but they also get know of her split personality disorder. Which explains why, Dr. Salunkhe was insisting that a man had committed the murder.

episodes.title: Sammohan Se Hatya
episodes.overview: Siddhanth and Maamvi, a married couple, are going for a dinner on their wedding anniversary. Siddhanth receives a call from a mysterious number, goes numb, and rams his car into a truck, killing himself and his wife. The CID are puzzled.

episodes.title: Maut Ka Khel
episodes.overview: CID get a distress call from a victim. They reach the location and realize that the killer had orchestrated the scene in such a way that such that the cops end up killing the innocent victim unknowingly.

episodes.title: Raaz Haddiyo Ki Crockery Ka
episodes.overview: A couple have lunch in a hotel with everyone around them. Suddenly the wife chokes and dies on the spot. The husband panics and calls CID. Initial assumption seems to be poisoning but a closer look reveals something else.

episodes.title: Mohabbat Ka Shikaar
episodes.overview: Two skeletons wearing clothes are found hanging from a tree, with a letter threatening their parents to agree to their relationship or else they will meet the same fate. The boy and the girl are missing and in possible danger.

episodes.title: Salunkhe Ki Hatya
episodes.overview: While examining a dead body, Dr. Salunkhe gets injured by a blast from a bomb planted in it.

episodes.title: Maut Ka MMS
episodes.overview: People are being sent scary and terrifying videos through MMS warning them of their impending death. They disregard it but some actually end up dead. The deaths are made to look like accidents, but CID find proof that they were murdered.

episodes.title: Zehreeli Hatya
episodes.overview: A couple gets killed and all their valuables get stolen. CID reach the location and does a thorough scan. Dr. Salunkhe reveals that there was some sort of sedative in the deceaseds' systems.

episodes.title: Car Murder
episodes.overview: A man is shot dead in a moving car, but no one witnesses or hears the gunshot. CID find another dead body in the trunk, and the mystery deepens when the car belongs to a girl named Homika who doesn't know either of the two men.

episodes.title: Khooni Natak
episodes.overview: Maanas, a renowned painter, dreams of two brutal murders by a bride and paints them on canvas. However, these murders come true in a theatre group office where he has had a tiff with the employees and the owners.

episodes.title: Bhootiya Haveli
episodes.overview: Rahul is missing and his wife reaches out to the CID for help. Just as they get a tip and break into an abandoned asylum, they find Rahul's body with his neck twisted behind his body in a bizarre manner.

episodes.title: Lightbox Mein Khoon
episodes.overview: Sanjay's dead body is found in his office's lightbox. CID wonder what could be the reason for it to be found there. Sanjay's wife Pooja tells the cops that Sanjay attempted to kill her. Cops find a key of a bank locker in his shoe.

episodes.title: Divider Mein Kankaal
episodes.overview: A car is accidentally crashed to a divider revealing a skeleton buried inside it.

episodes.title: Behrupiya Khooni
episodes.overview: Two women kill their husbands on their wedding nights, but the reason is unknown. CID are called in to investigate. Is it a coincidence or a planned murder?

episodes.title: Wax Ka Putla
episodes.overview: Reporter Ronita goes missing while she was on her way towards the Mayors House. Senior Inspector Daya and Purvi spot reporter Ronita's car in the middle of the jungle. One of the employees of a service center Mahesh has yet not returned back to his office. ACP Pradyuman gets to know about Vyom who was working with reporter Ronita on one of her crucial project. Who kidnapped reporter Ronita? To find out, watch this thrilling episode of CID.

episodes.title: Maut Ka Safar
episodes.overview: Team CID comes across a strange case where all the passengers who were travelling in the Bus were dead. Fortunately, both the Girls who got inside the Bus mid-way survive. Dr. Salunkhe, Sachin, Freedy, Shreya and Senior Inspector Abhijeet check out the Bus. Dr. Salunkhe reveals a shocking truth to Team CID about the cause of the death. Senior Inspector Abhijeet doubts on Terrorist. There were 35 passengers in the Bus out of which 22 are dead and 13 passengers got down mid-way. Senior Inspector Daya checks their luggage. Who is spreading poisonous gas in the Bus? So, where did the chemical came from? To find out the truth, watch this breathtaking episode of CID.

episodes.title: Main Hoon Qatil
episodes.overview: A woman walks into the CID bureau to surrender herself for the murder of her husband but when CID goes to take custody of the body, the body is missing. Where is the dead body?

episodes.title: Mahabharat: Part 1
episodes.overview: A theatre group perform in every small town in India but there's a strange layer of crime related to them. In whichever town they perform, a wealthy family is killed.

episodes.title: Mahabharat: Part 2
episodes.overview: A theatre group perform in every small town in India but there's a strange layer of crime related to them. In whichever town they perform, a wealthy family is killed.

episodes.title: Shaatir Chor
episodes.overview: The secretary of a businessman is found dead in his own house and his body is found in the locker. A thief named Monty is the main suspect of the case. Will CID catch him?

episodes.title: Talaash
episodes.overview: A young woman, Juhi, goes missing, leading CID to trace her house to an old couple who recognize her as their grandniece. Juhi's trail leads to a motel, while Preeti, also missing, has connections to the same motel.

episodes.title: Jaadui Naqaab
episodes.overview: Rich and wealthy people of the city are invited to a party with a promise of making them richer. At the party, there is a water tank that has a dead body. CID is called in and they find that the water tank has a morgue under it.

episodes.title: Commando
episodes.overview: Purvi goes missing. On her search, the CID enter a jungle and find a man who reveals he's a commando working for the government and that he didn't know that Purvi works for CID. They get together to find her. Will they succeed?

episodes.title: Khatre Mein Daya
episodes.overview: Daya is heavily injured and rendered helpless in the middle of a jungle, with a little girl who he was trying to protect. Will they both escape alive?

episodes.title: Heroine Ka Naqaab
episodes.overview: Famous film star Shanaya's enemy producer Sohan is killed and her fingerprints are found at the crime site. Upon further investigation, it is revealed that Shanaya wasn't present at the crime site, so how can her fingerprints be there?

episodes.title: Jungle Ki Ladki Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: A woman is brought to the CID with an engraving on her body as "CID Help". The women doesn't remember anything about herself and also speaks a strange language. This leads the CID to a jungle with a "curse" called "Rain of fire".

episodes.title: Abhijeet Khatre Mein: Part 1
episodes.overview: Abhijeet is found unconscious on the seashore. He has been shot twice in his back. When he gains consciousness in the hospital, he doesn't recall his identity. He doesn't know who he is and is charged for the murder of an innocent girl.

episodes.title: Abhijeet Khatre Mein: Part 2
episodes.overview: CID are shocked to see Abhijeet's involvement in the murder. They're helpless as they have evidence against him recorded in a CD. Abhijeet is still not convinced of the crime and is hiding from the cops. Will CID catch the accused?

episodes.title: Naari Raksha
episodes.overview: A girl seeks help from the CID after she escapes a racket being run by an unknown person in which girls are sold as brides. Will CID deliver justice to these girls?

episodes.title: Naari Par Atyachaar
episodes.overview: A woman who is standing up to empower other women in her village through education gets killed. CID are called in to investigate. Will CID be able to bring justice to her cause?

episodes.title: Atyachaar Ka Badla
episodes.overview: CID deal with a case of domestic violence where a woman is burnt and thrown from her flat window. Will the CID be able to bring justice to her?

episodes.title: Apharan Nanhi Comedian Ka
episodes.overview: Parents of a famous child comedian get a threat call to stop her from performing. They contact CID and Rajat is put to the task of protecting her but things get out of hand when she gets kidnapped and an upset ACP suspends Rajat.

episodes.title: Kidnapper Ka Khel
episodes.overview: The wife of a famous and rich businessman is kidnapped and a ransom of 5 crores is asked. But the ransom demand is a bit strange as the kidnappers have asked the businessman to deliver 5 crores in 5 installments at 5 different locations.

episodes.title: Coffin Box Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: Two friends, Arnav and Vansh are shopping in a mall when a woman bumps into Arnav. Arnav helps her get up, but he collapses and dies. When the body is taken back home, the body disappears. CID accuses Vansh of stealing the dead body.

episodes.title: Rahasya Paanch Laashon Ka
episodes.overview: A blind boy is found wandering on the road with bloodstains on his clothes and body. He's traumatized and can't remember what happened to him. CID trace the location where the boy came from and finds 5 friends shot to death in a farmhouse.

episodes.title: Raaz Na Sadne Wali Laash Ka
Rahasya 26 Kankaalon Ka
episodes.overview: A land baron illegally takes over land for a farm resort, but CID discovers 26 human DNAs in the soil. Cops uncover human skeletons and find out about a massive massacre, revealing the land was once a construction site.

episodes.title: Keedey Ka Rahasya
episodes.overview: A woman's decomposed body, infested with maggots, is found in a jungle, leading to a sensational twist where a killer with a sharp mind is involved.

episodes.title: Kati Ungli Ka Rahasya
episodes.overview: A finger found in a fish is believed to belong to a young girl with kidney problems. Police search for the girl Kiran but she is dead. However, Dr. Salunkhe shocks the cops by telling the finger belongs to an old man with blood cancer.

episodes.title: Phone Booth Murder
episodes.overview: Raunak, a renowned movie star, dies in a phone booth during filming. CID investigate, suspecting it to be a murder. Forensic results show he was murdered, but no weapon is found.

episodes.title: Khatarnak Zeher
episodes.overview: A distraught mother who reports her son missing for three weeks, suspects an aspiring model named Shaina. The mystery deepens as the CID team delves into the circumstances surrounding the man's disappearance and his connection to her.

episodes.title: Jail Mein Khoon
episodes.overview: Two murders occur during an annual day celebration in jail. CID investigate the incident. Despite checking the cell, no clues are found. Forensics reveal the bullet was shot from inside the cell. Everyone wonders how's it possible.

episodes.title: Rishikesh Mein Apradh: Part 1
episodes.overview: Three men, who don't know each other, go missing while river rafting in Rishikesh. Their families complain to the cops. The shop owner of the raft tells the cops that the three had come with a foreigner named Garvin.

episodes.title: Rishikesh Mein Apradh: Part 2
episodes.overview: Cops are stunned when they come to know that DCP Chitrole has called Dhenchu to Rishikesh. There's a gunshot which misses Dhenchu. Cops wonder who wants to kill Dhenchu and start following the leads.

episodes.title: Rishikesh Mein Apradh: Part 3
episodes.overview: ACP and Daya nab one of the suspects of a series of murders as others escape. They find that a guy named Chandan was supposed to meet the group at 5pm to pay them for the job. Meanwhile, a girl collapses which seems to be a case of poison.

episodes.title: Haridwar Mein Khoon: Part 1
episodes.overview: ACP notices a strange man meeting DCP and he recounts that the man is the same one who attacked Dhenchu. Cops get suspicious of DCP and his intentions. On the other hand, cops also discover a dead body in the Haridwar to Mumbai train.

episodes.title: Haridwar Mein Khoon: Part 2
episodes.overview: Dhenchu goes missing. The cops are looking for him at the Chandi Devi Temple entrance when they stumble on to a case of a missing woman. Meanwhile, there is a bomb explosion in the market and cops find evidence linking both the cases.

episodes.title: C.I.D. Mein Gaddar
episodes.overview: DCP Chitrole continues to appear suspicious in his tracking of kidnapped Dhenchu and the lives of the mysterious remaining two men. Cops come to know that DCP has been tracking the secret government agents.

episodes.title: Khooni Daayan
episodes.overview: A group of girls are telling each other ghost stories in their hostel dormitory. The next day, one of the girls disappears from the college. Is it just a coincidence or is the legend of a girl's ghost true?

episodes.title: Neend Mein Khoon
episodes.overview: A housewife wakes up in the morning to find her husband beside her shot dead. Cops feel the wife is the main suspect as the murder weapon has her fingerprints and her blood-soaked nightdress is also found dumped in the washing machine.

episodes.title: Raaz Heroine Ki Maut Ka
episodes.overview: On set, a heroine's car from an action movie goes haywire and explodes, instantly killing her. But how could such a skilled driver make such a grave mistake? Is there any foul play?

episodes.title: Aasmaan Se Giri Laash
episodes.overview: A media event at a hotel is sparked by an upcoming movie's music launch. A celebrity is interviewed when a body falls from the sky onto her car. Initial investigations reveal the body is of the movie's hero. Was it an accident or murder?

episodes.title: Saheli Ke Khoon Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: Natasha hears Madhu screaming in her room after they come back from the party where she had a fight with her ex-lover. She calls the CID who finds that Madhu has gone missing. Eventually, Madhu's is found dead along with the murder weapon.

episodes.title: C.I.D. Bureau Mein Khoon
episodes.overview: There is a unit training with high-tech weapons. The leader of the unit is Dragon. CID has been after him for a long time. Daya has a personal quest with him as he wants him alive. His friend was once caught up with him.

episodes.title: Jungle Ka Darinda: Part 1
episodes.overview: CID are called to the jungle by a woman who says she's in danger. They find a group of kids playing paintball and realize it was a hoax call. But they find a dead body of a forest officer seemingly attacked by a wild animal.

episodes.title: Jungle Ka Darinda: Part 2
episodes.overview: Forensic analysis reveals that some sort of chemical has been injected into the victim's body to change their genetic code. Meanwhile, Shreya seems to have gone missing, and the rest of the team go searching for her.

episodes.title: Teen Mujrim
episodes.overview: Sukhi, Manpreet and Mintoo are caught in the middle of a CID case, when they turn up at an MNC where CID are about to capture two infamous con artists named Aryan and Shimona. The MNC owners have been shot dead in their conference room.

episodes.title: Ek Aadmi Teen Haath
episodes.overview: A bag is found under a movie theatre seat by the bomb squad. Inside is a severed human hand, which DNA tests reveal belongs to a famous businessman named Saurabh. Upon checking, Saurabh is found safe with both hands intact.

episodes.title: Maut Ka Nasha
episodes.overview: A TV actress grappling with trauma following her fianceé's demise and persistent stalking takes a drastic step by hiring a killer to end her life. However, her plans take a dark turn when the assassin mistakenly targets her family instead.

episodes.title: Murder In Matheran
episodes.overview: A man whose family is threatened is killed in a Mumbai mall after a confrontation. Most of the family members are either dead or in the hospital except one person: a woman on her honeymoon in Matheran.

episodes.title: A.C.P. In Danger
episodes.overview: During a shootout between CID and a band of criminals, ACP Pradyuman gets shocked after seeing the face of the ringleader. Who was this man? Has he really seen him before?

episodes.title: Bhootiya Colony
episodes.overview: A dead body is found in an abandoned cottage, with a strange symbol in blood near it. CID locate the colony where the man lived to find it abandoned. They find out that all the residents left because of a spirit supposedly killing people.

episodes.title: Maut Ka Telephone: Part 1
episodes.overview: Daya, Sachin and Shreya are in the town of Kikkar for a seminar, when one night, all three of them receive calls from a panicked stranger telling them that in the span of the next 24-48 hours, three murders will take place.

episodes.title: Maut Ka Telephone: Part 2
episodes.overview: The three CID officers wake up in an enclosed room and realize they've been kidnapped. They manage to contact the others and guide them to their location using sound clues. But still there's work to be done.

episodes.title: Azaadi Ki Jung
episodes.overview: The CID is called in to an Independence Day function at a jail. They soon find out that an explosive is planted. The explosion takes place, killing several prisoners and injuring even more. The blast also helped 3 prisoners escape.

episodes.title: Sonakshi In Danger
episodes.overview: A film's press conference is happening at a 5-star hotel. While everyone is waiting for Sonakshi Sinha to join, they hear her shriek from her room. Everyone rushes there to find a man lying dead inside, shot.

episodes.title: Raaz Video Game Ka
episodes.overview: A huge horror game contest takes place, and 5 people win prizes. But things turn sour when soon after that, the prize winners start getting killed one by one, seemingly by the fictitious villain of the game they won.

episodes.title: Rakhi Ka Bandhan
episodes.overview: Cops discover a mutilated body in the woods, but DNA evidence suggests a human was responsible. Geeta, the victim's estranged wife, is suspected, but Rajat, Geeta's Rakhi brother, denies her involvement.

episodes.title: Haunted Haveli
episodes.overview: A group of friends go to an old, haunted mansion to make a documentary, when suddenly they realize that one of the friends, Kunal, has gone missing. They search the house and soon find him dead locked inside a room.

episodes.title: Baby In Danger
episodes.overview: CID receive a call about a woman's hit-and-run murder, but the case becomes bizarre when they discover the victim had a baby hidden in a fruit basket near the crime scene.

episodes.title: Junglee Manav
episodes.overview: People in the city are turning into zombie-like creatures after being bitten by infected people. CID discovers a dead infected person's body with traces of an extinct virus, posing a threat.

episodes.title: Shreya Ka Shaitaan
episodes.overview: Shreya's college friend Divya's family has been missing, who Divya says had a tattoo on his hand. CID manage to find the culprit but is found dead. However, they are shocked to find that the culprit was Divya and Shreya's old friend Varun.

episodes.title: Nikhil Ki Jung
episodes.overview: Nikhil needs money for his mother's operation. The amount is too much. An accident takes place in front of Nikhil and Pankaj. They take the injured man to the hospital, but he dies. The man was carrying Rs. 50 lakh that is now missing.

episodes.title: The Mouse Trap: Part 1
episodes.overview: Abhijeet turns up at a Basti in the guise of a small-time criminal where he saves a gangster's wife's life and becomes her bodyguard as a part of a plan. A parallel kidnapping of an intelligence officer's son complicates the case further.

episodes.title: The Mouse Trap: Part 2
episodes.overview: CID comes to know that IB officer Milind has to provide some critical info to Billa Dilawar. Hence his son has been kidnapped. The situation worsens when Sonal is forcibly taken away by Billa Dilawar and Abhijeet feels responsible for it.

episodes.title: Forensic Rahasya: Part 1
episodes.overview: The CID team is shutting a double murder case. However, a mystery clue and Dr. Salunkhe's sudden indefinite break, makes the whole investigation and conclusion look botched.

episodes.title: Forensic Rahasya: Part 2
episodes.overview: The substitute forensic doctor Dr. Sameer along with Dr. Tarika's assistance, proves Dr. Salunkhe's forensic report to be fake. Dr. Salunkhe who had been under house arrest until now suddenly goes missing.

episodes.title: Rahasya Dweep: Part 1
episodes.overview: Dr. Salunkhe is on the run on an island as he is being chased by local tribesmen shooting arrows past him. Meanwhile, CID is looking out for him as they reach his house and realize that someone has attacked and kidnapped him.

episodes.title: Rahasya Dweep: Part 2
episodes.overview: The team is under attack at the hilltop where the fisherman who guided them gets shot by a burning arrow. The cops run down the hill to take cover where they face a hallucinating mist on the island and see a dreadful mystic animal.

episodes.title: Rahasya Dweep: Part 3
episodes.overview: ACP and team are just outside the bunker as they pick up old rusted rifles to inspect them. They see some intruders but are later reassured that it was just Daya and his team. The team reunite and discuss the mysterious incidents.

episodes.title: Rahasya Dweep: Part 4
episodes.overview: The CID are trapped on the island and in mortal danger. Will they be food for the cannibals or the terrifying monster on the island? And what is the secret of the mysterious mist? Who are the strange men on the island and their plan?

episodes.title: Satara Mein Khoon: Part 1
episodes.overview: The CID team come across a stabbed dying man at the Mumbai state border. He tells them about a murder at the Satara waterfall just before his death. Armed with riddling clues and half-baked information, the team arrives at Satara.

episodes.title: Satara Mein Khoon: Part 2
episodes.overview: The key and shoe lead the CID to a wealthy family. They call Madan who has been blackmailing someone for money. The case further gets complicated when a skeleton is discovered at Waada and the family is totally clueless.

episodes.title: Chehre Par Chehra
episodes.overview: Amay sees Avantika, his wife being chased by goons and rushes to inform his friend Kunal but Kunal tells him his wife is at the salon. When Amay sees Avantika at the salon he is shocked. If she's here then who was that woman he had seen?

episodes.title: A.C.P. Murder
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman gets injured at a friend's son's birthday party, unexpectedly and this coincides with the CID team's hunt for a notorious arms dealer Vidhaan.

episodes.title: Khooni Keeda
episodes.overview: Diwakar, a man having obsessive-compulsive disorder dies while eating food on his dining table. People suspect he died of food poisoning but his wife calls CID because she felt it was impossible for him to die that way.

episodes.title: Bomb Ka Rahasya
episodes.overview: A group of friends go for a walk on Marine drive at night. As they walk, they hear a scream and turn their back to find a lady lying on the street screaming in pain. She seems to have been stabbed. CID gets informed.

episodes.title: Kaali Diwali: Part 1
episodes.overview: On Diwali night a man chased by goons gets shot to death. Meanwhile, Dhananjay's family throw a Diwali party. They light up the crackers but everyone faint. CID gets a call that Dhananjay's daughter is missing and they rush to investigate.

episodes.title: Kaali Diwali: Part 2
episodes.overview: Jatin gets killed before he could give any info to the CID. Was he just a pawn in this plan? Why was Ananya kidnapped and why was Bobby working at Dhananjay's factory? How are the two cases connected?

episodes.title: Raaz Boarding School Ka: Part 1
episodes.overview: A hitman is hired to do a job in a boarding school but he dies in an accident. the CID are still worried that whoever hired him will hire someone else for the job which they need to find out. Hence, Daya is sent undercover as a teacher.

episodes.title: Raaz Boarding School Ka: Part 2
episodes.overview: Daya is rushed to the hospital. Meanwhile, CID learn that Shekhar ran away from the school during the kidnapping. They follow his trail leading them to a dilapidated bungalow. Daya starts to find out the reason why Rishab was kidnapped.

episodes.title: Daya In Danger: Part 1
episodes.overview: On their way to the bureau, an accident halts the cops' plan. A woman crossing the road with a paper bag suddenly starts suffocating. Daya takes the bag and puts it in his car. The young woman is rushed to the hospital, but she dies.

episodes.title: Daya In Danger: Part 2
episodes.overview: The CID team is shocked and traumatized by Daya's accident even though he survives; he has lost parts of his memory due to trauma. The cops decide to decode the mystery of the dead woman and the mystery of the wooden box.

episodes.title: Singh Saab Ki Jung
episodes.overview: Saranjeet Singh IAS, who is currently incarcerated, calls CID in jail to investigate a case of an old man. CID wonder why he wants them to investigate an accident case. He tells them that he's sure that old man has been killed.

episodes.title: Antariksh Yaan Ka Rahasya
episodes.overview: A group of people witness a meteor shower. They rush towards the spot and are surprised to find mangled human remains. Dr. Salunkhe discovers the victim's body fell from a height and resembles that of a 120-year-old man.

episodes.title: Mrut Maa Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: Siblings find their dead mother alive in the mall. A shoot-out happens and a security guard dies. CID arrive to investigate. The father and the siblings tell the CID that the mother died in an accident 8 years ago. How is it possible?

episodes.title: Khatre Mein Boogie Woogie
episodes.overview: Ravi enters an abandoned house, wondering why Naved called him for a Boogie Woogie launch. Ravi enters, finds Naved tied to a chair and semi-unconscious. Breaking open the house, he finds the chair empty and Naved nowhere.

episodes.title: Invisible Gun: Part 1
episodes.overview: Moon Space Company plans to send Manish to space and he's undergoing a flying training but accidentally dies. Meanwhile, another man is shot dead while cleaning his own gun. CID are called in to investigate both these murders.

episodes.title: Invisible Gun: Part 2
episodes.overview: Nikhil is put under flying training to see how Manish died. He gets shot but is saved because of the bulletproof jacket. CID investigate the room and find the evidence for Dr. Salunkhe to investigate.

episodes.title: Khooni Stage
episodes.overview: A musician Rocky is killed in a fire during a stage show, and CID are informed. A band member reveals Rocky has been receiving blood-written threats, raising suspicions about the connection to the murder.

episodes.title: Khauffnaak Haveli: Part 1
episodes.overview: CID come to inspect a mansion for a kids function. While playing a game there's a power cut in the and a man is found dead. CID suspect something fishy about the mansion and begin their investigation.

episodes.title: Khauffnaak Haveli: Part 2
episodes.overview: Nikhil and Fredricks are caught in the web of the game and they end up harming people at the mansion. Out of the 13 people, 1 is dead and the other's life is in danger. Will CID find the culprit and get rid of the game?

episodes.title: Zinda Laash
episodes.overview: Dr. Tarika enters the forensic lab but to her surprise, the dead body is missing. She finds Dr. Salunkhe wounded on the floor. Meanwhile, a witness who is supposed to give a statement against Rocky dies mysteriously.

episodes.title: Zehreela Saap
episodes.overview: Shanti Devi is at a press conference with artist Mukesh, where she dies after being poisoned. CID suspect the people who were thrown away from her land. Dr. Salunkhe finds the reason of death of another victim which is connected but how?

episodes.title: ACP Aur Nakul Ka Raaz: Part 1
episodes.overview: Daya and Abhijeet are trying to nab a suspected criminal named Nakul who is on the verge of committing suicide. ACP Pradyuman saves him. This does not go well with CID and they question ACP's morals. Why was he trying to save Nakul?

episodes.title: ACP Aur Nakul Ka Raaz: Part 2
episodes.overview: CID has put Nakul under their watch. ACP is not convinced that Nakul is the killer and goes against his team. CID continues their investigation and looks for Karan who can prove to be a valuable asset for the case.

episodes.title: Abhijeet Ka Sangharsh
episodes.overview: CID goes to investigate the murder of a rich businessman named Raj. They interrogate his secretary and staff and find out that he did not have any enemies. The body did not have any mark and hence the reason for death was unknown.

episodes.title: Vichitra Mariz
episodes.overview: Lisa, a foreigner has an accident as soon as she arrives in India, and goes into coma for a long time. She suddenly awakens one day, and starts saying something in Telugu, a language she has absolutely no knowledge of.

episodes.title: Ahmedabad Mein Daya Faraar: Part 1
episodes.overview: Daya is absconding, at the popular Kite Festival in Ahmedabad. The rest of the CID team is frantically trying to chase him down, while the local ACP has even passed shoot-at-sight orders against him.

episodes.title: Ahmedabad Mein Daya Faraar: Part 2
episodes.overview: Shreya gets severely injured and Daya searches for Pakya. ACP Pradyuman tries to collect more information about Sarthak who got shot by Daya. Team CID is shocked as they get to know about 3 innocent People who got killed by Daya.

episodes.title: Khooni Laash
episodes.overview: A group of friends are staying in a hotel. The next day Sagar and Mihir are found dead and their friend Anisha is found on the road. Who killed them and why?

episodes.title: Lift Mein Anhoni
episodes.overview: Purvi is working undercover on a case to nab a gang but is attacked and kidnapped by them. CID is on the hunt for her. Meanwhile, she's stuck in the lift of her building with the kidnapper Makarand and the lift crashes. Will Purvi survive?

episodes.title: Khooni Joker
episodes.overview: A nanny puts a girl to sleep and watches TV. She notices a man dressed in a clown uniform. The joker kills the nanny and escapes. CID arrives at the crime site and investigates the murder. Will they catch the joker?

episodes.title: Khauffnaak Laash
episodes.overview: Mrinal encounters a strange-looking man in a jungle who claims to be a spirit and is looking for his killer. He asks him for help but he runs for his life and dies. CID arrives at the crime site and finds only half the body of Mrinal.

episodes.title: Chudail Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: Two women enter Dhruv's house but get hit on the head and they find themselves stranded at a deserted place. Meanwhile, one of them named Shikha is dead with strange marks on her neck. How did she die?

episodes.title: Khooni Makdi
episodes.overview: A woman in a mall is killed by a spider and another man Siddharth is scared of a spider wanting to take his life. CID are informed about this. Will they solve the mystery?

episodes.title: Raaz Horror House Ka
episodes.overview: Pratik, a boy gets kidnapped from the Horror House in an amusement park. There's no ransom call and the CID investigate the kidnapping. They find another decomposed dead body in a lake. While investigating, they uncover a sinister plot.

episodes.title: Paudhe Ka Rahasya
episodes.overview: CID are baffled at a murder where there are no witnesses, and all clues lead to dead ends till they come across a witness. A plant who witnessed the murder. Is it possible for the plant to identify the killer? Can the plant talk?

episodes.title: Shark Attack
episodes.overview: Two unnatural shark attacks on two men have made the CID to investigate this case as an engineered shark attack. They soon find out that both the victims were connected to each other. Will CID find the culprit behind this?

episodes.title: Piranha Fish Attack
episodes.overview: Param, a swimmer meets an ugly end at the hands of a mysterious water carnivore that almost tears his body apart. Meanwhile, a similar attack happens on a photographer in another lake. Forensics reveal that they were preys of Piranhas.

episodes.title: Mumbaicha Dabbawala
episodes.overview: A battered wife decides to put an end to her misery once and for all. On the very same day, her husband dies of poisoning. The obvious suspect is the wife, who used to have his lunch delivered to him everyday.

episodes.title: Naari Suraksha
episodes.overview: Team CID come across yet another strange case of Kashish, an NGO worker who was found dead in Shyam Nagar's sky walk located in Mumbai. Fredericks is shocked to see Kashish as her face was covered with coins.

episodes.title: Mission Mumbai: Part 1
episodes.overview: A man gets uneasy and faints in the middle of a busy marketplace. When another man tries to revive him, he finds the letters 'CID' written on his chest in blood. Who could have done this to him?

episodes.title: Mission Mumbai: Part 2
episodes.overview: Animal's viruses are found in Human Body. Team CID tries to collect more information about the virus from Dr. Sankalp but he suffers from massive heart attack. Abhijeet, Daya and Nikhil try to solve the puzzle located near Asiatic Library.

episodes.title: C.I.D. Holi Dhamaka
episodes.overview: Dhenchu gets to know about a contract killer Anil who has planned to kill Abhijeet in a Holi party. He tries to escape when comes to know that Dhenchu knows their plan. Dhenchu succeeds in informing Daya and he searches for Dhenchu.

episodes.title: Diamond Robbery
episodes.overview: A family gets together at their mansion, where they're entertained by Sunny Leone. Their patriarch will announce that he'll be distributing his wealth among some members of the family. Later however, he is found dead in his chambers.

episodes.title: Raaz Kanheri Caves Ka
episodes.overview: CID is up to nab a tourist guide who is upto some illegal activities. They don't find the guide, instead, they stumble upon a dead body of another man.

episodes.title: Mumbai Ki Chawl Ka Rahasya: Part 1
episodes.overview: One by one, several residents of a chawl are disappearing overnight. Their neighbours realize that they do not even have any relatives left to visit, and that a similar incident had taken place at a neighbouring chawl as well.

episodes.title: Mumbai Ki Chawl Ka Rahasya: Part 2
episodes.overview: The investigation of people going missing from their respective chawls continues. The CID are searching for Sangeeta and Nalini's killer all over the city and also visit Ambawadi chawl to collect more information about Ketan.

episodes.title: Bus Hijack: Part 1
episodes.overview: CID are called on a case of bank robbery with all employees drugged and customers locked in the vault. They investigate the case and find out that the robber's getaway vehicle was towed and that is why they hijacked a BEST bus.

episodes.title: Bus Hijack: Part 2
episodes.overview: CID manage to track the bus down and ask the robbers to give up. In retaliation they throw the conductor out of the bus right in the way of the jeep of the cops.

episodes.title: C.I.D. Giraftaar: Part 1
episodes.overview: CID had planted 10-12 undercover cops to infiltrate the underworld but they're getting killed one by one. ACP sends Abhijeet to pick up one of them but gets kidnapped. He wakes up the next morning lying on the road with a memory lapse.

episodes.title: C.I.D. Giraftaar: Part 2
episodes.overview: The cops find the identity of the two victims. They're underworld goons. As cops follow the trail they make a startling discovery. The goons themselves were undercover cops working for ACP.

episodes.title: C.I.D. Giraftaar: Part 3
episodes.overview: Based on inputs given by a doctor who had operated on Daya, CID trace the location only to find that he's been shifted to a new hideout. Forensics also find out that that the bullet in Daya's body was fired from Abhijeet's gun.

episodes.title: C.I.D. Giraftaar: Part 4
episodes.overview: Abhijeet is trying to prove his innocence. He reaches the location where he and Daya were drugged and held captive only to be arrested and brought back to the bureau. The cops get a phone call from Daya saying that ACP shot him.

episodes.title: C.I.D. Giraftaar: Part 5
episodes.overview: CID are stunned to hear that ACP shot Daya and before DCP could confront ACP, he runs away to save the remaining agents. But ACP gets shocked when they're not ready to come out because they claim that the DCP sold the list of their names.

episodes.title: C.I.D. Giraftaar: Part 6
episodes.overview: Goons attack ACP, Daya and Abhijeet and try to kill them. They fight back defeating the goons. Now cops plan their fake death which makes Don to come out of his hiding. The Don celebrates his win by throwing a party.

episodes.title: Khooni Taxi
episodes.overview: People are disappearing and dying mysteriously on a stretch of a road. The locals report the sighting of a haunted taxi which is being driven without a driver that seemingly disappears without a trace.

episodes.title: Choro Ka Khooni Kaun?
episodes.overview: Two masked thieves rob a bank and escape in their car. Somebody notices the number and calls the CID who now give them a chase. During the chase, the thieves loose control and dash against a tree and are found dead.

episodes.title: Box Mein Hatya
episodes.overview: In a resort, while taking a steam box, Rachit is killed. Cops come to the crime scene and they find that the entire body except the head is missing. It is discovered that the body has been melted with the help of a newly invented acid.

episodes.title: Jurm Ki Aag
episodes.overview: A big-time criminal is kept in the ICU on grounds of ill health and placed under high security. City cops are trying to collect evidence against him. As the doctor enters the room for the checkup he is shocked to see the body on fire.

episodes.title: Khatarnaak Keeda
episodes.overview: People are dying without any injury marks. The victims were sleeping when they were killed. CID are unable to find any lead. Forensic reveal that there's some kind of chemical being used to kill the victims without any external wounds.

episodes.title: Gumshuda Parivar
episodes.overview: Juhi's family had gone missing ten years back. Investigation revealed nothing and the case was closed. Now all of a sudden, she discovers her father's hat which she had not seen for ten years.

episodes.title: Khooni Chaku
episodes.overview: Jasmine gets kidnapped in the midst of her wedding anniversary party. She wakes up in a deserted farmhouse where she is shocked at the sight of blood-stained knives and many dead bodies.

episodes.title: Fridge Mein Laash
episodes.overview: Shishir, a meditation guru, is found mysteriously dead in a fridge on display in a crowded mall following a 2-minute power outage.

episodes.title: Anu Malik Par Hamla
episodes.overview: An arrogant stuntman invites Anu Malik to witness him doing a big dangerous stunt so that he can appear on TV. However, he mysteriously goes missing during the stunt and Anu Malik is the main witness.

episodes.title: Khooni Doll
episodes.overview: A woman is found murdered in her house. The only person present at the home was her daughter playing with her toys in another room. As CID investigate, they realize that there was a doll in the house, which has now gone missing.

episodes.title: Khooni Sapne
episodes.overview: A girl in a college hostel suffers from nightmares in which she feels as though someone is trying to kill her. Soon, she is murdered in the same manner as in her dreams.

episodes.title: Sabooto Ka Rahasya
episodes.overview: A notorious terrorist sends CID an evidence bag containing a severed finger, a blooded knife, a handwritten letter in Russian, a child's photograph and a windchime. He challenges the CID to find a crime scene using them.

episodes.title: Painting Ki Chori: Part 1
episodes.overview: People have gathered at a hotel for an art exhibition held by Raj. Soon, Raj reveals that he's going to propose to his girlfriend. But as he's about to, a group of armed masked men break into the hotel and steal all the paintings.

episodes.title: Painting Ki Chori: Part 2
episodes.overview: On the trail of the gang of art thieves, CID are also trying to find out about a mysterious assassin, 'X'. Who was his intended target? They also find out about Viren's murder and realize that he was X's high-profile target all along.

episodes.title: Copy Cat Serial Killer
episodes.overview: Famous authors in the city are found murdered in very unusual crime scenes. CID figure out that the murders are done by the same person, a serial killer. CID learn that there were similar crimes around 5 years ago by another serial killer.

episodes.title: Rahasya Chamatkari Talab Ka
episodes.overview: A group of teenagers are camping in the woods, when one of them wanders off and never returns. CID are called to investigate and find that several people have gone missing in these woods over the years in precisely the same way.

episodes.title: Khatre Mein Masoom: Part 1
episodes.overview: A bomb explodes at a function. The CID are shocked to find out that Shreya, a young deaf and dumb girl who is Abhijeet's friend, is involved. It's revealed that she's been forced to commit these crimes and kill 3 targets.

episodes.title: Khatre Mein Masoom: Part 2
episodes.overview: Abhijeet manages to track Shreya and arrest her after her second attack but then he and she both disappear. He doesn't arrest her and bring her to the bureau. Upset, CID track him, but he allows her to escape before he gets shot by Daya.

episodes.title: Trishakti: Part 1
episodes.overview: A fight is going on in a local bar when a man named Tez suddenly enters and murders everyone present. When CID check the CCTV footage, they realize that Tez is extraordinarily fast, almost superhuman.

episodes.title: Trishakti: Part 2
episodes.overview: CID are now after two culprits. Their investigation reveals a hidden document in one of them: Tez's hideout, which leads them to his childhood village.

episodes.title: Trishakti: Part 3
episodes.overview: CID now encounter a third culprit, Meera who escapes right in front of the cops. CID seem to have uncovered multiple individuals with 'superpowers'. Who is behind this conspiracy?

episodes.title: Raaz Gayab Magician Ka
episodes.overview: Ajinkya, a debt-ridden magician, organizes a magic festival, requiring him to disappear in a car's boot and walk through the audience. But he disappears. Soon, blood is found in the car, but there still is no sign of Ajinkya.

episodes.title: Raaz Magic Trick Murders Ka
episodes.overview: KC a well-known magician, is conducting a three night show in which he shows never-seen-before acts. The first night as he shows a 'water tank act' in front of millions, a woman is killed in exact same manner on the other side of the city.

episodes.title: Jadoo Punar Janam Ka
episodes.overview: Tillotma is a woman who claims to be able to send people to their past lives. She sends one such person, named Aakash, but things turn sour when she's unable to bring him back. His wife Natasha approaches CID for help.

episodes.title: Masoom Dost: Part 1
episodes.overview: Niharika, a billionaire's daughter comes to Mumbai with her fiancée Ketan for a business trip. During the trip, she gets shot and injured at by snipers while at an inauguration. Her advisor dies in the attack. CID are called onto the case.

episodes.title: Masoom Dost: Part 2
episodes.overview: CID search for the ACP but to no avail. Meanwhile, Niharika is once again attacked. They begin to explore the possibility of Saker and Mita being involved in this, when they stumble upon evidence suggesting that Ketan might be the culprit.

episodes.title: Raaz 3 Bullets Ka
episodes.overview: A man has been shot while in a moving vehicle on a busy road. Upon investigation it's found that 3 bullets were fired at him, out of which one killed him.

episodes.title: Ek Villain
episodes.overview: Shraddha Kapoor and Sidharth Malhotra are driving to their film's press meet when they hear a child's scream. When Sidharth goes to investigate, he finds a gang of masked men taking a group of children somewhere.

episodes.title: Shahi Talwar Ki Chori
episodes.overview: A young boy goes missing from his house. CID investigate and find out that he had overheard a plot to steal a royal sword from a museum. They go to the museum to find the sword already stolen. But it reveals the theft was a diversion.

episodes.title: Khooni Khel
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman's friend calls him over for a dinner party at his home. At the party, while playing some games, one of the guests dies. The CID arrive with DCP Chitrole. To their dismay, all of the evidence points to the ACP.

episodes.title: Raaz Kate Haath Ka
episodes.overview: The CID are having a picnic with some underprivileged orphans. But 2 of the kids, Tara and Chintu go missing. Shreya begins to search for them and comes across goons taking them into the jungle. She attempts to fight them but they escape.

episodes.title: Mahasangam: Part 1
episodes.overview: Dayaben finds the ACP's wallet and brings it to the CID bureau. It turns out that it's fake. The person carrying the wallet has been killed. CID suspects that someone is masquerading as the ACP with his face by plastic surgery.

episodes.title: Mahasangam: Part 2
episodes.overview: A couple return home and are shocked to find blood on their children's beds, with them missing along with an unknown woman's dead body. Meanwhile, Jethalal's photo has been found in a man's home, pinned to a wall with darts pinned into it.

episodes.title: Zehreelay Bichhoo
episodes.overview: Abhijeet gets bitten by a scorpion, but his life is saved in time. Soon, when three bodies are found killed by the same kind of scorpion poison, it is revealed through forensic analysis that it is not a natural scorpion bite.

episodes.title: Mahasangam: Part 3
episodes.overview: A woman's ghost is picking random people and killing them after cutting one of their body parts. CID is skeptical about the idea of a ghost. Is it a serial killer? Or some personal vendetta?

episodes.title: Mahasangam: Part 4
episodes.overview: Tarot Card Reader Vishakha Sulekha had predicted Soham's death. Soham gets murdered by a football player. Bhide reveals a shocking truth to Abhijeet. Vishakha Sulekha also gets killed and Amya is also found dead in her house.

episodes.title: Bandh Kamre Mein Laash
episodes.overview: One of the most wanted thieves, Takiya well-known for opening any safe in the world, gets murdered while opening one of the lockers kept in the room which was closed and had no ventilation of air.

episodes.title: Raaz Sudden Attack Ka
episodes.overview: Paranormalist Aliya gets murdered in a mansion where a hotel was supposed to get constructed. CID investigates and questions her group who were keeping an eye on her movements on camera. Dr. Salunkhe reveals about a sudden heart attack.

episodes.title: Rahasya Serial Killer Ka
episodes.overview: Just when Daya was about to express his feelings to Shreya, he gets a call and rushes to the spot where a murder had occurred in the house. On the other side, a couple Prashant and Prema were attacked by a serial killer.

episodes.title: Raaz Jungle Ke Bhoot Ka
episodes.overview: 3 brothers of an influential industrialist go missing from a hiking trip. Just when the CID are thinking it as a normal trek-disappearance the tour guide of is mysteriously killed. Cops understand that the disappearance is well-planned.

episodes.title: Salman Ki Kick: Part 1
episodes.overview: Anna attacks the cops but disappears into the darkness when confronted by Abhijeet and Daya. However they manage to recover the ghost Anna's lantern. Salman Khan and his team are at a resort for promoting his film Kick.

episodes.title: Salman Ki Kick: Part 2
episodes.overview: The cops discover that Koena is none other than Anna as they confront her. However, she tells them how she was forced by her husband Ashok to do everything.

episodes.title: Raaz Bus Ke Qatilon Ka
episodes.overview: A journalist Arnab, boards the 'BEST' bus to his office. On the bus, he has a small altercation with another passenger, soon he flies into a rage and he strangles the passenger and jumps out. He falls and collides with another truck.

episodes.title: Glass Room Murder
episodes.overview: The CID are called to solve a crime in an impossible situation. A man Ankush is shot in his cabin with his whole staff outside and not one of them being aware of this crime. The killer escapes without being noticed or even stopped.

episodes.title: Gayab Biwi Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: Rahul is working at his home, right when a doorbell rings and a cook is saying he was appointed by his wife Namrata. After an hour another doorbell rings and a woman enters the house claiming to be Namrata but according to Rahul she isn't.

episodes.title: C.I.D. Mein Singham: Part 1
episodes.overview: Corruption charges are levied against DCP Chitrole and DCP Singham has come to handle the case as it deals with black money. DCP Singham enters the CID bureau to get to the bottom of this case with the help of CID.

episodes.title: C.I.D. Mein Singham: Part 2
episodes.overview: DCP Singham and CID cops manage to fight their way out of the trap and find that DCP Chitrole was framed to take the blame. He was innocent and DCP Singham and the CID team trap the real money launderer.

episodes.title: C.I.D. Mein Singham: Part 3
episodes.overview: Further investigation reveals that DCP Chitrole sold CID's plan to Marco. The cops go with the flow to foil their own murder plan, arrest Marco, and the resort owner Anwesha who tried to kill cops due to personal revenge.

episodes.title: Azaadi Ki Jung: Part 1
episodes.overview: The CID gets info on a plan for a terrorist attack on the Independence Day Parade in Mumbai. They investigate and are shocked to find out that this person carrying the info isn't aware and is about to board a train to Delhi.

episodes.title: Azaadi Ki Jung: Part 2
episodes.overview: CID's mission continues. They're unaware that the terrorists have also sent their team on the train to get rid of this person and destroy the evidence as it could hamper their plan.

episodes.title: Khatre Mein Masoom: Part 1
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman gets a call from Bunty's hostel that he's been behaving strange from past few days. He reaches there and speaks to Bunty who tells him that the problem is not with him but his roommate Rahul.

episodes.title: Khatre Mein Masoom: Part 2
episodes.overview: ACP promises Rahul that he will find out what happened to his father Vishal. Bunty is relieved. However, Bunty's life also comes in danger's shadow as a few people turn up at the bureau and the hostel claiming to be his distant relatives.

episodes.title: Khatre Mein Masoom: Part 3
episodes.overview: CID succeed in arresting the Bunty and Rahul's kidnappers. Shreya shares her problem with Abhijeet. Bunty reveals a shocking truth to ACP Pradyuman in the bureau. Will Daya be able to express his feelings to Shreya?

episodes.title: Abhijeet Ka Bachpan
episodes.overview: A man collapses and dies in the middle of a crowded street. CID arrives and finds that the man was behaving strangely shortly before his death and was constantly mumbling a set of numbers. What do these numbers mean and how did he die?

episodes.title: Khatre Mein A.C.P.
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman is on the edge of a building as he is asked by the mysterious stranger to jump, or else innocents will lose lives.

episodes.title: Daya Bana Dulhan
episodes.overview: Murders are happening at the wedding. As cops investigate, they find out a shocking history of the village which connects the killer and these brides.

episodes.title: Ganesh Utsav Mein Apaharan: Part 1
episodes.overview: A woman gets kidnapped in the middle of a crowd during Ganesh Chaturthi celebrations.

episodes.title: Ganesh Utsav Mein Apaharan: Part 2
episodes.overview: The CID are puzzled about how did the culprit take the victim through such a huge crowd. There are other people who have also got kidnapped. Who is the kidnapper and what does he want from CID?

episodes.title: Ganesh Utsav Mein Apaharan: Part 3
episodes.overview: Just then CID starts receiving calls about random people disappearing suddenly from the city. There seems to be no connection between them but about a hundred have gone missing without a trail.

episodes.title: Bipasha Par Hamla
episodes.overview: Bipasha is doing her regular workout in the gym, when a goon attacks her but somehow she manages to dutch him and then complains to CID. They come across a murder which is connected with Bipasha.

episodes.title: Maut Ka Video
episodes.overview: People in the city are dying under strange circumstances. The cops find out that each of them committed suicide in a certain manner. All of them had received a mysterious video some time back from a loved one who had died recently.

episodes.title: Kankaal Ka Rahasya
episodes.overview: A group of excited youngsters from the nearby neighborhood decide to dig up the fortune/treasure, and when they do so, they are in for a shock. They find five skeletons embedded in earth to form 5 alphabets that read as a word together.

episodes.title: Maut Ka Kabaddi
episodes.overview: Vishal dies in the middle of a Kabaddi tournament. His friend Deepali confesses that she gave his contract to a contract killer. The opposite team players are suspects but Dr. Salunkhe has some shocking revelations about the death.

episodes.title: Rahasyamayi Maut
episodes.overview: Shreya finds out that a bomb was planted in the locker to kill Vishal. Abhijeet suspects an inside job. The CID catch the killer in an interesting way by taking part in the kabaddi tournament opposite to killer's team.

episodes.title: 40 Crore Ki Chori
episodes.overview: 40 crores have been shifted to the main headquarters of a bank for transfer tomorrow. The manager goes to his cabin to complete the formalities and back to check the vault. To his shock the vault's monitor shows that it's completely empty.

episodes.title: Naari Shakti: Part 1
episodes.overview: Shreya, Purvi and Dr. Tarika are attending a charity function. There, they meet a social worker Saakshi Kumar. After the function, she gets a fit. Her PA and her bodyguards control her and tell them that she's a patient.

episodes.title: Naari Shakti: Part 2
episodes.overview: Keerti's husband is involved in child trafficking and Keerti discovered this about him. Meanwhile, Saakshi is missing and CID is on the lookout. Saakshi was given medicines so that she could never be in her senses.

episodes.title: Shreya Ki Sagai
episodes.overview: On the engagement day of Shreya, her fiancée Siddharth goes missing and a dead body is found in his room. CID gets on the case to find him and the kidnapper and for that Daya has to do a task which is not simple. What is the task?

episodes.title: Ichcha Purti Haveli: Part 1
episodes.overview: Abhishta arrives in Chanda's mansion to make a wish of coming first in the exams as she wants to defeat her competitor. Abhishta gets terrified there. Will Chanda make her wish come true? How will CID solve this horrifying case?

episodes.title: Ichcha Purti Haveli: Part 2
episodes.overview: In a desperation to top in the exams, Abhishta falls in a stairwell trap where she asks a wish after reaching at a particular step. She finds her competitor dead, but the CID find no such staircase in that house.

episodes.title: Barf Mein Laash
episodes.overview: Dr. Salunkhe is blinded and in action he has heard 1 bullet, but the dead body has 2 bullets. How will he do the autopsy in this blind state? How will he help the cops solve the mystery?

episodes.title: Zehreela Baal
episodes.overview: Dr. Salunkhe finds a clump of hair in the dead body which contains traces of poison but the hair doesn't belong to the victim. Why was he killed? How will Dr. Salunkhe solve the case with just a help of hair?

episodes.title: Gunaah Ki Seedi
episodes.overview: Some kids have been kidnapped. Cops don't have any clue of the kidnapper and also come across a murder. In forensic, Dr. Salunkhe has only a ladder brought by the kidnappers to kidnap the kid.

episodes.title: Zehreela Dawa
episodes.overview: A leading dentist of the city is found guilty of murder when all he had done was prepared customized dentures for his client. Is the poison in the dentures? How will Dr. Salunkhe track the killer by the dentures?

episodes.title: Haddi Mein Code
episodes.overview: A video is sent for Dr. Salunkhe showing a few people in black plastic hoodies, blowing up a car and shouting Dr. Salunkhe's name. How is this related to Dr. Salunkhe?

episodes.title: Samundar Mein Kankaal
episodes.overview: Dr. Salunkhe gets a driftwood with bullet in skull. He finds a derivation of various coloured sea salts and its similarity with the deposits on the skull make the cops investigate to find the source of the skull.

episodes.title: Naakun Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: A finger is the only clue that Dr. Salunkhe has of the victim to find the killer. What are the secrets that the nail holds? It is an impossible case as the cops are searching in the dark for the killer.

episodes.title: Daya V/S Daya
episodes.overview: Daya wakes up in the woods, remembering a night before. Villain Daya calls to save ACP and Abhijit, and Daya sends the CID team to find and help them.

episodes.title: 10:45 Murder
episodes.overview: A joker predicts his death at 10.45, causing chaos in an operating theater. After ten minutes, he dies simultaneously, prompting CID to investigate the bizarre case of a man predicting his own death.

episodes.title: Khoon Ka Badla
episodes.overview: A get-together ends with the host dead and friends Mohit and Ganesh unconscious. Police investigate, discovering Ganesh's cryptic conversation and his escape. Mohit is found hanging from a fan, but Dr. Salunkhe reveals it's a murder.

episodes.title: Phone Booth Murders
episodes.overview: Two women are murdered by a mystery killer, while Roy and Jiyaa stop at a phone-booth. Roy calls a man who claims to know the killer, leading to his girlfriend's murder. CID investigate all three murders, but the call was made to a motel.

episodes.title: Khooni Bag
episodes.overview: Pritika behaves strangely with her friends and is stubborn on leaving for home even though her friends insist her to stay. When she catches a rickshaw to go home, it already has a woman sitting inside. The woman tells Pritika that she should have given everything back but she didn't and stabs her with a knife asking her to face the consequences. Injured, she falls on the road. Who tried to kill Pritika? Watch this episode of CID to find out.

episodes.title: Shikaari Ka Shikaar
episodes.overview: Vipul, stressed, locks his wife Kiran in a room after hearing a doorbell ring. He receives a gun and and a phone call. The man asks Vipul to shoot a man in a red cap. Hesitantly, he shoots but a woman comes in between and gets shot.

episodes.title: Masoom Baby Ka Rahasya
episodes.overview: A thief steals a baby girl, and her parents are found murdered. Cops find a baby boy in the house, who doesn't match the dead couple's profile. The case raises questions about kidnapping or other factors.

episodes.title: Kyun Maalik Bana Chor?
episodes.overview: A man runs into a mall to save his life from a woman who tries to shoot him. He was carrying some rare paintings. The next day, Dhanraj, is found dead in his living room, in the guise of a thief with the robbery of the SAME paintings.

episodes.title: Bai Ka Sangharsh
episodes.overview: Shanti, a maid is trying to help Veronica, a victim of domestic violence. Veronica's husband Tarun realized that Shanti is danger to him and gets her arrested in a robbery case, but Veronica saved her. Eventually, Shanti is found murdered.

episodes.title: Faisal Par Humla
episodes.overview: Faisal is the top contender and star of a dance show. However, a lot of tension and ego battles are going on. Eventually, all the 3 judges are found dead. Faisal disappears and comes back. He doesn't react much to the news of the deaths.

episodes.title: Pied Piper
episodes.overview: A number of robberies are taking place in the city and cops are surprised to find the culprits to be kids around ten years of age. A Pied Piper kind of a character is kidnapping children and using them to commit crimes.

episodes.title: Brave Kids
episodes.overview: School kids playing cricket in the playground discover that terrorists have entered the premises and are holding teachers and kids as hostages. They manage to hide but get stuck in different rooms. They decide to call CID for help but how?

episodes.title: Happy Ending
episodes.overview: Armaan and Yudi are discussing a script when Yudi notices that a young chap poisons a middle-aged person by putting some drops in his juice. The twist in the tale comes when forensics finds out that the man didn't die due to poisoning.

episodes.title: Mumbai Chawl
episodes.overview: Vijay comes across a dying man Deepu who hands him a bag. His killers are after him and Vijay escapes. CID investigating Deepu's murder find out that he returned from Dubai. The killers realize that Vijay has the bag. What's in the bag?

episodes.title: Chawl Mein Murder
episodes.overview: Vinay and Kishore shoo away a man for assaulting Sheetal. She attempts suicide but fails. Next morning, Vinay is found dead in a tank.

episodes.title: Bandh Kamre Mein Laash
episodes.overview: Manish, a rich businessman checks in a 5-star hotel. Gunshots are heard and when CID arrive at the crime scene they find him dead. CID find out that the 3 adjacent rooms to Manish are all booked under false names as well as that of Manish.

episodes.title: Mahabali Shera Ki Dahaad
episodes.overview: Shera, a wrestler has come to meet his childhood friend Suraj. He had called him for some urgent work. But Suraj suddenly suffers from brain hemorrhage and dies. Shera insists to the CID that it's a murder.

episodes.title: Kulhaadi Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: A female thief breaks into a couple's bungalow, causing blood to flow from a table. The wife finds an antique axe inside, but the couple feign ignorance, fearing the cops will uncover hidden secrets buried in the axe.

episodes.title: Action Jackson
episodes.overview: Sameer is at his wedding reception where Ajay Devgn is a guest. He spots his parents and gets very upset about it. Meanwhile, the bride goes missing and CID encounters a new CID officer named Jaywanti hired by DCP Chitrole.

episodes.title: Double Murder Ki Saazish
episodes.overview: Mansha is stalked by an unknown man, who shoots her dead after she leaves the mall. CID investigates the relationship between the killer and the woman.

episodes.title: Bomb Blast
episodes.overview: A car blast takes place on a deserted road and CID find 3 dead bodies. They realize that there were 3 more people at the blast site. Where are they? Why did they flee the scene without informing the cops?

episodes.title: Sar Kata Manav
episodes.overview: Ravi, while returning from a party with his family faint when he witnesses the bizarre sight of a headless biker on the highway. When he comes around, his family goes missing. He calls his friend Abhijeet for help.

episodes.title: Haunted Haveli
episodes.overview: Three girls go to a mansion that is considered haunted by the people of the colony. The owner Suraj is called from America and he decides to sell it of but before he could do so, the broker goes missing after visiting the mansion.

episodes.title: Bhootiya Boat
episodes.overview: Three friends are on a boat in the middle of the sea when they spot another boat where a girl is shot dead. An unknown man appears from the water and the three friends go missing. Will CID find them?

episodes.title: Chain Chor
episodes.overview: A 50-year-old widow who lives alone in a rented flat in a Mumbai suburban society-building is known for her fearlessness. She gets attacked by 2 men in the temple. CID are called in to investigate and a blind beggar becomes a witness.

episodes.title: Microwave Gun
episodes.overview: During a wedding anniversary party, Bunty gives food to his grandparents and gets into an argument with his mother. Meanwhile, Rakesh falls into the pool and dies. How could he die of drowning?

episodes.title: Christmas Party
episodes.overview: During a Christmas party, a man disguised as Santa enters and the host's daughter goes missing. Upon finding out they find the host's secretary dead, the CID believe the Santa to be the suspect.

episodes.title: Sher Ka Shikaar
episodes.overview: Three children get separated from the rest during a school picnic in a conundrum caused by a tiger in the forest. On investigation, C.I.D comes across an ex-forest inspector who had lost his mental stability and was off the grid for a couple of years. He informs them that there has been some tiger poaching going on. Will the C.I.D be able to put a stop on the poaching and find the lost children?

episodes.title: Nakul Returns: Part 1
episodes.overview: The city is under a terrorist attack as reported by Interpol and there is chaos in the CID bureau. The prime suspect is ACP's son Nakul who he shot 8 years ago.

episodes.title: Nakul Returns: Part 2
episodes.overview: A couple in a beach find a coat. They check the coat and finds a wallet inside it. He is shocked to see ACP Pradyuman's ID card in the wallet. Is ACP Pradyuman alright?

episodes.title: Happy New Year
episodes.overview: Ambika is embroiled in a drug deal and after escaping crossfire gets murdered in a storehouse. CID soon realize that it's not about Ambika or drugs, but a harbinger to a crime that is about to take place in the orphanage on New Year's Eve.

episodes.title: Lift Mein Khoon
episodes.overview: A very vexing case has come to the attention of the C.I.D. A wealthy businessman died in an elevator in a luxrious hotel. The elevator was ascending, when it started to malfunction, and by the time the security opened the doors of the elevator, the man inside had drowned. Will Inspector Abhijeet and his team be able to figure out this bizzare cause of death and catch the killer?

episodes.title: Auto Mein Khoon
episodes.overview: Hemant and Mona are the landlords of Reema and her daughters, Anu and Era. Reema's husband and Anu and Era's father is found dead in their own home by two unknown people. Things get worse when Anu, disguised as a taxi driver, goes after the ones who killed her father but unexpectedly makes a new friend. Watch as the CID team hunts down the killers, while a mysterious man spies on them.

episodes.title: 3 Bullet
episodes.overview: Ajit's stepmother, Kamini, is ill treated by him, so she decides to get him killed. Kamini hires Ronny, a college student, and gets a bomb fixed in his brain. Ajit kidnaps Ronny and shoots at him, but he survives the shot. Devastated, Ajit then pushes him onto the wall which triggers the bomb in his head, causing a bullet to leave his eye and hit Ajit in his, leaving both of them dead.

episodes.title: Bhootiya Mehmaan
episodes.overview: A solitary owner of a supposedly haunted house, Tarun, is found dead in the morning after his family hires a servant the night before and the rest go missing along with the servant. On investigation, C.I.D. finds traces of blood on the floor which has surreal test results and they discover the deceased had forged the identity. As the plot thickens, will C.I.D. be able to solve this case?

episodes.title: Theatre Mein Bhoot
episodes.overview: A group of actors are doing a routine rehearsal, when they come across a strange woman dressed in red. The woman appears to be a ghost, exhibiting a few supernatural powers, and promises that all of them will die. Eventully they discover the corpse of Pooja. A.C.P. Pradyuman is called to the scene, but he does not believe a ghost was responsible and intends to uncover the truth.

episodes.title: C.I.D. Ka Sankatkaal: Part 1
episodes.overview: The confines of the submarine held a lot of marine engineers in captive. After the killing and abduction of marine engineers, the C.I.D comes into action but their strive to locate the submarine and the criminals are all in vain. A.C.P. Pradyuman devices a plan to infiltrate the enemy's territory and sends in Daya, Abhijeet and Pankaj disguised as marine engineers into the danger zone.

episodes.title: Desh Ke Dushman
episodes.overview: When the whole country is celebrating Republic Day, a pack of terrorist captures a mall arena and all the citizens present in it, in demand to release a deadly terrorist. Elsewhere a school bus is being seized by other brothers of the same terrorist gang, kidnapping the school students. How will the CID crew act in such turmoil? Will they be able to save the citizens and children together?

episodes.title: Daya Khatre Mein
episodes.overview: While helping a poverty-stricken family, Inspector Daya gets into trouble as the cash, he donates for the well-being of the family are fake. It turns out that Daya had borrowed the money from his friend Vijay, but when Daya along with his senior inspector visits Vijay to enquire, they find him murdered. So they start a further investigation and what gets revealed is far mysterious than assumed.

episodes.title: Khatre Mein Milly Aur Tina
episodes.overview: When a housewife commits suicide, ACP Pradyuman guesses right away that it is a pre-planned cold-blooded murder and later Dr Tarika's autopsy report states the same. The CID team then sets out to investigate further into the matter which leads them to the disappearance of two adolescent girls. What follows next reveals the mystery behind the murder and its connection to those missing girls.

episodes.title: White Mask
episodes.overview: Rakesh and Nirmalya, with a noble thought of re-establishing a 10-year-old orphanage, visits India. Soon they spot the age old orphanage to be haunted. The story takes an unusual turn when their son disappears during a masquerade event leaving behind a pair of shoes and a blood stained floor. Watch to find how CID takes charge of the case and unfolds the 10-year-old mystery.

episodes.title: Shera Ki Dosti
episodes.overview: The sudden entry of a wild tiger in a city locality becomes terrifying for the society. As death starts knocking the door of one house after the other, the situation turns intense when a small boy named Tinku goes missing. CID takes charge of the investigation when citizens discover a dead body in the forest. Watch to find if the suspect is truly a man-eater or some serious criminality.

episodes.title: Shark Ka Hamla
episodes.overview: A treacherous friend Raunak invites his newly married friend Preet and his wife for a mid-sea boat ride only to get Preet killed by the sharks. Two years later when a fatal incident occurs at the same place while shark viewing supervised by a tourism company, CID gets involved in the case and solves both the cases by revealing the secret scarier than the shark.

episodes.title: Varun Dhawan Khatre Mein: Part 1
episodes.overview: Varun Dhawan gets attacked by a strange-looking creature at the promotional event of one of his films. Varun saves his team but is taken away by the creature.

episodes.title: Varun Dhawan Khatre Mein: Part 2
episodes.overview: Varun Dhawan manages to escape from captivity by fighting off the goons, and rushes to CID, to try and help them with the case.

episodes.title: Fashion Show Mein Murder
episodes.overview: CID team come across a strange murder case which is linked to a fashion show and its models. The episode begins with a model, Meher, committing suicide from a roof top leaving a clue about a 'Shapit dress' and information about another model Juhi, whose life is in danger. What is the mystery behind 'Shapit dress'? Watch the thriller investigative episode, find out how CID team crack the case.

episodes.title: Jaadui Kalabaazi
episodes.overview: The episode begins with a magician entertaining the guests with his magic at the birthday party by floating a man, Pritam in the air. Later, the magician dies because of a heart attack leaving Pritam in the air. Soon, Pritam's dead body is recovered by the CID team with questions of his mysterious death. Is this actually magic or something else? Will CID team be able to solve the mystery?

episodes.title: Khatre Mein Jaadugar
episodes.overview: A famous child magician goes missing during his act, and instead of him; his father's dead body appears onstage. The secret behind the trick was only known to the father and his child, hence nobody knows how the father ended up onstage.

episodes.title: Naqaab
episodes.overview: Two friends Mayank and Vishal meet a strange girl who commits suicide from a roof top of a deserted construction site. The duo meet the same girl alive next morning when they go to meet Vishal's to be bride, Shruti. Vishal's mother ignores Vishal and get him married to Shruti. After their marriage, they find Ramu Kaka's dead body. What is Shruti's secret? Watch how CID team solve the mystery.

episodes.title: Beherupiye Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: On his way to meet Abhijeet, Daya helps an injured man and admits him in a hospital who later goes missing from the hospital. Daya meets the same injured man at an inauguration ceremony and on interrogating he claims to be a completely different person named Arjun. What is the reality behind the two similar faces with different identities? Will CID be able to solve the suspense?

episodes.title: Gaayab Jaadugar
episodes.overview: It's strange to hear that a dead man comes alive again. This is what happens in this case where a magician loses his life while performing his best magic trick. The magician vanishes and appears from all three sides but his dead body is found on the fourth side. Later, a hotel staff sees him walking to his room. What is the suspense behind the magician's life? Will CID be able to reveal the truth?

episodes.title: Prithviraj Chauhan Ka Raaz
