episodes.overview: The episode begins with a play where Sanyukta's 'swayamvar' is organised. Suddenly a strange man comes in the place of actor Sameer as a Prithviraj and stabs a man playing Jaychand and elopes with a girl playing Sanyukta and claims to be the real Prithviraj Chauhan. The CID is in shock as the criminal commits the crime in front of them and elopes with a hostage. Will CID be able to solve the case?

episodes.title: Dance C.I.D. Dance
episodes.overview: CID team gets their next assignment at the Sheesh Mahal where they enrol themselves as participants for a dance competition with other three groups. One of the participants named Era was haunted earlier and later goes missing from the venue without leaving any trace. Is Sheesh Mahal haunted? Watch to find out how team CID track criminals, led by the smallest of clues to solve the case.

episodes.title: C.I.D. V/S Super Villain
episodes.overview: The episode takes us to the movie premier of Super hero No.1 where a superhero dummy murders the movie director and elopes from the eyes of all the guests and media. CID team arrives at the crime location and begin their investigation, but couldn't get any lead. Does the criminal really possesses some super power? Watch to find out how will team CID solve the case with almost no clues.

episodes.title: Adhrushya Manav
episodes.overview: A group of friends are interrupted by a strange, and rashly driven car. When they proceed to confront the driver, they encounter a hooded man, who gently smiles, and then vanishes into thin air. Within a short duration, they see the car again, and this time, almost killing a man. When they rush the victim to safety, they overhear the victim's mother claiming that a spirit has murdered her son.

episodes.title: Khatarnak Bikers: Part 1
episodes.overview: Sheena pays a visit to the racing track and is terrified to see Gulando's racing skills. She storms off, when he doesn't pay heed to her advice of slowing down. She then encounters a racer on her way, who chases her with a gun, and falls down, when she tries to defend herself. What is the reason behind this mysterious attack?

episodes.title: Khatarnak Bikers: Part 2
episodes.overview: A group of bikers use their biking skills, to try and pull off the biggest heist of their lives. They intend to complete 'Mission ABG' on the 21st of March, but soon find themselves being chased by the CID. The CID are on their way to arrest Gulando, the leader, and several other people involved in the mission, but are mislead. Can the CID chase them down, and prevent the robbery?

episodes.title: Khooni Jungle
episodes.overview: A family's peaceful lunch is disturbed, when a severed hand falls out of the air, and lands in one of the plates. Terrified, they report it to the CID, who start investigating the initials 'R.V.' inscribed on it. Meanwhile, a lot of people are reported missing. The search behind the mysterious hand leads them deep into the forests of Phoolwari. Will they crack the mystery of the severed arm?

episodes.title: C.I.D. Ki Daud
episodes.overview: The CID group finally decide to take a break, and go on a trip to Goa, when they notice a small girl, who is badly injured. Upon further investigation, they discover a letter buried in the girl's pocket, which leads to details of the whereabouts of her father, who had been in the ICU. When they follow her father, Mayank Kumar, they are lead to a series of conspiracies surrounding him.

episodes.title: Ali Ki Khalbali: Part 1
episodes.overview: Actor Ali Asgar is horrified, when he sees a dead body in a matrimonial costume, lying in his car. Clearly terrified and indecisive, he drives the body back to the shooting spot, but is unable to get his mind off it. He even dreams of Daya slapping him for giving lame excuses. Will Ali Asgar be able to draw himself out of the sticky mess he is in?

episodes.title: Byomkesh Bakshi Ki Talaash
episodes.overview: In Mumbai, a woman is stalked by strangers and on her birthday party night, the stalker, Naina and her husband are killed. And in Bengal, an elderly man who is waiting for his nephew Byomkesh Bakshi dies seemingly by heart attack.

episodes.title: D.C.P. Chitrole Ki Shaadi
episodes.overview: CID is transferring a big criminal from Mumbai to Delhi but they get embroiled in a murder and suspended. Meanwhile DCP Chitrole has been meeting a beautiful young woman Vishakha. He shocks the cops by announcing he's marrying her.

episodes.title: Jaanbaaz Mr. X
episodes.overview: Marco, an illusion artist tells everyone that he will jump and swim in the pool, and he will reappear at the top of the terrace to prove TELEPORTATION as a fact. As Marco dives, he disappears. Marco falls off the building and he dies.

episodes.title: C.I.D. In Train: Part 1
episodes.overview: During a gang shootout, a goon survives and escapes as something explodes. Dr. Salunkhe finds a train ticket from the dead man's pockets which leads CID to go to the platform in disguise. They find out that a drug deal was on the books.

episodes.title: C.I.D. In Train: Part 2
episodes.overview: A drug deal on the train journey from Mumbai to Goa. But they don't know who the criminals are and where and when the drugs would be exchanged. Is it only a drug deal or is it something more?

episodes.title: Telekinesis
episodes.overview: Amyra has a fight with one of her colleagues Meera when a chandelier mysteriously almost comes crashing down on her. That night, her roommate sees Amyra being flung towards the ceiling from her window.

episodes.title: Khatre Mein Masoom
episodes.overview: Sr. Inspector Abhijeet finds a young boy named Sunny in a forest whose parents are missing after a tragic car accident. Sunny also describes about a mysterious woman with a knife who tried to stab him earlier in his house. There are many unanswered questions in front of the CID team with very few leads in their hands. Watch how the team of expertise unfold all the hidden secrets to solve the case.

episodes.title: Maut Ka Chakravyuh: Part 1
episodes.overview: Sanjana disappears mysteriously and the last person she contacted was her boss. When CID reach the spot, they're told that she never worked there, and no one recognizes her. They find a secret access card to a vault on the 13th floor.

episodes.title: Maut Ka Chakravyuh: Part 2
episodes.overview: Dr. Salunkhe manages to save Daya after the building collapsed. Abhijeet, Daya, Sachin and Purvi have suffered various injuries but insist on staying in the field. They find a dead body inside the vault and an entrance to a long tunnel.

episodes.title: Maut Ka Chakravyuh: Part 3
episodes.overview: Sanjana managed to escape but her brother has been captured and she's asked to hand over a briefcase because of which she was kidnapped. Abhijeet and Daya break open the briefcase to find a photo of a man who had come for a competition.

episodes.title: Maut Ki Baarish
episodes.overview: During an event, a white cloud forms out of nowhere and it rains fire raindrops on people melting them to death. CID realize that it's a planned acid rain attack using the technique of cloud seeding. Will they find the culprit?

episodes.title: A.C.P. In Hospital
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman gets admitted for a minor operation and the attending nurse Gayatri disappears. He begins to look for her and stumbles upon the dead bodies of Gayatri and Dr. Sameer. Daya and Abhijeet discover an organ trade racket.

episodes.title: C.I.D. Mein Daraar: Part 1
episodes.overview: A robbery has taken place in a Jewelry Shop and a man is found dead. DCP Chitrole has divided the CID into teams telling them to solve the case differently. Amidst the investigation, DCP also tries to create difficulty for them.

episodes.title: C.I.D. Mein Daraar: Part 2
episodes.overview: Priya, who shot the DCP is caught and she confesses to stealing the diamonds. Further investigation shows the real culprits responsible for the robbery. Did DCP survive the gun shot? Will the CID be able to recover the stolen diamonds?

episodes.title: Khauffnaak Apradh
episodes.overview: Rekha has returned back home from her business trip. She was very excited and wanted to surprise her father Deen Dayal. However, Rekha has arrived few days earlier than her scheduled business trip itinerary. She went on searching for her father but he was not there. She asked her neighbors about her father whereabouts but didn't get any satisfactory answers from them. On returning back into her house she again started looking for her father. This time she went into the store room and found his dead body wrapped in a plastic sheet. Her father was dead. But who has murder him? Why was Deen Dayal killed? Will Team CID nab the culprit? To know all keep watching full episode.

episodes.title: C.I.D. In Delhi
episodes.overview: Sonali and Kundan get attacked in Haus Khas in Delhi by a group of goons. They kill Kundan but Sonali manages to escape and boards a train to Mumbai. CID find out about it when the train reaches Mumbai and the girl is found dead.

episodes.title: C.I.D. In Agra
episodes.overview: CID get an info that a contract killer named Keshav, living in Agra, has a new target, but they don't know who the target is. When the cops catch him, he informs them that he has passed the contract to another killer, Ravi who is murdered.

episodes.title: C.I.D. In Mathura
episodes.overview: A kid asks CID for help and informs them that his parents Ajay and Natasha are missing in Mathura and they could be in trouble. When they reach Mathura, they find out that Natasha and Ajay are searching for Natasha's parents.

episodes.title: Hostel Mein Ragging
episodes.overview: A young boy dressed in a woman's clothes is found hanged in the college. CID find out that he was brutally ragged before he killed himself. They interrogate everyone behind the ragging, but is ragging really the reason behind his death?

episodes.title: Daya Abhijeet Ki Dosti
episodes.overview: 3 dead bodies are found tied down in a jute sack. It is revealed that all 3 of them were partying in the same club the night they were killed. When the CID interrogate everyone from the club, they find out that Daya too was present there.

episodes.title: Hawai Jahaz Par Maut Ka Keher
Behrupiya Biwi
episodes.overview: While Karan is on-stage during a press conference, a woman named Radhika meets him and claims to be his first wife, though Karan does not recognize her. Later, Karan's second wife, Anita, is found dead.

episodes.title: Khalnayak
episodes.overview: Kushal saved an unknown girl who later turns out to be one of his friend's girlfriend, Roshani. Kushal's friend and Roshani's boyfriend, Sid, planned a way to defame Kushal and made Roshani a part of it. Later Roshani is killed.

episodes.title: Lift To Death
episodes.overview: A residential building's lift gets stuck. A boy and a gravely injured man with a gun are trapped in it. CID manage to save the boy, but the lift plummets to the ground. The boy tells CID that the man said someone will die tonight at 10 pm.

episodes.title: Jhagdalu Aurat
episodes.overview: Shobha lives in an apartment with her family. Her bad temperament has stained her family's name and people of her society despised her. One day Shobha is found dead in her house. Who killed Shobha? Was the family involved?

episodes.title: Coffin Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: Kilori lives with her husband Vikram. She finds out that her ex-husband Jagan, who was living in London with their 3 children was dead. The children were flying the body back to India, but only the coffin arrived. Where are the children?

episodes.title: Samundar Mein Khoon
episodes.overview: Sunil was assigned to kill a woman named Ankita while she was partying on a boat in the sea. However, he missed and hit Ankita's husband. Moreover, when CID nabbed him, they were shocked to know that he was forced to do it. Who forced him?

episodes.title: Forensic Clue
episodes.overview: A dead body is found in a car belonging to Harish. CID questions him regarding the body but he repeatedly pleads that he is innocent. Meanwhile, Dr. Salunkhe is trying to unveil this murder mystery with the help of his forensic expertise.

episodes.title: Hotel Red Star
episodes.overview: Shera, a criminal was on the verge of revealing dark secrets about the underworld and details about an attack plan. On the day of revelation, Shera feels an intense pain in his head and collapses. Who could be behind Shera's death?

episodes.title: Ek Anokha Qatil
episodes.overview: A friendly picnic turns deadly when one of the friends Naman is found dead in the vicinity of the farmhouse. The CID find out that he was heinously attacked by poisonous bees which resulted in his death.

episodes.title: Chamakta Kankaal
episodes.overview: Anurag and a young girl meet in a restaurant and exchange a package and a brief case. After leaving, he was on his way to execute the deal but he meets with an accident midway while driving. Anurag's wife suspects it to be a murder.

episodes.title: Ghayal
episodes.overview: The CID find Akhil injured at his own house. Before dying, he takes the name Ajay Mehra. Ajay Mehra is protecting a girl named Malini who's being chased by Akhil's killers. Why do they want Malini's bag? Which code is in Akhil's house?

episodes.title: Dongara Ki Wapsi
episodes.overview: A business tycoon in London receives a call from a private number that his wife's life is at stake. He rushes but gets killed in a car explosion. Back in India, a famous actress's husband gets murdered outside an airport.

episodes.title: Karo Ya Maro
episodes.overview: An old enemy of CID Harpes Dongara comes back. On the other hand, the CID team gets strict orders to solve any case within 24 hours. Will CID catch Harpes again?

episodes.title: Karo Ya Maro
episodes.overview: Dr. Salunkhe is dying because of some contagious viral infection. He gets infected through a dead body in which some chemical tubes are implanted.

episodes.title: Khooni Haveli
episodes.overview: Princess Ashima returns to her ancestral property to turn it into a heritage hotel. However to her shock, she is told that the mansion is cursed. In between, everything goes for a toss for the cops when Katori Damta shoots himself in jail.

episodes.title: Karo Ya Maro
episodes.overview: A man named Ravi's dead body is found hanging in the air, in a container yard tied with heart-shaped balloons. Moreover, team CID has come to know about the love triangle. Could this be one of the possible motives behind the murder?

episodes.title: Karo Ya Maro
episodes.overview: A drug smuggling racket is busted. The smugglers have abducted a young boy named Ashu and murdered Meena. Ashu's sister Aanya had a map which was hidden in her teddy. Will CID save Ashu?

episodes.title: Karo Ya Maro
episodes.overview: An apparition of a Rani tries to scare everybody. As the story unfolds, the valuable necklace of the Rani is stolen. Meanwhile, recurring murders intrigue the interest. CID digs deeper into the investigation. Will they catch the culprit?

episodes.title: Karo Ya Maro
episodes.overview: Daya and Abhijeet are accused of theft. They are on a run to save their lives and seek refuge at a couple's house. Meanwhile, a local goon who has hijacked a bus blackmails the duo in return of a box they had stolen.

episodes.title: Karo Ya Maro
episodes.overview: A couple requests a man to let their child go but is soon shot at. The child of the couple agrees to kill a CID Inspector. After Daya is attacked, he loses his memory and the CID gets concerned about it. Will Daya get his memory back?

episodes.title: Karo Ya Maro
episodes.overview: A man is stabbed to death by a sharp knife. However, Team CID has reached the spot and they have started investigating the case by considering it to be their top priority. Will they find the killer?

episodes.title: Karo Ya Maro
episodes.overview: Firgun Darchi, a sculptor had been handed Nebratamba for safe-keeping. Katori sends his man Vicky to look for it but Firgun fights them and makes them into love statues. Meanwhile, Ninja warriors attack the studio and Vicky gets killed.

episodes.title: Karo Ya Maro
episodes.overview: A group of friends enter a restricted area where they're attacked. They somehow escape. Meanwhile, CID is investigating the precious thing that Katori wants and as soon as they open it the entire room gets filled with a white light.

episodes.title: Karo Ya Maro
episodes.overview: A young woman named Ayesha is murdered after she is approached by a man in a restaurant where she was impatiently waiting for someone. CID is called in to investigate and find the murderer of Ayesha. Will they find him?

episodes.title: Karo Ya Maro
episodes.overview: A fake princess Tilottama reports that her niece Ayesha has been killed. However, after thorough investigation CID gets to know that Ayesha was trapped by Dolly. Moreover, it is revealed that Katori and Tilottama work for each other.

episodes.title: Khufia Gang
episodes.overview: A dead body is found in a jungle. The dead body had a secret mark on his arm. Natasha and his Fiancée Vishal both are the witnesses of the case and also the target of Chaku Daku Gang.

episodes.title: Bahadur Bacche
episodes.overview: Two school children are abducted by miscreants but with their valour, they manage to escape the trap and inform CID about this who then begin their investigation to nab the culprits.

episodes.title: Rahasyamayi Aurat
episodes.overview: Vikram is followed to his building by one of his neighbours and he doesn't look normal at all. Within moments, he reaches the top and jumps. When the CID investigate, they come to know about the mysterious woman who foretold his death.

episodes.title: Rahasya 150 Saal Purani Kitaab Ka
episodes.overview: Fishermen find an unconscious man on a boat, who tells them someone has been behind his life since winning the Diary of a Spanish Ship Captain. CID are called to solve the mystery.

episodes.title: Bank Robbery
episodes.overview: Four youths make a master plan to rob a bank after getting inspired after watching a movie. The robbers has held the employees captive and looted the bank. They have also fired a bullet on a woman, who is an employee of the bank.

episodes.title: Dream Murder
episodes.overview: A writer dreams regularly in his sleep about a girl getting killed while partying in a pub. Mentally disturbed, his friends suggest him to go to Goa to relax. To his horror, there he spots the same waiter and the girl who he dreamt of.

episodes.title: Thak Thak Gang
episodes.overview: Ajay gets shot dead in his own automobile in broad daylight. Team CID discovers that Ajay may have been fatally shot at close range. Daya is informed by Jyoti that Ajay has pledged to wed her. Unexpectedly, ACP Pradyuman now believes Jyoti was responsible for killing Ajay. Do you wish to learn more about the case? Then keep watching to learn more.

episodes.title: Raaz Anjaan Bacche Ka
episodes.overview: Manju, a maid at Vishal's house, becomes suspicious after seeing a boy in his house. She and her colleagues investigate, finding the boy in a pool of blood, leading the CID to suspect Vishal being involved in child trafficking.

episodes.title: Raaz Apaharan Ki Saazish Ka
episodes.overview: Surekha kidnaps Muskan to steal money from her husband, but the CID discovers her husband's extra-marital affair, leaving Muskan missing. The CID must find her.

episodes.title: Khatarnak Jungle
episodes.overview: The CID are called to investigate a murder case involving a group of friends, Sameer and Vanshika, who accidentally lost their way in the jungle and found a charred human arm.

episodes.title: Daya Ka Ateet
episodes.overview: CID investigate Kavita's death, finding a letter on her body. They find Daya, who doesn't recognize colleagues, and question his identity and the murderer of Kavita.

episodes.title: Raaz Bandh Kamre Mein Khoon Ka
Tohfa
episodes.overview: Anita asks Gaurav to hand over a parcel to Niyati. She and Gaurav get shocked to see a human hand in it. CID reach her house after hearing of her death. Gaurav tells them a demon has killed her. They find out that she's Shamsher's sister.

episodes.title: Kanchola Ka Darr
episodes.overview: Shivani and Vansh, a young couple adopt an orphan named Abeer. One day, Abeer goes missing. Shivani requests team CID to find him. However, they find Vansh, dead. They're soon contacted by an unknown person who demands a ransom for Abeer.

episodes.title: Wapsi
episodes.overview: Siddhant's three friends get murdered while jogging in a garden. Forensic analysis reveals that they were killed by arrows. CID meet Siddhant's new neighbour Rupa, who informs them that her husband had brought a box of arrows.

episodes.title: Raaz Khopdi Ka
episodes.overview: Kanika, Sheena and Mehek meet with an accident while travelling in a car. Mehek rushes to a nearby post office to ask for help, but instead gets shocked to see a lone human skull. Who does the skull belong to and why was it there?

episodes.title: Rahasya Adrushya Khooni Ka
episodes.overview: Alok dies mysteriously in his house. CID are surprised to discover that he was allegedly killed by an 'invisible person'. They rush to Karjat, to Alok's farmhouse but only find another dead body there. Who is behind these strange murders?

episodes.title: Dulhan
episodes.overview: Sushila finds a mysterious woman dressed up like a bride walking in her house and calls for help. Avinash rushes to the scene, revealing that the woman is his wife, Rashmi. Soon, Sushila finds Avinash's dead body outside of her house.

episodes.title: Do Masoom Shikaar
episodes.overview: Anjali is found dead inside her house. Sudha informs the CID that she had kept 2 newborn babies in Abhijeet's car. Daya and his colleague find the car in a jungle. Abhijeet saves the babies from a few goons.

episodes.title: Rahasyamayi Beti
episodes.overview: Bhushan and his relatives gather in a farmhouse for Himani's death anniversary. They get shocked to see her alive assumes her to be a look-alike of his daughter.

episodes.title: Laash Mein Hathyar
episodes.overview: Tina shouts at her husband Danny's funeral and tells everyone that he was not a good man and had an affair with his secretary. Suddenly the dead body in the coffin starts moving. How is it moving and, who did this to him?

episodes.title: Muqabla
episodes.overview: Anshul and his friends prepare for a swimming competition. A villager finds Anshul's dead body floating in a pond. Team CID finds out that Anshul had jumped into the pond in search of diamonds.

episodes.title: Raaz Adrishya Padosi Ka
episodes.overview: Three men, Amar, Ruhan and Sanjay's dead bodies are found in an apartment, next to a woman named Kinjal, who is sitting beside them with an iron rod in her hand. CID learn that Kinjal suffers from split personality disorder.

episodes.title: Cop Ya Qatil?
episodes.overview: Team CID suspects Abhijeet in Ghanashyam's shooting death, citing past threats. Despite claiming innocence, ACP Pradyuman must uncover the truth to prove Abhijeet's innocence.

episodes.title: Sahi Timing
episodes.overview: CID catch a gang of robbers who kill with iron rods and interrogate them. They insist that someone else killed two of the people they've been accused of killing. Forensic analysis reveals that someone else is trying to copy the gang.

episodes.title: Happy New Year
episodes.overview: The CID team come to a New Year's Eve party. DJ Dash suffers a heart attack in the party. CID find a pen drive while investigating. They listen to a phone conversation recorded in the pen drive which leads to a startling revelation.

episodes.title: Kaanch Ke Paar
episodes.overview: Nirjar is an overbearing businessman. When his servant Monu breaks an expensive glass by mistake, Nirjar insults him. Nirjar suddenly gets murdered by wounds on his neck. Nirjar's family blames Monu for Nirjar's death.

episodes.title: Bhavishyavani
episodes.overview: A famous astrologer Bhanukar is found dead in his office. The CID learn that Bhanukar used to predict accurate future for his clients. Bhanukar's colleagues inform that a client called Bindu was present at the time of his death.

episodes.title: Statue
episodes.overview: A chef collapses to his death during shooting for a 'mannequin challenge' in the restaurant.

episodes.title: Rahasyamay Aatmahatya
episodes.overview: Viraj is a social activist who is under constant threat of being killed by his enemies. A couple watch him jumping off a bridge into a river. They assume that it's a suicide. However, CID somehow find out that Viraj has been murdered.

episodes.title: Band Aankhen
episodes.overview: Rohit invites his girlfriend Megha to his bungalow. Next morning CID find Megha's dead body near Varun's construction site. They investigate and learn that Varun is Rohit's close friend. Rohit clears it to CID that he has not killed Megha.

episodes.title: Raaz Nakli Pistol Aur Asli Goli Ka
episodes.overview: Kyra is a famous actress who is in a mall for the inauguration of a shop. An anonymous person guns down Kyra in the mall. CID learn that Kyra was killed by a ghost gun.

episodes.title: Khooni Courier
episodes.overview: Monika receives a courier from an anonymous person. When her husband comes home, he gets shocked to see her lying dead in the living room.

episodes.title: Maut Ki Dastak
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman's friend Kunal is a crime journalist. One day, Kunal falls unconscious in a hospital. The ACP learns that a martial arts practitioner had secretly injured Kunal in the past.

episodes.title: Apradh Ki Awaaz
episodes.overview: CID find Rajiv's dead body in his house. Rajiv's wife tells them that Rajiv had suspected paranormal activities in his apartment. Rajiv's neighbours inform the CID that Rajiv had seen Lallan's ghost in his house.

episodes.title: Maut Ka Muqabla
episodes.overview: Akash invites Daya to play football with his friends. Akash's opponent Dino dies after a brawl with Daya on the field. Dino's sister blames Daya for Dino's death.

episodes.title: Filmy Murder
episodes.overview: Director duo Abbas-Mustan host premiere of their new movie 'Machine' in a theatre. While screening of the movie, a person called Ayan gets murdered inside the theatre hall.

episodes.title: Maut Ka Video
episodes.overview: Dhiraj is a famous social media enthusiast. An anonymous person kills him in front of camera and broadcasts the video on his social media account.

episodes.title: Vasiyat Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: A rich businessman dies under mysterious circumstances. CID learn that he had feared that he might get killed by his family members for his property. Will CID be able to prove it as murder by investigating his ashes?

episodes.title: Jungle Ka Kehar
episodes.overview: Senior forest officer Kartik allegedly gets killed by a wild animal. Daya meets his colleagues to investigate the case.

episodes.title: Khoon Ki Saazish
episodes.overview: Dr. Ranjeet dies during his heart surgery. The hospital staff tells team CID that Dr. Ranjeet must have been murdered during the operation. While investigating, The CID learn that Dr. Ranjeet was involved in illegal organ transplants.

episodes.title: Khooni Safar: Part 1
episodes.overview: An anonymous person throws Manish off a moving train leading to his death. CID reach the place to investigate and find a few diamonds from Manish's pants.

episodes.title: Khooni Safar: Part 2
episodes.overview: CID plan to travel in a train to find out the murderer. ACP Pradyuman learns that an anonymous person had kidnapped Vishwas.

episodes.title: Samundar Mein Laash
episodes.overview: A helicopter blasts in mid-air before it crashes into a sea. Few fishermen rush to rescue the survivors. CID learn that a businessman was in the helicopter when the incident took place. While investigating, they find the fishermen dead.

episodes.title: Durghatana Ya Aparadh
episodes.overview: A speeding car rams into a tree on a busy street. CID find a dead body in the car. They soon learn that the death is not due to the accident. While investigating, they find out that the man was drugged before the incident.

episodes.title: Bhootiya Lift
episodes.overview: Amit goes missing after he enters the lift of his apartment. Residents think that a spirit of an old woman who was found dead in her house six months ago has killed Amit.

episodes.title: Rahasya Gayab Logon Ka
episodes.overview: Pankaj's friend Snehal goes missing while travelling by her car. He requests the ACP to help him find her. Team CID learn that the GPS of Snehal's car was hacked by an anonymous person. Will CID be able to find Snehal?

episodes.title: Agni Pariksha
episodes.overview: Dilip's family get shock of their life when he gets burnt to death in a party. Team CID learn that Dilip and his business partner Rohan were responsible for a nine years old criminal case. Will CID be able to find the murderer?

episodes.title: Khooni Sapna
episodes.overview: Raima and her husband Sunil are in a hotel to attend a wedding. Raima while trying to sleep sees a murder and she informs CID. Sunil tells them that she has sleep paralysis. Team CID go undercover in the hotel to investigate.

episodes.title: Phone Ka Dhamaka
episodes.overview: An actor holds a mobile phone near his face while shooting for its ad. The mobile explodes and catches fire leading to his death. The mobile phone company head blames the rival company.

episodes.title: Pocket Maar Gang
episodes.overview: A few pickpockets mysteriously get killed. CID recover a radioactive detector machine from one. They meet a person who portrays himself as a RAW agent. He tells them that a pickpocket has stolen nuclear secrets from a government agency.

episodes.title: Raaz Dhamake Ka
episodes.overview: A lunatic student explodes a bomb in front of his college. CID recover a skeleton from the scene. Salunkhe informs the ACP that the deceased died about 2 years ago. How is it possible?

episodes.title: Teen Katil
episodes.overview: Nikhil's friends find him dead in a resort. Salunkhe informs the ACP that Nikhil was killed by three people. Nikhil's friends inform the CID that Nikhil had organized a party in the resort. Was it someone from the party who killed Nikhil?

episodes.title: Haveli Ka Shraap
episodes.overview: A woman calls the CID and informs that her fiancé, Raj, is dead due to bee sting and suspects that he was killed. CID arrive at the mansion where Raj died. They discover that he had received a death threat. Who wanted to kill Raj and why?

episodes.title: Aalap Alpviram
episodes.overview: KD mysteriously dies during his recording inside the studio. The CID team learns that KD was addicted to narcotics and suspect that his addiction might have caused his death. Dr. Salunkhe finds the presence of poisonous substances.

episodes.title: Maut Ka Sandesh
episodes.overview: Tina receives a text message warning that the taxi in which she is travelling is not safe. Panicked, she asks the driver to stop but in vain. The next day her dead body is found on the road and CID are called in to investigate.

episodes.title: Smartphone Khooni
episodes.overview: Kartik, an entrepreneur is killed in a car accident. CID however find out that his death was a cold-blooded murder. Kartik had designed the world's cheapest smartphone, aimed at the masses thus having multiple suspects in the case for CID.

episodes.title: Qatl Ya Khudkhushi
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman receives a phone call from Bala, who has been on the run for over a decade. He offers to surrender on one condition that CID must reopen the case of his daughter's death which was declared a suicide. Will CID help Bala?

episodes.title: Bala Ki Wapsi
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman suspects that Bala's life is in danger. While investigating a murder, meanwhile, Abhijeet behaves indifferently due to a chemical and Bala has come to surrender. How will CID solve the mystery?

episodes.title: Pyaar Ka Junoon
episodes.overview: Riya receives messages on social media where she's threatened with dire consequences if she doesn't reciprocate his feelings. She seeks help from the CID. But before they can dig deep into the case, Riya is found dead with her throat slit.

episodes.title: Juaari
episodes.overview: A gambling conman Siddharth is killed in a bungalow. His pictures were put out on all the newspapers. Three people come forward saying they had lost money while gambling with him.

episodes.title: Raaz Bandh Building Ka
episodes.overview: An old building is about to be detonated, when suddenly a man, sneaks into the building seconds before the detonation to look for his missing cat. To his horror he discovers a corpse hidden in a corner.

episodes.title: Apaharan
episodes.overview: A young woman wakes up to a disturbing social media news feed from Anchal, which informs about her murder and her daughter Aria's kidnapping. The lady calls the CID. They discover that Aria is having critical health issues.

episodes.title: Antim Khushi
episodes.overview: An argument breaks out between 2 men during a stand-up comedy event. Next day, a man is found dead in his office. When the CID comes, they discover that the dead man is laughing. What could have led to his death with a grin on his face?

episodes.title: Khooni Safar
episodes.overview: The CID is baffled with an intriguing mystery proving impossible to solve. Meanwhile, another murder mystery takes the CID team into its vortex. A woman is found dead. The autopsy reveals that the woman was suffocated.

episodes.title: Bhayanak Raat
episodes.overview: The CID see a stabbed woman in the middle of the road. Daya and Abhijeet look around in the nearby bungalow and find more corpses and a woman claiming to be Sunny's sister who tells him he's trying to kill her.

episodes.title: Maut Ka Khel
episodes.overview: Preeti, a computer science teacher stumbles upon a dangerous game of death on the internet. She tries to investigate the game to help a friend, but in the end becomes a victim of the game itself. Will CID be able to solve the mystery?

episodes.title: Reth Mein Chhupa Raaz
episodes.overview: Kamal, a well-known novelist, is found buried in sand on a beach. Kamal's wife tells CID that he used to go to isolated beaches to write his novels. On examining, Dr. Salunkhe finds two types of sand on Kamal's body.

episodes.title: Ajeeb Gawah
episodes.overview: Sarika suffers from a rare brain disorder in which she can only see half side of a person. The CID is called after her aunt is killed and she's attacked, and they suspect her family members. Sarika is the sole witness in the case.

episodes.title: Forensic Gutthi
episodes.overview: Dr. Salunkhe's friend Keshav's wife and son hear an explosion and immediately run towards the bathroom and find him dead in his bathtub to their shock. Autopsy reveals Keshav had a broken spine and internal organs were ruptured.

episodes.title: Apaharan
episodes.overview: 3 top executives of a renowned MNC are kidnapped by two masked men who are demanding 50 crores in uncut diamond. One of the executives gets killed. Daya finds out that the video of one officer being killed is shown in every news channel.

episodes.title: Adrishya Khooni
episodes.overview: Abhijeet's old friend from crime branch gets murdered in front of his eyes but there is no killer in the room. Very soon another old co-worker of his gets killed by an invisible killer in an art house.

episodes.title: Baal Chor
episodes.overview: A 'Mysterious Force' is cutting off womens' hair. Women are terrified to venture out at night. The attacks continue to escalate and finally result in a young woman's death.

episodes.title: Aanko Ka Raaz: Part 1
episodes.overview: 2 youngsters are killed after they find a mysterious shortwave radio station. The murder case leads CID into the shadowy world of Numbers Station, an antiquated method used in the World War era by military forces to transmit coded orders.

episodes.title: Aanko Ka Raaz: Part 2
episodes.overview: CID get an inkling of a bomb explosion. The trail leads them to a place called Black Forest. However, when they arrive at the said spot, no such explosion takes place. Something very strange occurs as cops discover an abandoned shack.

episodes.title: Saaza E Maut
episodes.overview: Two judges are in a clubhouse. Someone sends them a package with something mysterious that ends up killing both of them. CID have to find out from a plethora of disgruntled lawyers and criminals who had the strongest motive for the murder.

episodes.title: Maut Ka Sandesh
episodes.overview: Sameer is chatting with a mysterious woman who has added him recently. Just before they're about to meet, she sends strange pictures of his girlfriend Tina. Sameer rushes to her house in panic but finds her murdered. Who is this woman?

episodes.title: Pankaj Ka Faisla
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman accuses Pankaj as the only suspect in a murder case. Abhijeet gets furious on ACP. But ACP always doubts them when they're related directly or indirectly in the case. Will ACP lift his accusation on Pankaj?

episodes.title: Ped Mein Kankaal
episodes.overview: ACP, Daya and Abhijeet are in for a shock when they find graffiti scrawled across the walls of their homes. They begin their hunt for the person who wrote it, and for this allegedly murdered Sanjana Prakash. Who is Sanjana Prakash?

episodes.title: Khatarnak Abhijeet
episodes.overview: Abhijeet has been behaving very strangely after returning from a work trip in Delhi. He realizes he's suffering from a strange form of amnesia and hires a private detective to keep an eye on him 24x7. Will Abhijeet find out the truth?

episodes.title: Khooni Ghar
episodes.overview: Two high-profile tycoons have been killed by a kind of smart home run by a programmed voice that control electronics and appliances. CID realize that someone has tampered the system to be able to murder these people. But why?

episodes.title: Daya Ek Hatyara
episodes.overview: At the ransom exchange to save a kidnapped child, Daya shoots and kills the kidnapper by mistake, putting the kid's life is in danger. To make things worse, Daya is arrested for killing the man, though he insists that he didn't kill him.

episodes.title: Woh Kaun Tha
episodes.overview: Ranjan, a wealthy man, and his wife Sulekha are accused of dumped a dead woman in a lake, leading Ranjan to call CID for investigation. He's confused about if he's telling the truth or playing strange games.

episodes.title: Akash Mein Khoon
episodes.overview: Three people are involved in a private plane crash which kills all three and the pilot is nowhere to be found. The wives of the three dead approach CID to investigate the case after they tell CID that they were getting death threats a few days before the flight crashed.

episodes.title: Putle Ki Maut
episodes.overview: A headless body of a woman is found in the workshop of a boutique. CID identify the woman and begin to investigate her private life and find that she apparently lived several secret lives under different names.

episodes.title: Khatarnak Din
episodes.overview: CID finally has a lead on the head of The Eye, the identity of their best hacker, Ajinkya. CID trail him and are about to catch him when, Ex-CID officer Shreya shows up with an IB team, also trying to catch Ajinkya.

episodes.title: C.I.D. Bees Saal Baad
episodes.overview: CID team has finally found and arrested the leader of The Eye but it is not over yet. They plan to transport him to a secret safe house to question him. But still, they are ambushed en route. Can CID overcome this obstacle after 20 years?

episodes.title: Waapsi
episodes.overview: A Mumbai colony experiences terror as a headless kidnapper returns after 12 years of death. CID investigates, finding residents convinced of the supernatural killer's identity, questioning if there's more to the story.

episodes.title: Paryavaran Prem
episodes.overview: Someone is wandering around the city, murdering people. CID find that the victims are people who were harming the environment. The killer disappears without a trace every time he's about to be caught.

episodes.title: Drugs Ki Taskari
episodes.overview: A couple staying in a hotel for their honeymoon is arrested by the police after drugs are found in their suitcase. The same day, CID inspects the dead body of a man who died in a club after a drug overdose. How are the incidents connected?

episodes.title: Chaal
episodes.overview: An old man witnesses a young girl being stabbed in the building opposite, but upon investigation, no signs of death or violence are found, raising questions about the victim.

episodes.title: Khooni Chaal
episodes.overview: Four young goons kidnap a wealthy man, who is later found dead. CID investigates murders of the kidnappers, questioning motives and potential innocence.

episodes.title: Darr Ki Awaaz
episodes.overview: A suicide helpline receives a call from a pregnant woman claiming to have committed suicide, but CID's forensic analysis reveals a murder being disguised as a suicide.

episodes.title: Khatarnak Qatil
episodes.overview: CID investigate a sinister cult targeting vulnerable individuals online, causing random murders without connection. They must find perpetrators before innocent people are massacred, as no one knows who has been targeted.

episodes.title: Khel Suraag Ka
episodes.overview: Dr. Salunkhe receives a gift card to a murder scene but discovers that it's evidence from stolen cases. Suspended, he pleads innocence, and CID wonders if they can solve the case without Salunkhe's help.

episodes.title: Khooni Aasmaan
episodes.overview: A paraglider and a trekker get shot while paragliding. CID are particularly confused by this case, because at such a height, there's no vantage point to take aim at the victims from. No chopper, no cable car, no plane or any flying object.

episodes.title: Muft Delivery
episodes.overview: Delivery boys of shopping websites are getting killed. CID find out that the victims are all being killed after being called to an abandoned location, leaving no clues for them to investigate.

episodes.title: Sach Ya Sapna
episodes.overview: Komal has been having strange nightmares about a woman, a house, a man and a murder. Her parents think it's some kind of mental illness but she insists that it's going to happen. She paints all the nightmares and takes them to the CID.

episodes.title: Chor Ke Khoon Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: Tony is killed mysteriously in his office by an unknown assailant. Dr. Salunkhe discovers strange coins in his stomach which the killer had fed him for some reason before killing him.

episodes.title: Mukhota Mein Khooni
episodes.overview: A masked man imitating from a popular TV show is stabbing random people in the city. The CID team find two young men are puppets, with someone else controlling their actions.

episodes.title: Nadi Mein Laash
episodes.overview: A group of fishermen are out on a fishing trip at a river. They cast their net and are surprised to find stacks of currency notes. They cast their net wider and to their shock, find 2 dead bodies as well.

episodes.title: Andher Nagari
episodes.overview: A new, murderous presence haunts the city, mystifying the CID after leaving a dead industrialist in its wake. The CID suspect a skilled, purposeful assassin using an ancient weapon and a Japanese connection.

episodes.title: Khooni Tasveer
episodes.overview: A wealthy couple anonymously receive a photoshopped family photo frame on their wedding anniversary. It has been sent by a photographer who is brutally killed. CID are on the case and realize that there is a dangerous family secret in it.

episodes.title: Daya Lapata
episodes.overview: CID investigates a double suicide case, where a husband shoots his wife and kills himself. Daya goes missing, and cops trace him to a baby trafficking ring.

episodes.title: Maut Ka Khel
episodes.overview: Cops find a strange man covered in blood. They find strange tattoos and symbols on his body pointing to 4 missing people. Cops need to solve these clues and find these people before it's too late and find who's behind all of this.

episodes.title: Hawai Jahaz Mein Khoon
episodes.overview: Abhijeet is on board a plane where a man is killed by a deadly nerve agent. There is a killer on board and every passenger is in danger. CID must race against time to solve a mystery and find the perpetrators and save the many lives.

episodes.title: Apaharan
episodes.overview: When a young boy goes missing for days, CID spring into action, only to find the kidnapper himself murdered in an ambulance. Soon after, the boy returns with a long stitch across his abdomen, but none of his organs are missing.

episodes.title: Jaadui Khooni
episodes.overview: A famous illusionist Zoravar is proven a fraud at his own show by a mysterious man by the name of Ilesh and hours later, the man is killed in a supernatural way. Everyone is baffled. CID has to prove that it's a human murder only.

episodes.title: Majboor Khooni
episodes.overview: Two murders: one in a disco and another in a café. The common thing in them is that when they were being killed, the murderer told the victims to run away. Why?

episodes.title: Chalti Gaadi Mein Maut
episodes.overview: A woman was shot in a moving vehicle, and her ex-husband was unaware. CID discovers she was shot from a nearby building, using a delaying tactic for a perfect aim.

episodes.title: Ichchadhari Saap Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: CID have been called to investigate a very strange case where the victim's mother believes that the killer is a dead snake's spirit. The cops don't believe it, but all their investigations lead back to this mysterious snake.

episodes.title: 100 Saal Baad
episodes.overview: Behram was a dreaded serial killer who killed hundreds of people a century ago. Now after all these years, a ruthless, psychotic killer who considers Behram his guru, is replicating his horrific crimes.

episodes.title: Adrushya Khooni
episodes.overview: A man with an organ transplant is murdered in broad daylight, seemingly driven by a genie. The case escalates when another organ transplant recipient is murdered, with the donor's younger brother claiming the killer is a genie.

episodes.title: Maut Ka Ghar
episodes.overview: Abhijeet has a terrifying experience in a haunted house which leaves him shaken. He remembers seeing 2 dead bodies inside but when the cops check the next day, there's no trace of anything suspicious.

episodes.title: Khooni Daya
episodes.overview: A man says that Daya has stabbed him and wants to kill him. CID realize that he has a condition which causes him to see Daya's face in everyone caused by excessive chemicals in his brain. Will CID find out why?

episodes.title: Daya Ki Shaadi
episodes.overview: A family is blown up in their house, leaving the daughter behind but no clues no trails. A new twist appears when a woman claims to be Daya's wife with evidence. Daya denies it all and somehow both the cases are linked.

episodes.title: Khooni Dhun
episodes.overview: A deadly serial killer escapes while being transferred to another prison. CID are baffled as he kills 3 people in quick succession, but his sister is sure that he's not the killer. Is it really the serial killer or a copycat?

episodes.title: Bhavishya Se Paigam: Part 1
episodes.overview: Abhijeet is being troubled by a mysterious entity, who warns him that the entire CID is going to die. Even as he prepares for a toughest case that'll test the very limits of CID, on the other end is CID's most formidable foe.

episodes.title: Bhavishya Se Paigam: Part 2
episodes.overview: After the CID walk into a trap laid by the Eye, they're seen as fugitives from the law. John Harris has been found murdered and the CID are the prime suspects. Meanwhile, the cops realize that the conspiracy is not limited to a murder.

episodes.title: Khooni Dimag
episodes.overview: People are hearing voices in their heads that are forcing them to kill specific people and then commit suicides. CID are baffled as they can't pinpoint if this state is natural or induced by a mastermind.

episodes.title: Nashe Ki Pathshala
episodes.overview: A student union leader dies due to drug overdose in a medical college. Someone signals the local cop that it's actually a murder. CID go undercover in the same college and discover a large racket of exam paper leak. How will they stop it?

episodes.title: Cricket Dhamaka
episodes.overview: The star batsman of a domestic cricket league team is killed in a blast in the middle of the game. The CID suspect a betting angle. However, they soon realize that the victim was a brash, arrogant player who had more enemies than friends.

episodes.title: 10 Saal Ka Badla: Part 1
episodes.overview: The CID come to know that a released prisoner Krakato has a plan to take down ACP Pradyuman for arresting him. Meanwhile, a dead body is found and the dead man is found to have a direct connection to Krakato.

episodes.title: 10 Saal Ka Badla: Part 2
episodes.overview: The cops confront Krakato but he challenges ACP to kill Abhijeet and Daya in exchange for his grandson. They try to outwit him but he outwits them by telling them that he doesn't know where ACP's grandson is.

episodes.title: Raaz Gayab Gaadiyon Ka
episodes.overview: A number of cars are stolen in the city and one of the owners is brutally murdered. The CID realize that the killers have targeted all five cars which were sold on the same day for a particular reason.

episodes.title: Khooni Jungle
episodes.overview: A dead man's skin has been removed and kept in 3 bags. The CID investigate his death which leads to another death in front of them from the poisoned garland around his neck. They try to save another victim but find her hanged.

episodes.title: Khoon Ki Taiyari
episodes.overview: While shooting for a film in a forest, a dead body is found buried. CID realize that he wasn't killed in the forest as the trail leads the cops to a flat with blood stains all over the floor.

episodes.title: Imtihaan Ki Ghadi
episodes.overview: Two men on the run are found in strange circumstances. One of them is dead and the other suffering from a mysterious condition. CID find a strange glow from their bodies and discover that a deadly nuclear weapon has entered the country.

episodes.title: Behosh Khooni
episodes.overview: Abhijeet receives voice notes with instructions while on a flight. He then discovers a dead passenger on one of the seats.

episodes.title: Sazaa-E-Maut
episodes.overview: In the garb of the kidnapping of school kids, CID is in for a shocking journey when Daya is kidnapped during the investigation by a man who swears on hanging Daya to his death, just like his own brother who is being hung due to CID.

episodes.title: Abhijeet Ka Insaaf
episodes.overview: Abhijit ends up killing a criminal during an interrogation. CID receives huge backlash for misusing their powers and Abhijit is suspended by ACP. A furious and heartbroken Abhijit is kidnapped by a mysterious vigilante group. They make him an offer to join them and deliver justice by going against the law. Will Abhijit join them?

episodes.title: Rahasyamayi Gawah
episodes.overview: Cops are intrigued when a 17-year-old orphan suffering from a rare condition reports two murders. The problem is that she doesn't know when and where it happened and who was murdered. How will the cops solve this challenging case? Is the orphan saying the truth? Watch this episode to find out.

episodes.title: Rahasyamayi Hathyar: Part 1
episodes.overview: An investigation of a murder leads to death of Jimmy. Sheetal blames ACP to involve Jimmy in the case and ACP resigns from CID. Will ACP come back? Who will lead the team?

episodes.title: Rahasyamayi Hathyar: Part 2
episodes.overview: ACP is in the hunt to find Jimmy's killer but due to certain circumstance, he himself surrenders to the killer and then it's a race against time for the CID to save the ACP.

episodes.title: Aakhri Chunauti
episodes.overview: CID learn about the mysterious death of an internet celebrity named Siddharth. Daya and Abhijeet take up the case as ACP Pradyuman is busy with Jimmys birthday celebrations. Later, ACP Pradyuman is dejected learning that the case might be transferred to IB. The case takes a drastic turn as Jimmy is shot dead while trying to help the CID nab the criminals.

episodes.title: Satark Rahe
episodes.overview: Abhijeet gets a message on his phone. The message claims that information stored in a pen drive will lead the CID to the eye gang. The CID decide to find the pen drive. Meanwhile, ACP Pradyuman is in talks with a hacker to find out the trail of the eye gang. Will the CID team be able to find and arrest the eye gang? Watch the episode and find out.

episodes.title: The Final Challenge
episodes.overview: CID is called to investigate a strange murder case. A decapitated head is found in a bowling alley. CID find the body and Dr. Salunkhe finds out that the victim was shot dead before his head was decapitated. Also found at the crime scene is a briefcase. CID find multiple death certificates inside the briefcase. Who is the victim and why was he murdered? Watch the episode and find out.

episodes.title: Sniper Rifle Murderer
episodes.overview: During a critical rescue operation, Abhijeet tragically loses his daughter Shreya due to a minor error by Daya. Three months later, a mysterious shooting incident occurs on a metro, leaving a woman injured. How will ACP Pradyuman and his team uncover the truth behind this case?

episodes.title: A Mid-Air Murder
episodes.overview: On a mid-air flight, Abhijeet receives voice notes with certain instructions. He soon discovers a dead passenger on one of the seats. How will team CID aid Abhijeet solve the case and catch the culprit before the flight lands?

episodes.title: Body In The Red Suitcase
episodes.overview: During a journey from Nagpur to Mumbai, Richa's husband, Alok, vanishes under mysterious circumstances. Shockingly, his dismembered body is later discovered inside a suitcase. Who is behind this chilling crime?

episodes.title: Chehre Par Chehra
episodes.overview: CID officer Avni investigates a case involving her injured friend uncovering a tangled web of deception, identity twists, and a tragic past Can the team bring clarity to the chaos?

episodes.title: Murder On The Island
episodes.overview: Three charred bodies are discovered in a bungalow on a secluded island by catering staff. The CID team steps in to uncover the mystery behind the gruesome deaths. What secrets does the island hold?

episodes.title: Salunkhe's Catwalk
episodes.overview: The CID team investigates the mysterious death of Digvijay, an NRI groom, at his own wedding. As the case unfolds, they uncover a web of deception, hidden grudges, and unexpected twists, leading to a dramatic revelation about the true motive behind the crimes.

episodes.title: Grehani
episodes.overview: Vishal is a tech genius, whose AI, Grehani, leads to his mysterious death. The CID uncovers secrets of betrayal, rivalry, and a conspiracy surrounding the AI's dangerous potential.

episodes.title: Bank Robbery
episodes.overview: A bank robbery in Mumbai leaves manager Rahul as the sole victim of a planned attack. As CID investigates, they uncover a web of betting addiction, kidnapping, and betrayal involving Rahul, his sister-in-law Kanchan, and others.

episodes.title: Twelfth Victim
episodes.overview: A young man, Vasu, is jailed for his girlfriend Jhanvi’s murder, but years later, a serial killer confesses. CID uncovers a web of corruption, revenge, and deception tied to Jhanvi’s workplace, ultimately preventing a sinister plot and delivering justice.

episodes.title: Jungle
episodes.overview: A foreign photographer’s mysterious death in a forest sparks a CID investigation. As they uncover corruption, illegal activities, and local rituals, the team faces unforeseen challenges.

episodes.title: Gumnaam Hai Koi
episodes.overview: Tragedy strikes when a dancer suddenly collapses and dies while performing a hoola hoop routine on stage.

episodes.title: Ready to Eat
episodes.overview: The CID investigates a series of gruesome discoveries: fingers with numbers found in sausage packets. Tracing the source to a factory, they uncover a smuggling ring using victims to transport diamonds to Dubai.

episodes.title: Charcoal
episodes.overview: A corporate party turns deadly when a mysterious poison causes multiple deaths. The CID races against time, following clues to uncover the culprit and stop the poison's spread.

episodes.title: Katputli Ka Khel
episodes.overview: CID investigates a dancer's murder, uncovering a series of killings tied to an artistic pattern and a dark past. As they race to stop the next crime, the case leads to a dramatic showdown in an abandoned theatre.

episodes.title: Killer Route
episodes.overview: A series of gruesome murders targeting bus conductors on a specific route every Sunday baffles the CID, as victims are found beheaded with no trace of blood or their missing heads. Going undercover as conductors, the CID team hunts for the elusive killer.

episodes.title: The Last Fight
episodes.overview: The sudden death of a very famous underground fighter, Vikram in the ring. His girlfriend, sensing the situation, calls the CID.

episodes.title: Flat No 403
episodes.overview: A gunshot echoes through a society, leading CID to Vikrant's flat, where they find bloodstains and a skull on the wall. What mystery lies behind this chilling scene?

episodes.title: Mechanical Trap
episodes.overview: A deadly threat frames CID, putting Daya under suspicion. As the team investigates, they uncover a web of deception and the real mastermind behind the setup.

episodes.title: Haunted House
episodes.overview: Rajveer and his friends discover bloodstains in an abandoned bungalow and alert the CID. As the team investigates, they uncover something suspicious.

episodes.title: Murder In The House
episodes.overview: A woman is found dead in her home after a chandelier mysteriously falls on her. As CID investigates, they uncover suspicious details surrounding the incident.

episodes.title: Gilheri Rakshas
episodes.overview: A man discovers a dead body in the forest and suspects the Gilheri Rakshas is behind it. Can CID uncover the truth?

episodes.title: Death Of A Therapist
episodes.overview: Inspector Abhijeet discovers Dr. Meera dead at her clinic. As CID investigates, their search leads them to a Softech Solutions company. Who is behind the murder?

episodes.title: Not Guilty
episodes.overview: After an accident on a jungle road, Akshita seeks refuge with Dr. Salunkhe, who tries to shield her. As CID investigates, hidden truths unravel, leading to a shocking revelation.

episodes.title: Curse Of The Burning Man
episodes.overview: A man is found dead with burning footprints leading away. As the CID investigate, they uncover a deadly plot tied to an old shipyard legend.

episodes.title: Swimmers
episodes.overview: Three state-level swimmers go for a swim, but when one of them is found dead under mysterious circumstances, CID steps in. As they investigate, dark secrets and a cunning murder plot unravel, leading to a shocking truth.

episodes.title: Room No 804
episodes.overview: A man checks into Forest Woodland Resort only to realize that the eighth floor, which existed earlier, has mysteriously vanished. Later, CID arrives to investigate the murder of a girl found in Room 408. What is the truth behind this baffling case?

episodes.title: Baby Steps
episodes.overview: A yoga instructor, Rohini, mysteriously dies while on a call with CID, with only her baby present. Soon, another instructor, Puja, also dies. CID discovers both were killed remotely using Bluetooth hacks. How will CID solve this case?

episodes.title: The Talking Skeleton
episodes.overview: CID investigates a restaurant staff member’s death and uncovers hidden remains in a statue. As more victims emerge, they follow clues leading to a smuggling operation. How will CID get to the bottom of the case?

episodes.title: Men's Premier League
episodes.overview: The CID team is thrown into action when a biker hurls a duffel bag onto their car, raising bomb concerns. Upon inspection, they find cash and a tape recorder exposing a syndicate linked to match-fixing, with clues tied to cricket.

episodes.title: Nakabposh
episodes.overview: While Inspector Abhijeet pursues a criminal, he meets a man at a bus stop who claims to have a vision of a girl being murdered, with her hair being cut off. Soon after, CID investigates a case that matches his eerie prediction. Is this coincidence or something more sinister?

episodes.title: The End Of The Watch
episodes.overview: CID uncovers a bomb plot, only to realize it’s a trap by Barboza of the Golden Eye Gang. He hijacks the bureau and successfully kills ACP Pradyuman. Is this end of CID and ACP Pradyuman?

episodes.title: The Aftermath
episodes.overview: Barboza makes a threatening call to Daya, revealing ACP’s death. As the team reels from the loss, they prepare to take down Barboza and his gang. Meanwhile, Sachin remains in the ICU and Avni battles her injuries.

episodes.title: Ticket To Heaven
episodes.overview: Rajeev, a shopkeeper, is found dead on a bus under alarming circumstances - his face had turned cherry red with signs of rapid rigor mortis. CID officers Purvi and Pankaj are joined on the case by a couple of other officers, who doubt the team's capabilities in ACP Pradyuman's absence.

episodes.title: Purze
episodes.overview: ACP Ayushmaan arrives as the new ACP and sets boundaries before the team. Team CID then investigates the cases of gruesome, organ-harvesting murders, where the victims are abducted and are operated on when alive.

episodes.title: Murder At The Studio
episodes.overview: Podcaster Aniket, who had recently uncovered the identity of the culprit behind a two-year-old murder case, is found dead in his studio with his throat slit. ACP Ayushmaan and the CID take charge of the investigation to uncover the truth behind this chilling crime.

episodes.title: Murder At The Railway Tracks
episodes.overview: A girl is found dead near the Mahim railway tracks, prompting CID to take charge of the investigation. Meanwhile, Sachin notices something suspicious about the victim's footwear and urgently asks to speak with Inspector Daya,

episodes.title: Death In The Car
episodes.overview: A company prepares for a grand launch of its latest car, meant to showcase the future of automobiles. But during the big reveal, a corpse is discovered in the driver's seat. How will CID solve the case?

episodes.title: The Silent Den
episodes.overview: A mysterious murder takes place inside a silent den, leaving Team CID with no clear leads. As suspicion spreads among the staff and guests, will they be able to uncover the killer hiding in plain sight?

episodes.title: CID Mein Gaddar
episodes.overview: Team CID arrives at a school under threat from an unknown man. Meanwhile, ACP Pradyuman and ACP Ayushmaan clash over the Barboza case, with Ayushmaan suspecting a mole within their own team

episodes.title: Accidental Death Or A Planned Murder?
episodes.overview: Two celebrities from a reality show meet a mysterious end, sending shockwaves through the industry. As the investigation unfolds, team CID is soon alerted to yet another tragic incident - the accidental death of rising star Dhwani. Are these deaths truly accidents, or is there a sinister plot at play? With the pressure mounting, CID races against time to uncover the truth and bring the culprits to justice.

episodes.title: The Last Stroke
episodes.overview: A painter is found dead in his art gallery while working on a painting. As CID begins their investigation, they discover a lipstick mark on a cup, a diary, a photograph, and a mobile phone. Can these clues lead them to the killer?

episodes.title: Missing Flight
episodes.overview: Team CID is left baffled when they discover a corpse strapped to a seat, resembling a pilot who appears to have crashed. What is the mystery behind this strange death?

episodes.title: The Mysterious Death Of A Businessman
episodes.overview: A successful businessman is found dead while swimming in his pool at his farmhouse. Team CID investigates the case and is unable to find the cause of the death of the businessman. Soon after, another man is murdered. How will the team crack the cases?

episodes.title: Skeleton At A Construction Site
episodes.overview: CID team takes on a new case involving a skeleton found buried in the ground. With no initial clues, how will the team unravel the mystery?

episodes.title: Case Of Real Diamonds
episodes.overview: Two men are brutally murdered on the same night, one at home and the other at his office. The CID begins investigating and finds a diamond studed vase in both the crime scenes. Could there be a connection between the two cases?

episodes.title: The Last Call
episodes.overview: Unknown calls trigger deadly phone explosions across the city. CID discovers chips secretly installed in phones via a fake repair campaign. Linked to the old EchoNet project, the mastermind remains unknown.

episodes.title: Jewellery Theft
episodes.overview: A raid turns shocking when CID uncovers stolen jewellery in a godown - alongside Inspector Daya's badge. As suspicion clouds the team, a second daring heist strikes another jewellery store, carried out by masked men. Is Daya truly behind it, or is someone framing him?

episodes.title: ACP Pradyuman Is Alive?
episodes.overview: Daya tells the CID team that ACP Pradyuman is alive-but in a shocking twist, he reveals that the ACP failed to recognize him and opened fire. As the team reels from the news, Daya exposes a dark secret about Barboza and his gang that shakes them to the core. Can CID reach ACP Pradyuman before it's too late?

episodes.title: ACP Pradyuman Tricks CID
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman escapes with Barboza, deceiving the entire CID team. When he walks into the bureau, Abhijeet refuses to believe his story. Later, ACP reveals the shocking truth behind how he survived the bureau blast.

episodes.title: Accident Or Murder?
episodes.overview: Purvi comes under suspicion as the team believes she's the mole, until the DIG arrives just in time to defend her. Meanwhile, CID investigates a minor car crash with a shocking twist. Was the driver killed in the accident, or was he already dead before the impact?

episodes.title: Behind the Glamour
episodes.overview: Ira, an actress who had bagged a coveted role, is found hanging in her apartment. Team CID investigates the case as they find out about Ira's rival. Who killed Ira, and why?

episodes.title: Death In The Jungle
episodes.overview: While trekking, four friends stumble upon a headless body deep in the jungle. When CID investigates, they find something even stranger - the body has no blood. With no clues and rising fear, can CID uncover the truth behind this eerie mystery?

episodes.title: Dead Men In Uniform
episodes.overview: A group of kids find a gun in their society. Soon after, a policeman falls to his death. A young girl silently sees someone who looks like Daya behind a mask. Later, two more police officers are murdered. What is this case really about?

episodes.title: Janamdin Par Maut
episodes.overview: Officer Daya tampers some of the evidence of a case. Parallelly, a man is murdered as he enters his house for his surprise birthday party. Notably, while waiting for Salil to return, Dodo makes a statement about the incident of a man being killed on his birthday. Who killed Salil and why?

episodes.title: Omkar Sawant Joins The Team
episodes.overview: Daya shoots Inspector Milan on a moving bus. As CID begins their investigation, Superintendent Omkar Sawant joins the team. While interrogating the passengers, they uncover four distinct personalities within the same man. Can they reach Daya in time and will Inspector Milan survive?

episodes.title: Omkar Sawant Has A Breakthrough
episodes.overview: Superintendent Omkar Sawant announces that the death of Officer Milan has resulted in a breakthrough in the case. Soon after, he states that he has been tracing Officer Daya's moves. Meanwhile, team CID is notified about murder cases that lead to similar, torturous deaths of different victims.

episodes.title: Officer Daya Is On The Run
episodes.overview: Officer Daya disguises himself and boards a flight. The same flight happens to get hijacked. With team CID on the hunt for Officer Daya, will he be able to save the passengers, conceal his identity, and get away without drawing any attention towards him?

episodes.title: An Encrypted Message
episodes.overview: Team CID raids Officer Daya's house and discovers that he has escaped in disguise. While Officer Daya takes Shreya's help once he lands in Delhi, some of the members of Team CID decrypt his secret message left behind. What will the encrypted message lead to?

episodes.title: Purvi Receives A Message
episodes.overview: While team CID surrounds the Governor's residence, Daya succeeds in sending an encrypted message to Purvi. Daya and Shreya continue working on their operation. Will Purvi be able to decipher Daya's message?

episodes.title: Double Agent Daya
episodes.overview: When Omkar Sawant exposes Daya's truth, Abhijeet defends him and reveals the real mastermind. As Purvi and Abhijeet enter the building to rescue Daya and the Governor, will their mission succeed?

episodes.title: Team CID On A Vacation
episodes.overview: While team CID is on vacation at a resort, they discover that a comedian's manager named Mohan has been murdered after being hit on the head by a coconut. Can they solve the case while still on holiday?

episodes.title: Officer Purvi's Narrow Escape
episodes.overview: Team CID finds out the cause of Tanya's death. Soon after, Officer Purvi narrowly escapes acid being flung towards her. On further investigation, the team narrows down the list of suspects. Will the culprit outwit team CID?

episodes.title: Ekk Anokha Case
episodes.overview: Sarthak, a man who is found dead, writes in his suicide note about murdering somebody else. Team CID has 72 hours to crack the case and save the life of the victim. Who is the victim and why did Sarthak kill him before dying?

episodes.title: Dr Salunkhe Goes Missing
episodes.overview: With only 42 hours left, Dr. Salunkhe is missing. Meanwhile, the man impersonating him is found dead inside the jail. During the investigation, it is revealed that someone posing as Daya had visited Dr. Salunkhe in jail. Will CID be able to find the real Dr. Salunkhe and uncover the cure for the poison in time?

episodes.title: CID Ke Naam Ek Gift
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman receives a mysterious call about a gift from someone calling himself the Chessmaster. CID finds themselves caught in a real-life game of chess as they race to solve the case. What danger lies ahead for the team?

episodes.title: Ekk Insaan, Do Maut
episodes.overview: Team CID investigates the death of a man and finds out that he has died twice. How will the team uncover this curious mystery, and what is the cause of the death?

episodes.title: Accident Ya Murder?
episodes.overview: A bike accident takes a shocking turn when the autopsy reveals hidden truths. The team begins to suspect foul play. Was it really an accident or a cleverly planned murder? The race to find out the truth begins.

episodes.title: Officer Abhijeet Witnesses A Crime
episodes.overview: While recovering at home from an injury, Officer Abhijeet believes that he has witnessed a crime take place in the apartment opposite his. Officer Daya arrives at the aforesaid apartment and finds the apartment bare. Team CID investigates whether a crime has taken place or if Officer Abhijeet is hallucinating.

episodes.title: Failed Transactions
episodes.overview: Multiple payment transactions fail across the city. Meanwhile, CID probes an accident involving a doctor set to receive an award on 15th August, only to discover he was responsible for YPI transaction security. What mystery will this investigation uncover?

episodes.title: Shraap
episodes.overview: CID investigates a case in a chawl where young Prasad collapses during Dahi Handi practice, his body twisted backwards from the waist. While an old lady calls it a curse, will CID uncover the real cause?

episodes.title: Dead Principal
episodes.overview: The principal of a college is found dead under mysterious circumstances. When CID investigates, they find red powder in his nails and deep scratches on his neck. Their suspicion falls on Professor Ajit, but is he really behind the murder or is there more to the case?

episodes.title: Do Minute, Do Khoon
episodes.overview: As the organisers at Lunaro Art Gallery gear up for their most anticipated exhibition, Dr Myra and Vikram are found murdered. Team CID investigates the case but gets trapped at the gallery when the anti-theft alarm goes off. Will they solve the crime with depleting oxygen levels in the gallery?

episodes.title: Manch Par Maut
episodes.overview: Amid Ganpati celebrations, the CID team is called in to investigate the mysterious death of a famous dance teacher. While it appears to be a heart attack, suspicions of murder grow stronger. Will the truth come out?

episodes.title: The Headless Dead Body
episodes.overview: Team CID investigates the case of a headless dead body found in a trunk on top of a bus. Who is the victim, why was he murdered and who is the culprit?

episodes.title: An Author's Murder Mystery
episodes.overview: While Team CID is busy playing a game of chess, they receive news of the murder of renowned novelist Surya. The case appears to be a natural death at first, until they discover a burnt paper with details about the murder in his room. How will CID unravel this mystery?

episodes.title: A Serial Killer's Revenge
episodes.overview: Chaos erupts when a feared serial killer breaks free, determined to hunt those behind his arrest. As fear grips the city, the CID team must stay one step ahead and track him down before his deadly revenge claims more victims.",shortDescription:"Chaos erupts when a feared serial killer breaks free, determined to hunt those behind his arrest. As fear grips the city, the CID team must stay one step ahead and track him down before his deadly revenge claims more victims.

episodes.title: Shooting Stars
episodes.overview: Arpan mysteriously dies moments after proposing to his girlfriend through a video under a shooting star. When the CID begins its investigation, they discover his charred body at the very spot of the attack. Was Arpan truly killed by a celestial phenomenon, or is there a darker conspiracy at work?

episodes.title: High Security Murder
episodes.overview: Abhijeet receives a threat that his friend Dhanraj's life is in danger. With Dhanraj under high-profile security, can Abhijeet reach him before it's too late?

episodes.title: Haunted Amusement Park
episodes.overview: A social media experiment to revive an abandoned amusement park turns sinister when an influencer dies mid-stunt. Can the CID team uncover the dark truth hidden inside?

episodes.title: Bureau Mein Murder
episodes.overview: A man walks into the CID bureau to report a threat to his life and warns ACP Pradyuman about an impending attack in Mumbai. But before he can say more, he suddenly dies right there in the bureau. How will ACP Pradyuman and his team uncover the truth behind this case?

episodes.title: Influencer Ki Maut
episodes.overview: On being called by Shanaya's concerned manager, team CID smashes Shanaya's door and finds her murdered. The top suspects involve Shanaya's current boyfriend and her ex-boyfriend. Based on the postmortem results, team CID hunts for an important clue. How will they catch the murderer?

episodes.title: Pariyon Ki Duniya
episodes.overview: CID takes on a baffling case where people act possessed, speak of a fairyland, and then die by suicide. With no substances found in their bodies and all deaths occurring at the same time, what is really behind this mystery?

episodes.title: A Poisoned Necklace
episodes.overview: Shreya arrives to attend the engagement ceremony of Rashi and Aman. Soon after, Rashi is found murdered after having wom a poisoned necklace. Team CID investigates the case and finds out that a slow poison was being administered to Rashi since a while. Who is the culprit and why was Rashi murdered?

episodes.title: Curious Case Of Artificial Intelligence
episodes.overview: Cricketer Neerav's daughter is kidnapped from school, and CID steps in to investigate. They discover that an unknown person picked her up claiming to have Neerav's permission. How will CID crack the case?

episodes.title: Murder At The Resort
episodes.overview: Team CID reaches a resort to investigate the mysterious death of a young girl. Upon inspection, they discover she was stabbed in a fit of rage. Will CID uncover the truth behind Surbhi's death while questioning her friends?

episodes.title: Deadly Overtime
episodes.overview: A woman is murdered under mysterious circumstances while working late in her office. The CID team notices something strange in the CCTV footage. Motion sensors detect movement but no body appears. Forensics reveal unusual entry and exit wounds. Can the team solve this baffling case?

episodes.title: Bungalow Mein Maut
episodes.overview: CID investigates a shocking case where a man named Kunal is found dead, but the police discover that Kunal himself had reported his own death before it happened. What is the mystery behind this eerie case?

episodes.title: An Obsessed Fan
episodes.overview: Neha is found dead in actress Aisha's green room, stabbed in the back with a pair of scissors. During the investigation, Pankaj discovers a strange necklace with Aisha's photo made from blue hair. What dark secret lies behind this eerie clue?

episodes.title: RJ Ki Maut
episodes.overview: Pankaj is on a call with RJ Rishabh when suddenly, the RJ calls out for help and is then found murdered. When team CID investigates the case, they find a few dead honeybees in the room. Who is the culprit and why was the crime committed?

episodes.title: Karmo Ka Phal
episodes.overview: A man is found dead with his face crushed by a stone and a message scrawled in his blood at an isolated spot with no CCTV. Was his death a personal vendetta, or is there a darker motive behind it?

episodes.title: Death Of A Fortune Teller
episodes.overview: A crowd gathers to hear messages from their ancestors through a woman, but suddenly the woman collapses and dies right before their eyes. When CID arrives to investigate, they discover someone else's blood stains at the scene. What dark truth lies behind this mysterious case?

episodes.title: Buried In Cement
episodes.overview: A unique case comes up for the CID team when a body is discovered buried in cement inside an abandoned bungalow. What clues will the team uncover from this corpse that has been lying there for months?

episodes.title: Cursed Mirror
episodes.overview: Actress Reva is found unconscious after a mysterious accident that appears to be deliberate. When CID takes charge of the investigation, they discover that Reva possessed a cursed mirror. What dark secret lies behind this shocking incident?

episodes.title: Death After Discharge
episodes.overview: Dhiren, a businessman, is found dead in his car after being discharged from the hospital. Team CID investigates the case and finds out more about his family dynamics and the ongoing politics in his business. Who murdered Dhiren and why?

episodes.title: Maut Ki Dhamki
episodes.overview: Businessman Kuldeep receives a threatening phone call over a bungalow dispute and is later found dead in his meditation room. Team CID investigates the case and discovers a broken window and aroma oil on his face. Who killed Kuldeep?

episodes.title: Apsara
episodes.overview: While team CID heads out for a picnic, they stumble upon a mysterious case involving a missing policeman. The prime suspect is a woman who lives by the lake and is known to lure men with her charm and jewellery. As the team dives deeper into the investigation, they uncover multiple corpses hidden beneath the lake's surface. What dark secret lies behind this eerie mystery?

episodes.title: Ekk Anokha Shadyantra
episodes.overview: Team CID investigates a case where they find a woman's body without the head. The entire team stitches various clues together and identifies the victim to be Alisha. On further investigation, the team narrows down the flow of the events leading to the murder. Who murdered Alisha and why?

episodes.title: A Chain Of Murders
episodes.overview: The CID team stumbles upon a strange case where an auto-rickshaw driver is found strangled to death with no signs of struggle and no witnesses. Soon after, another eerily similar death is discovered not far from the first scene. Is a serial killer on the loose, or is there a deeper connection behind these murders?

episodes.title: SOS Call
episodes.overview: Team CID follows a set of coordinates to a secluded location after receiving an SOS call. As they begin their search, they try to track down Officer Shreya and a woman named Sarla who was with her. What mystery lies behind this case, and where have Shreya and Sarla disappeared?

episodes.title: Rakshak Baba
episodes.overview: Three friends trespass onto land owned by Rakshak Baba. One escapes, but the other two are found decapitated and their bodies discovered deeper in the forest. How will CID piece the case together?

episodes.title: The Ghost Of Kalighati Village
episodes.overview: While on vacation, Daya discovers a village plagued by murders. Locals claim a witch is behind these deaths. Can he uncover the truth?

episodes.title: Murder At The Bureau
episodes.overview: When a serial killer dies in CID custody, suspicion falls on Abhijeet. ACP Pradyuman defends him as the team fights to clear his name.

episodes.title: Abhijeet's Secret Caller
episodes.overview: A truck driver named Munna is found dead and his partner is missing. CID is stunned to discover that the RDX once loaded in the truck has vanished. During the investigation, Abhijeet receives a rose and a call from a mysterious woman asking for help. Are these two incidents connected?

episodes.title: Abhijeet Shoots Daya
episodes.overview: With Abhijeet suspected of having gone rogue, team CID attempts to track 400 kg of RDX across the city. The team follows a lead and tracks delivery boys in the city. Shortly after, during a shootout, Abhijeet fires at Daya before escaping. What is Abhijeet's plan?
